sentences.zh: 志一百十五

translations.literal: Treatise one hundred fifteen.
translations.idiomatic: Treatise 115

sentences.zh: 兵十一

translations.literal: Military eleven.
translations.idiomatic: Military 11

sentences.zh: 製造

translations.literal: Manufacturing.
translations.idiomatic: Manufacturing

sentences.zh: 清代以弧矢定天下，而威遠攻堅，亦資火器。

translations.literal: The Qing dynasty established the realm with bow and arrow, yet for awe at distance and assault on strongholds, it also relied on firearms.
translations.idiomatic: The Qing won the empire with the bow, but projecting power at a distance and breaching fortifications also depended on firearms.

sentences.zh: 故京營有火器營鳥槍兵之制，屢命各省防軍參用槍砲。

translations.literal: Therefore the capital garrison had the institution of the Firearms Battalion and musket troops, and repeatedly ordered the provincial defense forces to employ guns and cannon as well.
translations.idiomatic: Hence the capital garrison maintained a Firearms Battalion with musket troops, and the court repeatedly directed provincial defense armies to adopt rifles and artillery.

sentences.zh: 初皆前膛舊制，繼購歐洲新器。

translations.literal: At first all were old-pattern muzzle-loaders; afterward European new weapons were purchased.
translations.idiomatic: At first everything was the old muzzle-loading pattern; later the government began buying new European arms.

sentences.zh: 其後始命各省設局製造。

translations.literal: After that, provinces were first ordered to establish bureaus for manufacture.
translations.idiomatic: Only later were the provinces ordered to set up manufacturing bureaus of their own.

sentences.zh: 製造之事，實始天津。

translations.literal: The matter of manufacture in fact began at Tianjin.
translations.idiomatic: Domestic arms production in fact began at Tianjin.

sentences.zh: 當咸、同間，中原未靖，李鴻章疏請在天津設機器局，自造槍砲，以供北方軍隊之用。

translations.literal: During the Xianfeng and Tongzhi reigns, when the central plains were not yet pacified, Li Hongzhang memorialized requesting the establishment of a machine bureau at Tianjin to manufacture guns and cannon on its own, to supply the northern armies.
translations.idiomatic: In the Xianfeng and Tongzhi years, while the heartland was still unsettled, Li Hongzhang petitioned to found a machine bureau at Tianjin to build rifles and artillery for the northern forces.

sentences.zh: 同時，江蘇亦創立機器局。

translations.literal: At the same time, Jiangsu also founded a machine bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangsu established a machine bureau at the same time.

sentences.zh: 同治四年，江蘇巡撫李鴻章疏言，統軍在江南剿賊，習見西洋火器之精，乃棄習用之抬槍、鳥槍，而改為洋槍隊。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Tongzhi, Jiangsu governor Li Hongzhang memorialized that the army under his command, while suppressing rebels in Jiangnan, had grown accustomed to seeing the excellence of Western firearms and therefore abandoned the wall guns and muskets they had long used and changed to foreign-rifle companies.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 4 (1865), Governor Li Hongzhang of Jiangsu reported that his forces fighting rebels in the south, having seen how fine Western firearms were, had dropped their familiar wall guns and muskets in favor of companies armed with foreign rifles.

sentences.zh: 留防各軍五萬餘人，約有洋槍四萬枝，銅帽月須千餘萬顆，粗細洋火藥十數萬斤，均在香港、上海購買。

translations.literal: The garrison troops left behind, more than fifty thousand men, had about forty thousand foreign rifles; percussion caps alone required more than ten million per month, and coarse and fine foreign gunpowder several hundred thousand catties—all purchased in Hong Kong and Shanghai.
translations.idiomatic: The more than fifty thousand troops left on garrison duty fielded roughly forty thousand foreign rifles, and each month needed over ten million percussion caps and tens of thousands of catties of foreign powder, all bought in Hong Kong and Shanghai.

sentences.zh: 又開花砲四營，每砲一具，重者千餘斤，輕亦數百斤，砲具精堅，藥彈繁重。

translations.literal: There were also four battalions of shell-firing cannon; each piece, the heavy ones over a thousand catties and even the light ones several hundred, was exquisitely solid, and powder and shot were weighty.
translations.idiomatic: There were four battalions of shell guns as well; each piece weighed over a thousand catties in the heavy types and still several hundred in the lighter ones—superbly made, with ammunition to match.

sentences.zh: 惟器械子彈皆系洋式，所用銅鐵木煤各項，均來自外洋。

translations.literal: Only the weapons and ammunition were all of foreign pattern; the copper, iron, wood, coal, and other materials used all came from abroad.
translations.idiomatic: Yet every weapon and round was of foreign design, and the copper, iron, timber, coal, and other inputs all had to be imported.

sentences.zh: 必須就近設局自造，以省繁費。

translations.literal: It was necessary to set up bureaus nearby for self-manufacture, in order to save heavy expense.
translations.idiomatic: Bureaus had to be set up locally for domestic production if costs were to be brought under control.

sentences.zh: 江蘇先設三局。

translations.literal: Jiangsu first established three bureaus.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangsu opened three bureaus at the outset.

sentences.zh: 嗣因丁日昌在上海購得機器鐵廠一座，將丁日昌、韓殿甲二局移並上海鐵廠。

translations.literal: Later, because Ding Richang purchased a machine ironworks in Shanghai, the two bureaus of Ding Richang and Han Dianjia were merged into that Shanghai ironworks.
translations.idiomatic: Later Ding Richang bought a machine ironworks in Shanghai and merged the bureaus named for him and Han Dianjia into it.

sentences.zh: 以後能移設金陵附近，濱江僻地，最為久遠之謀。

translations.literal: If later it could be moved and established near Jinling, in a secluded place on the river, that would be the most far-sighted plan.
translations.idiomatic: Relocating the works eventually to a quiet riverside site near Jinling would be the soundest long-term plan.

sentences.zh: 五年，閩浙總督左宗棠疏言，外洋開花砲，近日督飭工匠仿造，已成三十餘尊。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Governor-General Zuo Zongtang of Fujian and Zhejiang memorialized that foreign shell guns had recently been copied under his supervision, and more than thirty pieces had been completed.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 5 (1866), Zuo Zongtang, governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang, reported that his craftsmen had lately copied foreign shell guns and already turned out more than thirty pieces.

sentences.zh: 用尺測量，施放與西洋同其功用。

translations.literal: Measured with a rule and test-fired, they matched Western guns in function.
translations.idiomatic: Measured and test-fired, they performed the same as Western pieces.

sentences.zh: 十三年，船政大臣沈葆楨疏請飭沿江海各省，仿津、滬二廠，自設槍砲子藥廠局。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, Maritime Affairs minister Shen Baozhen memorialized requesting that the provinces along the coast and rivers be ordered, following the Tianjin and Shanghai plants, to set up their own bureaus for guns, cannon, and ammunition.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 13 (1874), Shen Baozhen, superintendent of naval affairs, asked that every coastal and river province be directed, on the model of the Tianjin and Shanghai arsenals, to establish its own gun, artillery, and munitions works.

sentences.zh: 光緒二年，李鴻章、沈葆楨、丁日昌疏請選派製造學生十四人，製造藝徒四人，由出洋監督帶赴法國學習製造。

translations.literal: In the second year of Guangxu, Li Hongzhang, Shen Baozhen, and Ding Richang memorialized requesting the selection of fourteen manufacturing students and four manufacturing apprentices to be taken to France by the overseas superintendent to study manufacture.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 2 (1876), Li Hongzhang, Shen Baozhen, and Ding Richang petitioned to send fourteen manufacturing students and four apprentices to France under the overseas superintendent to learn arms production.

sentences.zh: 此項學生，既宜另延學堂教習課讀，以培植根本，又宜赴廠習藝，以明理法，俾兼程並進，以收速效，備他日監工之選。

translations.literal: These students should both engage separate school instructors for classroom study to cultivate fundamentals, and go to factories to learn craft so as to master principles and methods, thus advancing by both routes together for quick results and future selection as factory supervisors.
translations.idiomatic: These students should study in a classroom to build a solid foundation while also training in workshops to master technique—pursuing both tracks at once for rapid progress and eventual appointment as factory supervisors.

sentences.zh: 其藝徒學成後，可備分廠監工之選。

translations.literal: When the apprentices completed their training, they could be chosen as supervisors at branch factories.
translations.idiomatic: The apprentices, once trained, would be candidates to supervise branch plants.

sentences.zh: 凡所習之藝，均須新巧，勿循舊式。

translations.literal: Whatever crafts were studied must be new and ingenious; old patterns must not be followed.
translations.idiomatic: Every skill taught had to be up-to-date; obsolete methods were not to be followed.

sentences.zh: 如有他廠新式機器，及砲台、兵船、營壘、礦廠，應行考訂之處，由監督酌帶生徒前往學習。

translations.literal: If other factories had new-style machinery, or fort batteries, warships, camps, or mines that ought to be studied, the superintendent might take students there at his discretion to learn.
translations.idiomatic: Wherever new machinery, batteries, warships, fortifications, or mines deserved study, the superintendent might take students to learn on site.

sentences.zh: 山東巡撫丁寶楨疏言：「今在山東省城創立機器製造局，不用外洋工匠一人，局基設在濼口，自春及秋，將機器廠、生鐵廠、熟鐵廠、木樣廠、繪圖房，及物料庫、工料庫大小十餘座，一律告成。

translations.literal: Shandong governor Ding Baozhen memorialized: "Now a machine manufacturing bureau has been founded in the Shandong provincial capital without employing a single foreign artisan; the site is at Luokou, and from spring through autumn more than ten buildings—the machine plant, pig-iron plant, wrought-iron plant, pattern shop, drafting room, and material and work-supply storehouses—have all been completed.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Ding Baozhen of Shandong reported: "We have now founded a machine manufacturing bureau in the provincial capital without hiring a single foreign craftsman. The site at Luokou has seen more than ten buildings finished between spring and autumn—the machine shop, pig-iron and wrought-iron plants, pattern shop, drafting room, and material and supply storehouses.

sentences.zh: 其火藥各廠，如提硝房、蒸硫房、煏炭房、碾炭房、碾硫房、碾硝房、合藥房、碾藥房、碎藥房、壓藥房、成粒房、篩藥房、光藥房、烘藥房、裝箱房，亦次第告竣。

translations.literal: Its powder plants as well—such as the saltpeter-extraction room, sulfur-steaming room, charcoal-charring room, charcoal-grinding room, sulfur-grinding room, saltpeter-grinding room, compounding room, powder-grinding room, powder-crushing room, powder-pressing room, granulating room, sieving room, glazing room, drying room, and packing room—were also completed in succession.
translations.idiomatic: The powder works followed in turn—rooms for extracting saltpeter, steaming sulfur, charring and grinding charcoal, grinding sulfur and saltpeter, compounding, grinding, crushing, and pressing powder, granulating, sieving, glazing, drying, and packing—all were finished one after another.

sentences.zh: 其各廠煙筒，高自四十尺至九十尺不等，凡大小十餘座。

translations.literal: The chimneys of the various plants, ranging from forty to ninety feet in height, numbered more than ten large and small.
translations.idiomatic: More than ten chimneys for the various plants, from forty to ninety feet high, were also in place.

sentences.zh: 所買外洋機器，次第運取。

translations.literal: The foreign machinery purchased was being transported in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Foreign machinery on order was arriving in stages.

sentences.zh: 俟機件煤炭各種備全，廠局告成，不逾一年，即可開工。

translations.literal: When parts, coal, and other supplies were all ready and the plants completed, within no more than a year work could begin.
translations.idiomatic: Once parts, coal, and other supplies were in hand and the plants complete, production could begin within a year.

sentences.zh: 將來如格林砲、克魯伯砲、林明登槍、馬梯尼槍，均可自造，不至受制於人，並可接濟各省，由水路轉運。

translations.literal: In the future Gatling guns, Krupp guns, Martini rifles, and Martini-Henry rifles could all be made on site, so as not to be subject to others, and could also supply the provinces, transported by water.
translations.idiomatic: Eventually Gatling guns, Krupp cannon, and Martini rifles could all be built at home, ending dependence on foreigners, and surplus output could be shipped by water to other provinces.

sentences.zh: 即使洋商閉關，不虞坐困也。」

translations.literal: Even if foreign merchants closed trade, there would be no fear of being left helpless.
translations.idiomatic: Even if foreign merchants cut off trade, we would not be left helpless."

sentences.zh: 直隸總督李鴻章、兩江總督沈葆楨、江蘇巡撫吳元炳疏言：「上海製造局自同治四年開辦，閱七年，曾請獎一次。

translations.literal: Governor-General Li Hongzhang of Zhili, Governor-General Shen Baozhen of Liangjiang, and Jiangsu governor Wu Yuanbing memorialized: "The Shanghai Manufacturing Bureau, since it opened in the fourth year of Tongzhi, after seven years had once been rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang, governor-general of Zhili, Shen Baozhen, governor-general of Liangjiang, and Wu Yuanbing, governor of Jiangsu, wrote: "The Shanghai Manufacturing Bureau opened in Tongzhi 4 (1865); seven years later its staff received rewards once.

sentences.zh: 今又閱七年，先後增造機器二百三十三座，大小銅鐵砲三百四十八尊，砲架七百八十餘座，開花實心砲彈十萬一千餘顆，各式洋槍一萬八千六百餘枝，槍彈八十餘萬顆，火藥十七萬磅，其他零件關係軍事者甚多。

translations.literal: Now after another seven years, they had successively added two hundred thirty-three machines, three hundred forty-eight large and small bronze and iron cannon, more than seven hundred eighty gun carriages, one hundred one thousand shell and solid shot, more than eighteen thousand six hundred foreign rifles of various types, more than eight hundred thousand rifle rounds, one hundred seventy thousand pounds of powder, and many other military parts besides.
translations.idiomatic: Another seven years on, they had added 233 machines, 348 bronze and iron guns large and small, more than 780 carriages, over 101,000 shell and solid shot, more than 18,600 foreign rifles of various types, over 800,000 rifle rounds, 170,000 pounds of powder, and a great many other military parts besides.

sentences.zh: 在事諸人，寢饋於刀鋸湯火之側，出入於硝磺毒物之間，積數年之辛苦，乃克有此成績。

translations.literal: Those engaged in the work ate and slept beside saws and furnaces and went in and out among niter, sulfur, and poisons; only after years of hardship could such results be achieved.
translations.idiomatic: The men involved lived beside forges and saws and worked amid niter, sulfur, and other hazards; only years of hardship produced these results.

sentences.zh: 請優獎以資鼓勵。」

translations.literal: They requested exceptional rewards as encouragement."
translations.idiomatic: They asked for exceptional rewards as encouragement."

translations.literal: (closing quotation mark in the source.)
translations.idiomatic: (closing quotation mark in the source.)

sentences.zh: 三年，湖南巡撫王文韶疏言：「近年上海、天津、江寧均有制造局，濱海固宜籌備，而內地亦應講求。

translations.literal: In the third year, Hunan governor Wang Wenshao memorialized: "In recent years Shanghai, Tianjin, and Jiangning have all had manufacturing bureaus; coastal areas should indeed be provided for, but the interior should also be attended to.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 3 (1877), Governor Wang Wenshao of Hunan wrote: "Shanghai, Tianjin, and Jiangning have all had arsenals in recent years. Coastal defense rightly demands such provision, but the interior should not be neglected either.

sentences.zh: 湘省一年以來，先建廠，次制器，仿造洋式，規模粗具。

translations.literal: In Hunan over the past year, plants were built first and then weapons made; foreign patterns were copied and the scale was roughly in place.
translations.idiomatic: Over the past year Hunan has first built plants and then begun turning out arms on foreign patterns; the establishment is roughly in place.

sentences.zh: 後膛槍及開花砲子，試演均能如法，與購自外洋者並無區別。

translations.literal: Breech-loading rifles and shell-gun projectiles, when test-fired, all performed properly and differed in no way from those purchased abroad.
translations.idiomatic: Breech-loading rifles and shell-gun projectiles test-fired correctly and were indistinguishable from imports.

sentences.zh: 以後隨時添造，自數千斤以至萬斤大砲，或鋼或銅，均可自造。

translations.literal: Henceforth additions could be made at any time; from guns of several thousand catties up to ten-thousand-catty great cannon, whether steel or bronze, could all be made on site.
translations.idiomatic: More can be added at any time thereafter—from guns of a few thousand catties up to ten-thousand-catty pieces, in steel or bronze, all can be built at home.

sentences.zh: 湘省向產煤鐵，攸縣、安化各處所產之鐵，與洋鐵一律受鑽。

translations.literal: Hunan has long produced coal and iron; iron from Youxian, Anhua, and other places drills the same as foreign iron.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan has long produced coal and iron; iron from You, Anhua, and other districts drills like foreign metal.

sentences.zh: 火藥一項，督匠精造，與洋火藥不相上下。

translations.literal: As for gunpowder, under supervision craftsmen refined it finely, and it was not inferior to foreign powder.
translations.idiomatic: Gunpowder, made under close supervision, is a match for foreign powder.

sentences.zh: 自光緒元年五月開辦，至二年十月，共用二萬二千餘兩。

translations.literal: From opening in the fifth month of the first year of Guangxu to the tenth month of the second year, more than twenty-two thousand taels were spent in all.
translations.idiomatic: From opening in the fifth month of Guangxu 1 (1875) through the tenth month of Guangxu 2 (1876), the outlay totaled more than 22,000 taels.

sentences.zh: 以後每月以三千兩為度。

translations.literal: Hereafter three thousand taels per month was set as the norm.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth the monthly budget is set at 3,000 taels.

sentences.zh: 請援津、滬二局成案，專摺奏銷。」

translations.literal: He requested following the precedent of the Tianjin and Shanghai bureaus and reporting expenditures in separate memorials."
translations.idiomatic: He asked to follow the Tianjin and Shanghai precedent and report expenditures in separate memorials."

sentences.zh: 四川總督丁寶楨疏言：「川省已設機器局，今外洋機件運到，即行開局，自造洋槍子彈等項。」

translations.literal: Sichuan governor Ding Baozhen memorialized: "Sichuan has already established a machine bureau; now that foreign machinery has arrived, the bureau will open at once to manufacture foreign rifles, bullets, and the like on its own."
translations.idiomatic: Governor Ding Baozhen of Sichuan reported: "Sichuan has already set up a machine bureau. Now that foreign machinery has arrived, work will begin at once on rifles, ammunition, and the like."

translations.literal: (closing quotation mark in the source.)
translations.idiomatic: (closing quotation mark in the source.)

sentences.zh: 四年，總理衙門王大臣疏言：「前陳海防事宜，有簡器一條，巨砲應如何購辦，各軍洋槍應如何一律，以後應如何自行仿造，請飭疆臣切實詳議以聞。」

translations.literal: In the fourth year, the princes and ministers of the Zongli Yamen memorialized: "Previously, in stating coastal defense matters, there was an item on simplifying armaments: how great cannon should be purchased, how the foreign rifles of the various armies should be standardized, and how imitation manufacture should proceed hereafter—frontier officials were ordered to deliberate in detail and report."
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 4 (1878), the princes and ministers of the Zongli Yamen wrote: "In our earlier report on coastal defense we included an item on streamlining armaments—how heavy guns should be procured, how foreign rifles in the various armies should be standardized, and how domestic imitation should proceed—and asked frontier officials to deliberate fully and report back."

sentences.zh: 嗣據各將軍、督、撫覆陳：「有言前膛槍穩實者，有言後膛槍靈捷者，有言線槍勝於洋槍者，有言宜勤加操練磨洗者，有言不宜多購防新出更勝者，有言宜派人赴外洋學習者，有言宜內地設局以防後患者。

translations.literal: Thereupon, according to replies from the various generals, governors, and governors-general: "Some said muzzle-loaders were steady and solid; some said breech-loaders were nimble; some said rifled guns surpassed foreign rifles; some said drilling and maintenance should be intensified; some said large purchases should be avoided lest newer superior models appear; some said men should be sent abroad to learn; some said bureaus should be set up inland as a safeguard for the future.
translations.idiomatic: Governors and generals then replied with a welter of views: "Some favored muzzle-loaders as steadier, others breech-loaders as handier; some held rifled guns superior to foreign rifles; some urged more drill and maintenance; some warned against overbuying lest newer models appear; some wanted students sent abroad; some wanted inland arsenals as insurance for the future.

sentences.zh: 臣等查外洋槍砲，近時皆用後膛，名目甚多，必須擇其至精之品，一律切實辦理，庶在彼不敢售其欺，在我得以適其用。

translations.literal: We have examined foreign guns and cannon: recently all use breech-loading, and the names are very numerous; the finest types must be chosen and implemented uniformly in earnest, so that they dare not sell us deception and we may put them to proper use.
translations.idiomatic: We find that foreign arms today are almost all breech-loading and come under many names. The finest types must be chosen and applied uniformly, so that sellers cannot palm off inferior goods and our forces can use what they buy effectively.

sentences.zh: 外洋軍械價值，本無成案可考，故承辦之員，視為利藪。

translations.literal: The prices of foreign arms had no fixed precedent for reference, so those in charge treated them as a profit trough.
translations.idiomatic: Because foreign arms had no fixed price schedule, those who handled procurement treated the trade as a source of profit.

sentences.zh: 查上海為各洋商聚集之地，多在該處交易。

translations.literal: Shanghai is where the various foreign merchants gather, and most dealings take place there.
translations.idiomatic: Shanghai is where foreign merchants congregate and where most such business is done.

sentences.zh: 請以精明廉正之員，總理其事。

translations.literal: We request that capable, upright officials be placed in overall charge.
translations.idiomatic: We ask that capable, upright officials be put in overall charge.

sentences.zh: 各省有委辦軍火者，責成該員核定。

translations.literal: Where provinces had commissioners for munitions, those officials should be held responsible for verification.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial agents charged with munitions should be held to verify purchases through that office.

sentences.zh: 如有浮冒等事，嚴行治罪。

translations.literal: If there were padding or the like, punishment should be strictly applied.
translations.idiomatic: Padding or fraud should be punished severely.

sentences.zh: 至仿造外洋軍火，李鴻章先後奏在上海、天津設局製造。

translations.literal: As for imitating foreign arms, Li Hongzhang had successively memorialized establishing manufacturing bureaus at Shanghai and Tianjin.
translations.idiomatic: On domestic imitation, Li Hongzhang had already memorialized for arsenals at Shanghai and Tianjin.

sentences.zh: 丁寶楨、王文韶亦在山東、湖南二省各設局廠，不用洋人，其費最省。

translations.literal: Ding Baozhen and Wang Wenshao also each set up bureau-plants in Shandong and Hunan without employing foreigners, at the lowest cost.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Baozhen and Wang Wenshao had each set up plants in Shandong and Hunan without foreign staff, at the lowest cost.

sentences.zh: 丁寶楨復於四川設局。

translations.literal: Ding Baozhen also established a bureau in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Baozhen had also opened a bureau in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 以上三局，均設在內地。

translations.literal: The three bureaus above were all set up in the interior.
translations.idiomatic: All three of these inland bureaus lay in the interior.

sentences.zh: 滬局製造槍藥，歲用銀四、五十萬兩。

translations.literal: The Shanghai bureau, manufacturing guns and powder, used four to five hundred thousand taels of silver yearly.
translations.idiomatic: The Shanghai bureau, producing rifles and powder, spent four to five hundred thousand taels a year.

translations.literal: The Tianjin bureau used more than two hundred thousand taels yearly.
translations.idiomatic: The Tianjin bureau spent more than two hundred thousand taels annually.

translations.literal: Recently, according to memorials from Li Hongzhang and Shen Baozhen, the Tianjin bureau made breech-loading cannon while the Shanghai bureau made both muzzle- and breech-loading foreign rifles; since they did not cooperate fully, what suited one place might not suit another.

sentences.zh: 請飭兩局派得力人員，隨時酌核，畫一辦理。」

translations.literal: We request that both bureaus send capable personnel to review and adjust at any time and handle matters uniformly."

translations.literal: At that time some court officials proposed using Shanghai machine-bureau funds for fixed garrison pay and relief contributions.
translations.idiomatic: At that time some officials proposed diverting Shanghai arsenal funds to garrison pay and relief contributions.

sentences.zh: 兩江總督沈葆楨疏陳，謂機器局締造十餘年，僅恃二成洋稅，入不敷出，而南北洋所用槍砲子藥，咸取給於此。

translations.literal: Liangjiang governor-general Shen Baozhen memorialized stating that the machine bureau, after more than ten years of establishment, relied only on twenty percent of the maritime customs revenue and could not cover expenses, while the guns, cannon, and ammunition used by the northern and southern fleets all came from it.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Shen Baozhen of Liangjiang replied that the bureau, after more than ten years, relied on only twenty percent of customs revenue and ran at a deficit, yet supplied all rifles, cannon, and ammunition for the northern and southern fleets.

sentences.zh: 海防重要，未可停工。

translations.literal: Coastal defense was important; work could not be halted.
translations.idiomatic: Coastal defense was too important for the plants to be shut down.

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Ding Baozhen memorialized that the Sichuan machine bureau had recently been petitioned to halt by En Cheng and Tong Hua; an edict ordered measured handling, but he still requested means to revive operations and not let them fall into ruin, and manufacturing was reopened.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 5 (1879), Ding Baozhen reported that En Cheng and Tong Hua had lately petitioned to close the Sichuan machine bureau. Although the throne ordered a measured response, he still urged that operations be revived rather than abandoned, and manufacturing resumed.

sentences.zh: 七年，兩江總督劉坤一疏言：「金陵製造局，於光緒六年，即飭工匠加工製造。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, Liangjiang governor-general Liu Kunyi memorialized: "The Jinling Manufacturing Bureau, in the sixth year of Guangxu, had already ordered craftsmen to intensify production.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 7 (1881), Governor-General Liu Kunyi of Liangjiang wrote: "At the Jinling Manufacturing Bureau, craftsmen were already ordered in Guangxu 6 (1880) to step up production.

sentences.zh: 各軍撥用洋槍，先後已及萬枝。

translations.literal: Foreign rifles allocated to the various armies had already reached ten thousand in all.
translations.idiomatic: Foreign rifles issued to the various armies had already passed ten thousand in all.

sentences.zh: 今軍械所尚存來福前膛槍一萬三千餘枝，馬梯尼後膛槍七千餘枝，林明登後膛槍八千餘枝，細洋火藥六十五萬餘磅，洋砲火藥四十餘萬磅，棉花火藥九萬九千餘磅，銅火一千萬磅，各項銅管火十七餘萬件，又水雷應用之電線七十五車，所儲尚不為少。

translations.literal: Now the ordnance depot still held more than thirteen thousand Enfield muzzle-loading rifles, more than seven thousand Martini breech-loaders, more than eight thousand Martini-Henry breech-loaders, more than six hundred fifty thousand pounds of fine foreign powder, more than four hundred thousand pounds of artillery powder, more than ninety-nine thousand pounds of cotton powder, ten million percussion caps, more than one hundred seventy thousand copper-tube primers, and seventy-five cartloads of electric wire for torpedoes—the stores were not small.
translations.idiomatic: The ordnance depot still holds more than 13,000 Enfield muzzle-loaders, over 7,000 Martini breech-loaders, over 8,000 Martini-Henry breech-loaders, more than 650,000 pounds of fine foreign powder, over 400,000 pounds of artillery powder, nearly 100,000 pounds of cotton powder, ten million percussion caps, over 170,000 copper primers, and seventy-five cartloads of torpedo wire—the stock is substantial.

sentences.zh: 而上海製造局現造之洋藥及林明登槍，可隨時接濟金陵。

translations.literal: Meanwhile the foreign powder and Martini rifles now made at the Shanghai Manufacturing Bureau could supply Jinling at any time.
translations.idiomatic: Powder and Martini rifles now coming from the Shanghai bureau can resupply Jinling at any time.

sentences.zh: 復定購機器，增設洋火藥局，並定購前後膛槍一萬五千枝，尚不在此數內。

translations.literal: Machinery was also ordered, a foreign-powder plant was added, and fifteen thousand muzzle- and breech-loading rifles were ordered besides—not counted in the figures above.
translations.idiomatic: Machinery has also been ordered, a foreign-powder plant added, and fifteen thousand muzzle- and breech-loading rifles contracted for—none of which is included in the figures above.

sentences.zh: 至各處明暗砲台所用之砲位，有上海製造局現造之一百二十磅子之鋼砲，年內可成。

translations.idiomatic: For batteries open and concealed along the coast, 120-pounder steel guns now under construction at Shanghai should be ready within the year.

translations.idiomatic: Field guns from the Jinling bureau are also largely serviceable."

translations.literal: That year, Wu Dacheng, superintendent of affairs for Ningguta and other places, memorialized requesting the founding of a machine bureau in Jilin.
translations.idiomatic: That year Wu Dacheng, superintendent for Ningguta and related territories, petitioned to establish a machine bureau in Jilin.

sentences.zh: 十一年，直隸總督李鴻章疏言：「上海、江寧、天津、廣東各機器局，大都分造砲械子藥，以供各軍操練戰守之用，尚未能仿造後膛大砲。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, Zhili governor-general Li Hongzhang memorialized: "The machine bureaus of Shanghai, Jiangning, Tianjin, and Guangdong mostly divided production of cannon, weapons, and ammunition to supply the various armies for drill and defense, but could not yet imitate large breech-loading guns.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 11 (1885), Li Hongzhang, governor-general of Zhili, wrote: "The arsenals at Shanghai, Jiangning, Tianjin, and Guangdong mostly turn out cannon, small arms, and ammunition for drill and defense, but cannot yet copy large breech-loading guns.

sentences.zh: 至若三、四寸口徑後膛小砲，後膛連珠砲，為水陸軍必需之利器，應就內地已開煤鐵礦近水之處，分設造槍、造砲專廠。

translations.literal: As for three- and four-inch breech-loading field guns and breech-loading repeater cannon, essential weapons for army and navy, specialized rifle and cannon plants should be set up where inland coal and iron mines already opened lay near water.
translations.idiomatic: Three- and four-inch breech-loading field pieces and repeater cannon, essential to army and navy alike, should be built at specialized plants sited inland near coal and iron mines and navigable water.

sentences.zh: 至克魯伯鋼砲，近來德、奧、義各國，恐純鋼不盡合用，均改造硬銅後膛小砲，融煉別有新法。

translations.literal: As for Krupp steel guns, recently Germany, Austria, and Italy, fearing that pure steel was not wholly suitable, all converted to hard-bronze breech-loading field guns, with new methods of smelting.
translations.idiomatic: Even for Krupp steel guns, Germany, Austria, and Italy lately doubted that pure steel was ideal and shifted to hard-bronze breech-loading field pieces cast by new smelting methods.

sentences.zh: 日本已聘洋匠仿造。

translations.literal: Japan had already hired foreign artisans to copy them.
translations.idiomatic: Japan has already hired foreign engineers to copy them.

sentences.zh: 中國亦宜踵行。

translations.literal: China should also follow suit.
translations.idiomatic: China should follow suit.

translations.literal: The patterns of foreign breech-loading rifles differed; the new style used repeaters of six or seven shots, unmatched in precision and power.
translations.idiomatic: Foreign breech-loading rifles vary in pattern; the newest repeaters fire six or seven rounds and are unrivaled in accuracy and power.

sentences.zh: 日本已設廠自造，中國亦宜專造，以應各省之用。

translations.literal: Japan had already set up factories for self-production; China should also specialize in manufacture to meet the provinces' needs.
translations.idiomatic: Japan already manufactures them domestically; China should do the same to supply the provinces.

sentences.zh: 約計造槍及小砲機器皆不過數十萬金，尚不甚鉅。

translations.literal: Roughly, machinery for rifles and small cannon would cost only several hundred thousand taels—not very large.
translations.idiomatic: Machinery for rifles and light cannon would cost only a few hundred thousand taels—not a huge sum.

sentences.zh: 水師所用之魚雷、伏雷，與砲並重。

translations.literal: Torpedoes and mines used by the navy were as important as cannon.
translations.idiomatic: Naval torpedoes and mines matter as much as guns.

sentences.zh: 各種伏雷，中國機器局多能自造。

translations.literal: Various kinds of mines, Chinese machine bureaus could mostly make on their own.
translations.idiomatic: Chinese arsenals can already build most types of mine.

sentences.zh: 至魚雷則理法精奧，別有不傳之秘，只可向西洋訂購。

translations.literal: Torpedoes, however, had subtle principles and secrets not transmitted; they could only be ordered from the West.
translations.idiomatic: Torpedoes, however, involve subtle principles and trade secrets and can only be ordered from the West.

sentences.zh: 天津機器局已購備試雷修雷之具，仿造則未易言也。」

translations.literal: The Tianjin machine bureau had already purchased equipment for testing and repairing torpedoes; imitation was not easy to speak of."
translations.idiomatic: The Tianjin bureau has bought gear for testing and repairing torpedoes, but copying them is another matter."

sentences.zh: 兩廣總督張之洞疏言：「粵省請募款開設槍、雷各局，其大砲仍歸滬、閩二廠製造。」

translations.literal: Governor-General Zhang Zhidong of Guangdong and Guangxi memorialized: "Guangdong requests funds to open rifle and torpedo bureaus; large cannon would still be made at the Shanghai and Fujian plants."
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhidong, governor-general of Guangdong and Guangxi, asked to raise funds for rifle and torpedo works while leaving heavy guns to the Shanghai and Fujian arsenals."

sentences.zh: 又疏言：「省城有機器局，城西增步地方有軍火局，以器具未備，僅能制小鋼砲開花子、尋常洋火藥、白藥、水雷殼、洋火箭、修理船砲尋常機器，除火藥、火箭尚可用，其餘能成而不能精。

translations.literal: He memorialized again: "The provincial capital has a machine bureau, and at Zengbu west of the city there is an ordnance bureau; with equipment incomplete, it could only make small steel guns and shells, ordinary foreign powder, white powder, mine casings, foreign rockets, and common machinery for repairing ship guns—except powder and rockets, which were still usable, the rest could be produced but not finely.
translations.idiomatic: He added: "The capital has a machine bureau and an ordnance bureau at Zengbu west of the city. sentences.zh: 設局十餘年，用銀數十萬，迥非津、滬、閩各局之比。

translations.literal: After more than ten years of establishment, several hundred thousand taels had been spent—far from comparable to the Tianjin, Shanghai, and Fujian bureaus.
translations.idiomatic: After more than ten years and several hundred thousand taels spent, the results are nothing like those of Tianjin, Shanghai, or Fujian.

sentences.zh: 今重加整頓，以機器、軍火二局，併入城西增步一局，以就水運之便，名曰製造局，仍制槍砲彈火藥等物。

translations.literal: Now, with thorough reorganization, the machine and ordnance bureaus were merged into one bureau at Zengbu west of the city for convenience of water transport, named the Manufacturing Bureau, still producing guns, cannon, shells, and powder.
translations.idiomatic: We are now reorganizing: the machine and ordnance bureaus will merge into a single plant at Zengbu for ease of water transport, to be called the Manufacturing Bureau, still producing rifles, cannon, shells, and powder.

sentences.zh: 其修理魚雷，歸黃埔雷局。

translations.literal: Torpedo repair was assigned to the Whampoa torpedo bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Torpedo repair will go to the Whampoa torpedo station.

sentences.zh: 就制械而言，以槍彈與行營砲為尤要。

translations.literal: As for arms production, rifle ammunition and field guns were especially important.
translations.idiomatic: For armaments, rifle ammunition and field guns are the priority.

sentences.zh: 蓋購槍可用數年，購彈不能支三月，一舉而購槍數千則易，一舉而購砲數十則難。

translations.literal: For rifles bought once could serve several years, but ammunition bought could not last three months; buying several thousand rifles at a stroke was easy, but buying several dozen cannon at once was hard.
translations.idiomatic: Rifles bought once last years, but ammunition bought in bulk lasts barely three months; procuring thousands of rifles at once is easy, dozens of cannon at once is hard.

sentences.zh: 自宜分條並舉，循序圖功。

translations.literal: It was right to pursue items separately in parallel and advance step by step toward results.
translations.idiomatic: Tasks should therefore be divided, pursued in parallel, and advanced step by step.

sentences.zh: 期以一年半而鑄槍砲廠成，兩年而砲台備，庶足以御強敵。」

translations.literal: The aim was that in a year and a half the gun and cannon foundry would be complete, and in two years the batteries ready, so as to be able to resist a strong enemy."
translations.idiomatic: The goal is a gun and cannon foundry in a year and a half and batteries ready in two years, enough to face a strong enemy."

translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Zuo Zongtang urged that "provincial arsenals be consolidated under unified planning and clear accountability.

sentences.zh: 前曾疏請開徐州、穆源各礦，為鐵甲鋼砲材料。

translations.literal: He had previously memorialized to open the mines at Xuzhou and Muyuan as material for ironclads and steel guns.
translations.idiomatic: He had earlier petitioned to open mines at Xuzhou and Muyuan to supply ironclads and steel guns.

sentences.zh: 茲奉諭飭議設廠處所，若論常格，自應由兩江、閩浙籌款試辦，或委公正富紳，集股創辦，並招通曉化學之人，研求煉法，俾速出鋼鐵應用。

translations.literal: Now, having received an edict ordering deliberation on sites for establishing plants, if one follows the regular practice, funds should naturally be raised by Liangjiang and Min-Zhe for trial operation, or upright wealthy gentry should be entrusted to gather shares and establish the enterprise, and persons well versed in chemistry should also be recruited to investigate smelting methods, so that steel and iron may quickly be produced for use.
translations.idiomatic: An imperial order now required plans for factory sites. Under normal procedure, Liangjiang and Min-Zhe should raise funds for a trial run, or upright wealthy gentry could be enlisted to gather capital and launch the enterprise, while chemists were recruited to develop smelting methods so steel and iron could be turned out quickly.

sentences.zh: 其實礦政船砲，相為表裡。

translations.literal: In truth, mining policy, ships, and cannon are mutually inner and outer aspects.
translations.idiomatic: In truth, mining policy, naval construction, and artillery were two sides of the same enterprise.

sentences.zh: 應設海防全政大臣，所有制造船砲礦廠軍火事宜，皆宜一手經理，以歸畫一。」

translations.literal: A grand minister for overall coastal defense policy ought to be established; all matters of manufacturing ships, cannon, mining plants, and ordnance should be managed in one hand for unified control."
translations.idiomatic: A single high commissioner for coastal defense should oversee shipbuilding, cannon manufacture, mining works, and ordnance under one authority to keep policy uniform."

translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 12 (1886), Governor-General Zeng Guoquan of Liangjiang reported that the Jinling foreign gunpowder works had been completed.

sentences.zh: 四川總督丁寶楨疏言：「川省建設製造局，已及五年。

translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Ding Baozhen of Sichuan wrote: "Sichuan's manufacturing bureau has now been in operation for five years.

sentences.zh: 仿造洋槍，為數不下一萬五千餘枝。

translations.literal: Western rifles copied numbered no less than more than fifteen thousand pieces.
translations.idiomatic: It had copied more than 15,000 foreign rifles.

sentences.zh: 除接濟廣西、雲南軍營外，局中尚存後膛洋槍三千五百枝，前膛洋槍四千枝。

translations.literal: Aside from supplying the Guangxi and Yunnan military camps, the bureau still had on hand three thousand five hundred breech-loading foreign rifles and four thousand muzzle-loading foreign rifles.
translations.idiomatic: Besides supplying camps in Guangxi and Yunnan, the bureau still held 3,500 breech-loading rifles and 4,000 muzzle-loading rifles.

sentences.zh: 恐不敷用，向上海洋商訂購克虜伯開花砲、格林砲各十尊，另造得用之劈山砲七十餘尊，抬槍五百枝備用。

translations.literal: Fearing they would not suffice for use, ten Krupp shell guns and ten Gatling guns were ordered from foreign merchants in Shanghai; additionally, more than seventy usable mountain guns were made, and five hundred wall guns were kept in reserve.
translations.idiomatic: Fearing shortages, he ordered ten Krupp shell guns and ten Gatling guns from Shanghai merchants, built more than seventy serviceable mountain guns, and held five hundred wall guns in reserve.

sentences.zh: 其火器彈丸銅帽等，除撥用外，尚存九萬餘斤。

translations.literal: As for gunpowder, bullets, copper caps, and the like, aside from what was allocated for use, more than ninety thousand jin still remained.
translations.idiomatic: Apart from what had been issued, the bureau still had more than 90,000 jin of powder, balls, copper caps, and related supplies.

sentences.zh: 今加工製造，每月可得火藥七千餘斤，以資接濟。」

translations.literal: Now, with intensified manufacture, more than seven thousand jin of gunpowder can be obtained each month for supply."
translations.idiomatic: With production stepped up, the bureau could now turn out more than 7,000 jin of gunpowder each month."

translations.idiomatic: (closing quotation mark in the source.)

sentences.zh: 十三年，四川總督劉秉璋疏言：「川省機器委員曾照吉等，能用巧思，不招洋匠，自教工徒，仿造外洋槍砲，創用水輪機器，以省煤力。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, Sichuan governor-general Liu Bingzhang memorialized: "The Sichuan machine commissioners Zeng Zhaoji and others were able to use ingenious ideas, did not recruit foreign artisans, taught the workers themselves, copied foreign rifles and cannon, and innovated by using water-wheel machinery to save coal power.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 13 (1887), Governor-General Liu Bingzhang of Sichuan wrote: "Sichuan's machine commissioners Zeng Zhaoji and others showed real ingenuity: without hiring foreign artisans, they trained their own workers, copied foreign rifles and cannon, and introduced water-wheel machinery to save coal.

sentences.zh: 又於省城外設局，以水機製造火藥。

translations.literal: They also established a bureau outside the provincial capital to manufacture gunpowder with water-powered machinery.
translations.idiomatic: They also set up a bureau outside the provincial capital to make gunpowder with water power.

sentences.zh: 數年以來，成機三部，機器一千五百九十件，洋槍一萬四千九百枝，火藥二十八萬餘斤，銅火帽一千三百七十五顆，後膛藥彈六十八萬五千五百顆，鉛子六十萬五千顆，洋砲三具，成績甚優。」

translations.literal: Over several years they produced three complete water-wheel sets, one thousand five hundred ninety machine parts, fourteen thousand nine hundred foreign rifles, more than two hundred eighty thousand jin of gunpowder, one thousand three hundred seventy-five copper percussion caps, six hundred eighty-five thousand five hundred breech-loading cartridges, six hundred five thousand lead balls, and three foreign cannon—the results were excellent."

translations.idiomatic: He therefore bought rifle and cartridge machinery in Shanghai and shipped it to Guangdong.

translations.literal: A rifle and ammunition manufacturing plant was then established at Shijing market north of the provincial capital.
translations.idiomatic: He promptly founded a rifle and cartridge factory at Shijing market, north of the provincial capital.

sentences.zh: 所有機器大廠一座，打鐵、烘銅殼、鍋爐、造木箱、裝子藥房共五處，儲料、發料庫各一處，又有裝蠟餅紙餅火藥及工匠等房，共安設機器二副，能造毛瑟、馬梯尼、士乃得、雲者士得四種槍彈。

translations.literal: There was one main machine hall, five sections for iron forging, copper-shell baking, boilers, crate making, and cartridge loading, one storage depot and one issue depot each, and further rooms for loading wax-paper cake gunpowder and for artisans; two complete sets of machinery were installed, able to manufacture four kinds of rifle ammunition: Mauser, Martini, Snider, and Snider-Enfield.
translations.idiomatic: The plant included a main machine hall, five shops for forging, baking copper shells, boilers, crate making, and cartridge loading, separate storage and issue depots, rooms for wax-paper powder charges and workers' quarters, and two complete machine sets capable of turning out Mauser, Martini, Snider, and Snider-Enfield cartridges.

sentences.zh: 試辦之初，每日約造二千顆。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the trial operation, about two thousand rounds were made each day.
translations.idiomatic: At first the trial run produced about 2,000 rounds a day.

sentences.zh: 熟習之後，每日可造八千顆。

translations.literal: After the workers became skilled, eight thousand rounds could be made each day.
translations.idiomatic: Once the crews were trained, daily output could reach 8,000 rounds.

sentences.zh: 目前即可開造。

translations.literal: Production could begin immediately.
translations.idiomatic: Production could begin at once.

sentences.zh: 尚有需用鎔銅、碾銅等機器，並增建廠屋，俟次第到齊，即可舉辦。」

translations.literal: There were still needed machines for melting copper, rolling copper, and the like, along with additional plant buildings; once these arrived in sequence, operations could proceed."
translations.idiomatic: Additional copper-melting and copper-rolling machinery and expanded buildings were still on order; once everything arrived, full operations could begin."

translations.literal: (closing quotation mark in the source.)
translations.idiomatic: (closing quotation mark in the source.)

sentences.zh: 十五年，張之洞疏言：「廣東籌建水師、陸師學堂，並於堂外建機器廠一座，鑄鐵廠一座，煙筒一座，及儲料所、打鐵廠、工匠房、操場、演武廳、石堤、馬頭等，約用銀六萬兩。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, Zhang Zhidong memorialized: "Guangdong planned to build naval and army schools, and outside the schools to build one machine plant, one iron-casting plant, one smokestack, and a materials depot, iron forge, artisans' quarters, drill ground, martial arts hall, stone embankment, wharf, and the like, costing about sixty thousand taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 15 (1889), Zhang Zhidong wrote: "Guangdong planned naval and army schools and, alongside them, a machine shop, an iron foundry, a smokestack, a materials depot, a forge, workers' quarters, a drill ground, a martial arts hall, a stone embankment, and a wharf, at a cost of about 60,000 taels.

sentences.zh: 機器廠內有十二匹馬力汽鍋機爐全座，大小旋鐵床、削鐵床、鑽鐵機、剪鐵機共一十七架，手用器具，銅鐵鋼料，約用英金二千五百鎊。

translations.literal: Inside the machine plant was one complete twelve-horsepower steam boiler engine set, seventeen machines in all including large and small lathes, planing machines, drilling machines, and shearing machines, along with hand tools and copper, iron, and steel stock, costing about two thousand five hundred pounds sterling.
translations.idiomatic: The machine shop would contain a complete twelve-horsepower steam boiler engine, seventeen lathes, planers, drills, and shears, plus hand tools and copper, iron, and steel stock, at a cost of about £2,500.

sentences.zh: 其機器在英國廠訂購之。」

translations.literal: The machinery was ordered from a factory in Britain."
translations.idiomatic: The machinery was ordered from a British factory."

sentences.zh: 又疏言：「前曾由文武官紳及鹽埠各商分年捐銀八十萬，造小兵輪十號。

translations.literal: He further memorialized: "Previously, civil and military officials, gentry, and merchants at the salt ports had donated eight hundred thousand taels over several years to build ten small gunboats.
translations.idiomatic: He also reported that "civil and military officials, gentry, and salt merchants had pledged 800,000 taels over several years to build ten small gunboats.

sentences.zh: 今接續捐募三年，專為購買製造機器並建築廠屋經費。

translations.literal: Fundraising would now continue for three years, devoted solely to purchasing manufacturing machinery and building plant structures.
translations.idiomatic: Fundraising would continue for three more years, earmarked solely for buying manufacturing machinery and building factory structures.

sentences.zh: 乃電詢德國柏林地方力拂機器廠，訂購新式製造連珠毛瑟槍，及造克魯伯砲、過山砲各項機器全副，其汽機馬力加大，以便槍砲兼造，鍋爐並為一廠，較為節省。

translations.literal: A telegram inquiry was then sent to the Lifu machine works near Berlin, Germany, to order a complete new set of machinery for manufacturing repeater Mauser rifles and for making Krupp guns and mountain guns; the steam engine horsepower was increased so rifles and cannon could be made together, with the boiler in one plant, which was more economical.
translations.idiomatic: He telegraphed the Lifu machine works near Berlin to order a full set of modern machinery for repeater Mauser rifles and for Krupp and mountain guns, with a larger steam engine so rifles and cannon could be made in one plant with a shared boiler, saving expense.

sentences.zh: 旋由出使德國大臣與該廠訂造槍機器一分，每日能造新式連珠十響槍五十枝，汽機馬力一百二十匹，又造砲機器一分，每年能成克魯伯砲口徑七生的半至十二生的之過山砲五十具，又購槍尾尖刀機器全分，價共一百八十一萬七千兩。

translations.literal: The minister dispatched to Germany then contracted with that factory for one set of rifle machinery able to make fifty new-pattern ten-shot repeater rifles per day, with a one-hundred-twenty-horsepower steam engine; one set of cannon machinery able to finish fifty Krupp mountain guns per year of calibers from seven and a half to twelve centimeters; and a complete set of machinery for rifle bayonets—the total price was one million eight hundred seventeen thousand taels.
translations.idiomatic: The minister to Germany then contracted for rifle machinery with a 120-horsepower engine capable of fifty new ten-shot repeater rifles a day; cannon machinery able to finish fifty Krupp mountain guns a year of 7.5 to 12 centimeter caliber; and a complete bayonet-making set—all for 1,817,000 taels.

sentences.zh: 今擇定省城西北石門地方，依山臨江，輸運便利，於建廠相宜，乃即日開工起築。

translations.literal: A site at Shimen northwest of the provincial capital was now chosen, backed by hills and facing the river, convenient for transport and suitable for building the plant; construction began that very day.
translations.idiomatic: He chose Shimen, northwest of the provincial capital, backed by hills and fronting the river with easy transport—a site well suited to factory building—and broke ground at once.

sentences.zh: 其槍管鋼料及鍊鋼罐等，均向德國名廠購備，以期精良。

translations.literal: Rifle-barrel steel and steel-refining crucibles and the like would all be purchased from renowned German factories, in hope of excellent quality.
translations.idiomatic: Rifle-barrel steel, refining crucibles, and related materials would be bought from leading German firms to ensure quality.

sentences.zh: 他日鐵礦各山開採得法，則鋼鐵材料取給內地，次第擴充，並可接濟各省軍營也。」

translations.literal: When iron mines in the various hills were opened and worked by proper methods, steel and iron materials would be supplied from within the country, expansion would proceed step by step, and the various provincial military camps could also be supplied."
translations.idiomatic: Once iron mines were opened and worked properly, steel and iron could be drawn from domestic sources, the works expanded step by step, and ordnance supplied to provincial camps as well."

translations.literal: (closing quotation mark in the source.)
translations.idiomatic: (closing quotation mark in the source.)

sentences.zh: 十六年，湖廣總督張之洞於湖北省城初建兵工廠。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, Huguang governor-general Zhang Zhidong first built an ordnance factory at the Hubei provincial capital.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 16 (1890), Governor-General Zhang Zhidong of Huguang began building an ordnance factory at the Hubei provincial capital.

sentences.zh: 是年，總理海軍事務大臣與戶部會議，以廣東槍砲廠改移湖北省，開廠後，常年經費，由湖北籌辦。

translations.literal: That year, the superintendent of naval affairs and the Board of Revenue conferred and decided that the Guangdong rifle and cannon plant would be moved to Hubei province; after opening, its regular annual expenses would be raised by Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: That year the superintendent of naval affairs and the Board of Revenue agreed to move the Guangdong rifle and cannon works to Hubei, with Hubei to fund its regular operations once it opened.

sentences.zh: 旋由湖廣總督張之洞覆陳：「鄂省開廠後，督飭洋匠，悉心考求。

translations.literal: Governor-General Zhang Zhidong of Huguang then submitted a follow-up report: "After Hubei opened its plant, he supervised the foreign artisans and studied the matter with full care.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhidong then reported in follow-up: "Once the Hubei plant opened, he would supervise the foreign artisans and investigate every detail.

sentences.zh: 原定造槍機器一副，每年能造新式連珠十響毛瑟槍一萬五千枝，造砲機器每年能成克魯伯七生的半至十二生的行營砲及台砲共一百具。

translations.literal: Originally one set of rifle machinery was planned, able to make fifteen thousand new-pattern ten-shot repeater Mauser rifles per year; the cannon machinery was to finish one hundred Krupp field and fort guns per year of calibers from seven and a half to twelve centimeters.
translations.idiomatic: The original plan called for rifle machinery to turn out 15,000 new ten-shot repeater Mauser rifles a year and cannon machinery to finish 100 Krupp field and fort guns of 7.5 to 12 centimeter caliber.

sentences.zh: 又應添購造槍砲藥、造白藥、造彈、造砲車、造砲架各機器。

translations.literal: Machinery for making rifle and cannon powder, smokeless powder, shells, gun carriages, and gun mounts should also be added.
translations.idiomatic: Additional machinery would also be needed for rifle and cannon powder, smokeless powder, shells, gun carriages, and gun mounts.

sentences.zh: 每槍一枝，隨彈五百顆，每年須成槍彈七百五十萬顆。

translations.literal: For each rifle, five hundred rounds accompanied it; seven million five hundred thousand rifle rounds had to be completed each year.
translations.idiomatic: At five hundred rounds per rifle, the plant would need to produce 7.5 million cartridges a year.

sentences.zh: 每砲一尊，外洋向例隨帶砲彈三百顆，茲就最少之數，亦須隨彈二百顆，每年須成實心彈、開花彈各種彈共三萬顆。

translations.literal: For each cannon, foreign practice customarily supplied three hundred shells; taking the minimum figure here, two hundred shells per gun were still required, and thirty thousand solid shells, shell rounds, and various other projectiles had to be completed each year.
translations.idiomatic: Foreign practice supplied three hundred shells per gun; even at the minimum of two hundred, the plant would need 30,000 solid shot, explosive shells, and other projectiles each year.

sentences.zh: 統計一切經費，約需銀七十五萬兩。

translations.literal: Counting all expenses together, about seven hundred fifty thousand taels of silver would be needed.
translations.idiomatic: Total annual costs would run to about 750,000 taels.

sentences.zh: 計一年所造槍砲全分，比外洋買價所省甚多。

translations.literal: Calculated against foreign purchase prices, a full year's output of rifles and cannon would save a great deal.
translations.idiomatic: A full year's output of rifles and cannon would save far more than buying abroad.

sentences.zh: 特是鉅款難籌，此次開廠試辦，所有槍砲藥彈，每年各造一半，約需銀四十萬兩。

translations.literal: But the huge sum was hard to raise; for this trial opening of the plant, all rifles, cannon, powder, and ammunition would each be made at half the planned annual rate, requiring about four hundred thousand taels.
translations.idiomatic: But such a large sum was hard to raise; for the trial opening, rifles, cannon, powder, and ammunition would each be made at half the planned rate, costing about 400,000 taels a year.

sentences.zh: 機器今已到鄂，置閒必至鏽壞，工匠亦必練習，方能精熟。

translations.literal: The machinery had now reached Hubei; left idle it would surely rust and spoil, and the artisans also had to practice before they could become fully skilled.
translations.idiomatic: The machinery had already reached Hubei; left idle it would rust, and the workers needed practice to reach proficiency.

sentences.zh: 就鄂省財力自行籌措，查四川機器製造局，系奏明支用土藥稅釐，今湖北槍砲廠乃奉旨特辦，較四川製造局大小懸殊，關係尤重。

translations.literal: Within Hubei's financial capacity he would raise funds himself; the Sichuan machine manufacturing bureau, it was found, had been approved to draw on the native opium tax surcharge, whereas the Hubei rifle and cannon plant was specially ordered by imperial edict, vastly larger than the Sichuan bureau and of even greater importance.
translations.idiomatic: Hubei would raise what it could on its own. The Sichuan machine bureau drew on the native opium tax surcharge, but the Hubei rifle and cannon works was an imperial special project, far larger than Sichuan's and of even greater consequence.

sentences.zh: 請將湖北省歲入土藥稅銀二十萬兩，川鹽加價銀十萬兩，共三十萬兩，撥充槍砲廠常年經費。

translations.literal: He requested that two hundred thousand taels of Hubei's annual native opium tax revenue and one hundred thousand taels from the Sichuan salt price surcharge, three hundred thousand taels in all, be allocated as the rifle and cannon plant's regular annual expenses.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that 200,000 taels from Hubei's native opium tax and 100,000 taels from the Sichuan salt surcharge—300,000 taels in all—be set aside as the plant's regular annual budget.

sentences.zh: 將來各省需用，撥款由鄂廠代造，則隨時收回價本，即可推廣多造。

translations.literal: When the various provinces needed supplies in future, funds could be allocated for the Hubei plant to manufacture on their behalf; principal could then be recovered at any time, and expanded production could proceed.
translations.idiomatic: When other provinces needed arms, they could pay the Hubei plant to manufacture on contract, recover costs as work was delivered, and thus expand production.

sentences.zh: 此次鄂省新設槍砲廠所造各械，皆系南北洋、廣東、山東、四川等省製造局所無者。

translations.literal: The various weapons to be made at this newly established Hubei rifle and cannon plant were all items that the manufacturing bureaus of the Northern and Southern Ocean regions, Guangdong, Shandong, Sichuan, and other provinces did not produce.
translations.idiomatic: The weapons the new Hubei plant would make were items none of the arsenals in the Northern and Southern Ocean regions, Guangdong, Shandong, Sichuan, or elsewhere yet produced.

sentences.zh: 至鄂廠所造克魯伯各種車砲，尤為邊防海防及陸道戰守必不可少之利器。

translations.literal: As for the various Krupp carriage guns to be made at the Hubei plant, they were especially indispensable weapons for frontier defense, coastal defense, and fighting and holding on land routes.
translations.idiomatic: Above all, the Krupp carriage guns the Hubei plant would build were indispensable for frontier defense, coastal defense, and land warfare.

sentences.zh: 前大學士左宗棠曾言購械外洋，以銀易鐵，實為非計，一旦有警，敵船封口，受制於人，運購均無從下手。

translations.literal: Former Grand Secretary Zuo Zongtang had once said that purchasing weapons abroad, exchanging silver for iron, was truly no good plan; once an emergency arose, enemy ships blockaded the ports, one fell under another's control, and transport and procurement could not be begun at all.
translations.idiomatic: Former Grand Secretary Zuo Zongtang had warned that buying arms abroad—trading silver for iron—was a poor strategy: in a crisis, with enemy ships blockading the coast, the country would be at another's mercy and unable to procure or transport supplies.

sentences.zh: 況陸續遠購之器，種式既殊，彈碼亦異，每至誤事。

translations.literal: Moreover, weapons purchased in succession from afar differed in type, and their ammunition calibers also differed, often leading to mishaps.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, arms bought piecemeal from abroad varied in type and caliber, often causing confusion in the field.

sentences.zh: 懲前毖後，則建廠自造，乃未雨綢繆之計也。」

translations.literal: Learning from past mistakes and guarding against future ones, building plants for self-manufacture was therefore a plan made before rain—a precaution taken in advance."
translations.idiomatic: Learning from past mistakes, building domestic factories was the prudent course."

sentences.zh: 是年，兵工廠成。

translations.literal: That year, the ordnance factory was completed.
translations.idiomatic: That year the ordnance factory was completed.

sentences.zh: 十九年，直隸總督李鴻章、兩江總督劉坤一疏言：「上海機器局於光緒十五年，令道員劉麒祥辦理局務，專心創造新式槍砲，及自鍊鋼料。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, Zhili governor-general Li Hongzhang and Liangjiang governor-general Liu Kunyi memorialized: "At the Shanghai Machine Bureau, in the fifteenth year of Guangxu, Intendant Liu Qixiang was ordered to manage bureau affairs and concentrate on creating new-pattern rifles and cannon and refining steel on its own.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 19 (1893), Governor-General Li Hongzhang of Zhili and Governor-General Liu Kunyi of Liangjiang wrote: "In Guangxu 15 (1889) the Shanghai Machine Bureau put Intendant Liu Qixiang in charge and set him to developing new rifles and cannon and refining steel locally.

sentences.zh: 外洋新出利器，不肯以秘法示人。

translations.literal: New weapons recently produced abroad would not reveal their secret methods to others.
translations.idiomatic: Foreign makers of the latest weapons would not share their secrets.

sentences.zh: 其機括靈巧，猝難臆測。

translations.literal: Their mechanisms were ingenious and could not quickly be guessed.
translations.idiomatic: Their mechanisms were ingenious and hard to reverse-engineer at a glance.

sentences.zh: 開辦之始，幾無端緒可尋。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the undertaking, there was almost no thread to follow.
translations.idiomatic: At the outset there was almost no clear path forward.

sentences.zh: 乃精選洋匠，博訪窮探，考索成式，參以心得，造成試驗之，有稍不如法者，拆改重造。

translations.literal: Foreign artisans were carefully selected, inquiries were pursued exhaustively, established patterns were investigated, personal insights were added, prototypes were made and tested, and anything slightly not up to standard was dismantled, altered, and rebuilt.
translations.idiomatic: They selected skilled foreign artisans, investigated thoroughly, studied existing models, added their own insights, built prototypes for testing, and dismantled and rebuilt anything that fell short.

sentences.zh: 於二年之內，盡群才之力，竟造成新式槍砲，並煉就鋼料，迭次考驗，與西洋所造一律精堅。」

translations.literal: Within two years, exhausting the combined talents of all, they actually produced new-pattern rifles and cannon and refined steel; repeated tests showed them uniformly as fine and solid as Western manufacture."
translations.idiomatic: Within two years, pooling every available talent, they produced new rifles and cannon and refined steel that repeated testing showed to be as fine and solid as Western manufacture."

sentences.zh: 湖廣總督張之洞疏言：「湖北新建煉鐵廠告成，開煉生鐵爐一座，已煉成生熟鐵具銅碾鐵軌鐵條，均有成效。

translations.literal: Governor-General Zhang Zhidong of Huguang memorialized: "Hubei's newly built iron-smelting plant was completed; one pig-iron furnace was opened, and pig iron, wrought iron, copper, rolled iron, rails, and iron bars had all been successfully smelted.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Zhang Zhidong of Huguang reported: "Hubei's new ironworks was complete. One pig-iron furnace was in operation, and pig iron, wrought iron, copper, rolled iron, rails, and iron bars had all been successfully produced.

sentences.zh: 其煉西門士鋼廠，開煉時極險，北洋、上海各爐，迭有炸裂堵塞之患。

translations.literal: Its Siemens-Martin steel plant was extremely dangerous when first opened; furnaces in the Northern Ocean region and Shanghai had repeatedly suffered explosions and blockages.
translations.idiomatic: Its Siemens-Martin steel plant was extremely hazardous at startup; furnaces in the Northern Ocean region and Shanghai had repeatedly exploded or clogged.

sentences.zh: 鄂省此項鋼爐，飭洋匠詳考火候，向來至速須六點餘鍾出鋼，今止三點餘鍾已能煉就鋼料，成色無異洋制，足以為造砲之用。

translations.literal: For this steel furnace in Hubei, foreign artisans were ordered to study the firing conditions in detail; formerly at fastest more than six hours were needed to tap steel, but now in a little over three hours steel could already be refined, its quality no different from foreign manufacture, sufficient for making cannon.
translations.idiomatic: Hubei's steel furnace, with foreign artisans studying firing conditions closely, now tapped steel in just over three hours instead of the six hours previously required; the quality matched foreign steel and was fit for cannon making.

sentences.zh: 砲廠亦即開工，即以煉出之鋼，試造六生的半及七八生的克魯伯陸路車砲。

translations.literal: The cannon plant also began work at once, using the steel just refined to trial-manufacture Krupp field carriage guns of six and a half and seven or eight centimeters.
translations.idiomatic: The cannon works also began operations, trial-building Krupp field guns of 6.5 and 7 or 8 centimeter caliber from the newly refined steel.

sentences.zh: 若能鋼料精堅，演放有準，即可造十二生的大砲。

translations.literal: If the steel proved fine and solid and test firings were accurate, twelve-centimeter heavy guns could then be made.
translations.idiomatic: If the steel proved sound and test firings accurate, 12-centimeter heavy guns could follow.

sentences.zh: 以軍需孔急，飭工匠多煉西門士鋼，及貝色麻鋼，為製造槍砲之用。

translations.literal: Because military needs were urgently pressing, artisans were ordered to smelt more Siemens-Martin steel and Bessemer steel for manufacturing rifles and cannon.
translations.idiomatic: With military demand urgent, workers were ordered to produce more Siemens-Martin and Bessemer steel for rifle and cannon manufacture.

sentences.zh: 外洋陸戰，全恃連珠快砲，僅有後膛槍砲，不足以盡之，鄂廠添購制快砲機器，尤為利用也。

translations.literal: In foreign land warfare, everything depended on repeater quick-firing guns; breech-loading rifles and cannon alone were not enough to cover all needs; adding machinery at the Hubei plant for making quick-firing guns was especially advantageous.
translations.idiomatic: Modern land warfare depended on repeater quick-firing guns; breech-loading rifles and cannon alone were not enough, so adding quick-firing gun machinery at the Hubei plant was especially valuable.

sentences.zh: 煉鐵廠之鐵路運道，及洋匠華工，原為二爐之用。

translations.literal: The railway transport lines at the iron-smelting plant, and the foreign artisans and Chinese workers, had originally been planned for two furnaces.
translations.idiomatic: The ironworks railway and its foreign and Chinese workers had originally been planned for two furnaces.

sentences.zh: 今止一爐，每年只能出鐵一萬五千餘頓，折虧甚鉅。

translations.literal: Now with only one furnace, only a little more than fifteen thousand tons of iron could be produced each year, and the losses were very great.
translations.idiomatic: With only one furnace running, annual output was just over 15,000 tons, and losses were heavy.

sentences.zh: 馬鞍山煤井焦炭爐完工在即，擬以湖南省所出白煤和攙焦炭冶鍊，勉供二爐之用，始足以資周轉。」

translations.literal: The Ma'anshan coal mine and coke ovens were nearing completion; it was planned to mix the white coal produced in Hunan with coke for smelting, barely supplying two furnaces, so that operations could become self-sustaining."
translations.idiomatic: With the Ma'anshan coal mine and coke ovens nearly complete, Hunan anthracite would be mixed with coke to keep two furnaces running and make the operation viable."

translations.literal: (closing quotation mark in the source.)
translations.idiomatic: (closing quotation mark in the source.)

sentences.zh: 二十年，總理衙門王大臣疏言：「軍務緊急，以趕造軍火為先務，而經費有限。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, princes and ministers of the Zongli Yamen memorialized: "Military affairs were urgent; rushing the manufacture of ordnance was the first priority, yet funds were limited.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 20 (1894), the princes and ministers of the Zongli Yamen wrote: "With military affairs urgent, rushing ordnance production was the top priority, but funds were limited.

sentences.zh: 以之購買外洋軍火則不足，且多須時日，以之就各省現有局廠加工製造，則軍火可倍而出之。

translations.literal: Used to purchase foreign ordnance, the funds were insufficient, and much time would also be required; used to intensify manufacture at existing bureaus and plants in the various provinces, ordnance could be turned out at double the rate.
translations.idiomatic: That sum was too small to buy arms abroad and would take too long; applied to intensified production at existing provincial arsenals, ordnance output could be doubled.

sentences.zh: 前由戶部撥款，在吉林設立機器局，專供吉林、黑龍江二省常年操防之用。

translations.literal: Funds had previously been allocated by the Board of Revenue to establish a machine bureau in Jilin, devoted solely to the regular drill and defense needs of Jilin and Heilongjiang provinces.
translations.idiomatic: The Board of Revenue had previously funded a machine bureau in Jilin to supply the regular drill and defense needs of Jilin and Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 請飭吉林機器局加添工料，增造軍火，以應急需。」

translations.literal: He requested that the Jilin machine bureau be ordered to add materials and labor and increase ordnance production to meet urgent need."
translations.idiomatic: He asked that the Jilin machine bureau be ordered to add materials and labor and step up ordnance production to meet urgent demand."

sentences.zh: 湖廣總督張之洞疏言：「湖北新設之漢陽鐵廠，先開生鐵大爐一座，日夜出鐵八次，共五十餘頓，以後日見進步，有每日出六七十頓者。

translations.literal: Governor-General Zhang Zhidong of Huguang memorialized: "At Hubei's newly established Hanyang ironworks, one large pig-iron furnace was first opened, tapping iron eight times day and night for more than fifty tons in all; afterward progress was seen daily, with some days producing sixty or seventy tons.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Zhang Zhidong of Huguang reported: "At Hubei's new Hanyang ironworks, one large pig-iron furnace was tapping eight times around the clock for more than fifty tons a day; output was improving daily, with some days reaching sixty or seventy tons.

sentences.zh: 其次乃煉熟鐵、煉貝色麻鋼、碾鐵條、制鋼軌以及錘鍊烘壓各法，一時並舉。

translations.literal: Next, refining wrought iron, refining Bessemer steel, rolling iron bars, making steel rails, and hammering, refining, baking, and pressing by various methods were all undertaken at once.
translations.idiomatic: Wrought-iron refining, Bessemer steel production, bar rolling, rail making, and hammering, refining, baking, and pressing were all launched at once.

sentences.zh: 所出之鐵，雖系初煉，已與外洋相較，無甚軒輊。

translations.literal: Although the iron produced was from initial smelting, compared with foreign iron there was not much difference in quality.
translations.idiomatic: Even as first-run output, the iron compared favorably with foreign product.

sentences.zh: 現在江夏馬鞍山煤井所出之煤，可作焦炭，合於煉鐵之用，已開橫穴煤巷，現擬進掘三層橫穴。

translations.literal: Coal now produced at the Ma'anshan coal mine in Jiangxia could be made into coke suitable for iron smelting; horizontal coal tunnels had been opened, and three levels of horizontal tunnels were now planned for advance digging.
translations.idiomatic: Coal from the Ma'anshan mine in Jiangxia could be coked for iron smelting; horizontal tunnels had been opened, and three more levels were planned.

sentences.zh: 外洋之大洗煤機及運煤之鐵掛線路，均已次第竣工。

translations.literal: The large foreign-style coal-washing machines and the iron cable railway for transporting coal had all been completed in sequence.
translations.idiomatic: Large foreign-style coal washers and the iron cable railway for hauling coal had been completed in turn.

sentences.zh: 洋式焦炭爐十座，年內當可一律告成，足敷生鐵一爐及各廠鍊鋼之用。

translations.literal: Ten foreign-style coke ovens would all be completed within the year, enough to supply one pig-iron furnace and the steel refining of the various plants.
translations.idiomatic: Ten foreign-style coke ovens would all be finished within the year, enough to supply one pig-iron furnace and the steelworks.

sentences.zh: 參以湖南所產白煤油煤，即可二爐齊開。」

translations.literal: Combined with the white coal and lamp coal produced in Hunan, both furnaces could then be opened together."
translations.idiomatic: Combined with Hunan anthracite, both furnaces could then run together."

sentences.zh: 此制造鋼鐵已有成效之情形也。

translations.literal: Such was the situation in which steel and iron manufacture had already shown results.
translations.idiomatic: Such was the progress already achieved in steel and iron manufacture.

sentences.zh: 又疏言：「鐵廠之設，實兼採鐵、鍊鋼、採煤三大端為一事。

translations.literal: He further memorialized: "The establishment of the ironworks in fact combined three major undertakings—iron mining, steel refining, and coal mining—as one enterprise.
translations.idiomatic: He further reported: "The ironworks combined three major undertakings—iron mining, steel refining, and coal mining—in one enterprise.

sentences.zh: 而開煤所費，幾與煉鐵相等，本難併入造廠煉鐵計算。

translations.literal: Yet the expense of opening coal mines was nearly equal to iron smelting itself and could hardly be folded into the calculation for building the plant and smelting iron.
translations.idiomatic: But opening coal mines cost nearly as much as smelting itself and could hardly be folded into the factory construction budget.

sentences.zh: 開平煤礦，費至二百萬，始克成功。

translations.literal: The Kaiping coal mine had cost as much as two million before success was achieved.
translations.idiomatic: The Kaiping coal mine had cost two million taels before it succeeded.

sentences.zh: 今鐵廠自經始至觀成，用款繁鉅，所有奏明撥用之款，早經用罄，雖以槍砲經費勻撥，不敷仍多。

translations.literal: From its beginning to completion, the ironworks had required vast sums; all funds approved and allocated had long been exhausted, and even with rifle and cannon appropriations spread over to cover the gap, the shortfall remained large.
translations.idiomatic: From groundbreaking to completion, the ironworks had consumed vast sums; approved allocations were long exhausted, and even shifting rifle and cannon funds left a large shortfall.

sentences.zh: 非原估續估之多疏漏，實因開煉以後經費，與造廠工程本系二事，必須先行籌墊一年。

translations.literal: This was not because the original and follow-up estimates had many omissions; it was because post-smelting operating expenses and plant construction were fundamentally two separate matters, and one year's advance funding had to be raised first.
translations.idiomatic: This was not mainly faulty estimating; operating costs after smelting began were separate from construction costs, and a year's operating budget had to be raised in advance.

sentences.zh: 且事皆創舉，機局變更無常，隨時補救，增出用款，多在洋匠原擬之外，非預料所及。

translations.literal: Moreover, everything was newly undertaken; machine arrangements changed constantly, remedies had to be applied at any time, and added expenses mostly lay beyond what the foreign artisans had originally planned—beyond what could be foreseen.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, everything was new; equipment arrangements changed constantly, repairs were needed on the fly, and added costs mostly exceeded what foreign engineers had originally planned.

sentences.zh: 其增出之款，除零星雜費數十項不計外，舉其重大者數端：一、增購機爐工料，如增置十五頓大汽錘一具，增貝色麻大壓汽機一副，增造西門士爐底火泥管及造火磚機器，增改生鐵大爐架一座，爐內用磚，令與礦煤之性相合，增生鐵廠內之鐵瓦敞棚，增中西兩式洗煤機，增內地火磚焦炭爐，增鋪地鐵板，增廠內運物鐵路，增運礦煤鐵車，增爐上鐵蓋，爐外水池水溝，及四周之保險門，增銅鐵管及水箱，增化驗煤鐵大小各項器具材料，以及汽表風表水表，皆為精細貴重之件。

translations.literal: Among the added funds, aside from dozens of miscellaneous minor expenses not counted, several major items may be cited: first, added purchase of machinery, furnaces, and materials, such as adding one fifteen-ton large steam hammer, one added Bessemer large compression steam engine, added manufacture of Siemens-Martin furnace-bottom fire-clay pipes and fire-brick machinery, added alteration of one large pig-iron furnace frame, furnace bricks made to match the nature of the ore and coal, added iron-roof open sheds within the pig-iron plant, added Chinese and Western coal-washing machines, added domestic fire-brick coke ovens, added floor iron plates, added in-plant freight railways, added iron ore and coal transport cars, added iron covers on the furnaces, pools and ditches outside the furnaces, and safety doors on all sides, added copper and iron pipes and water tanks, added large and small instruments and materials for testing coal and iron, and steam, air, and water gauges—all finely made and costly items.
translations.idiomatic: Among added costs, aside from dozens of minor items, the major ones included: first, additional machinery and materials—a fifteen-ton steam hammer, a Bessemer compression steam engine, Siemens-Martin furnace fire-clay pipes and brick-making machinery, reconstruction of a pig-iron furnace frame with bricks matched to the ore and coal, iron-roofed open sheds, Chinese and Western coal washers, domestic fire-brick coke ovens, floor plates, in-plant freight railways, ore and coal cars, furnace covers, cooling pools and ditches, safety doors, copper and iron pipes and water tanks, coal and iron testing equipment, and steam, air, and water gauges—all precision items of considerable cost.

sentences.zh: 一、增募開煉洋匠，原擬僱用八人，其餘僱用熟手之華匠百餘人應用。

translations.literal: Second, added recruitment of foreign artisans for smelting operations: eight had originally been planned for hire, with the remainder to be more than one hundred skilled Chinese artisans.
translations.idiomatic: Second, additional foreign smelting specialists: eight had originally been planned, with the rest to be more than one hundred skilled Chinese workers.

sentences.zh: 開煉之事，以生鐵大爐為重，中國向未煉過。

translations.literal: In opening smelting operations, the large pig-iron furnace was the crucial point; China had never smelted in this way before.
translations.idiomatic: Smelting turned on the large pig-iron furnace, a process China had never undertaken before.

sentences.zh: 若欲選用華匠，非有極聰明之人在廠精練多年，難與此選。

translations.literal: If one wished to select Chinese artisans, without extremely intelligent persons training diligently in the plant for many years, they would be hard to choose for this work.
translations.idiomatic: To rely on Chinese workers, one would need exceptionally able men training in the plant for years before they could fill these roles.

sentences.zh: 即鍊鋼各廠，亦非得專門名家之洋匠領首作工不可。

translations.literal: Even the various steel-refining plants could not do without foreign master artisans of specialized expertise leading the work.
translations.idiomatic: Even the steelworks required foreign specialists to lead operations.

sentences.zh: 若手法稍不中程度，即致變生意外，危險之至。

translations.literal: If methods fell even slightly short of the required standard, accidents would occur—extremely dangerous.
translations.idiomatic: The slightest deviation from proper technique could cause accidents—extremely dangerous work.

sentences.zh: 現募到洋匠二十八人，均萬不可少，較原估八人多出二倍餘。

translations.literal: Twenty-eight foreign artisans had now been recruited, every one indispensable—more than double the eight originally estimated.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-eight foreign artisans had been hired, every one indispensable—more than double the eight originally planned.

sentences.zh: 一、添補不全機器，外洋運到之機件，沿途損缺頗多。

translations.literal: Third, replacement of incomplete machinery: many machine parts shipped from abroad had been damaged or lost along the way.
translations.idiomatic: Third, replacing damaged machinery: many parts shipped from abroad had been damaged or lost in transit.

sentences.zh: 其簡便者，由漢陽本廠自行修補二千餘件外，其重大精細機器，必須由外洋或上海洋行重行購補。

translations.literal: Aside from more than two thousand simpler items repaired by the Hanyang plant itself, major precision machinery had to be repurchased from abroad or from foreign firms in Shanghai.
translations.idiomatic: Aside from more than 2,000 simpler parts repaired at Hanyang itself, major precision machinery had to be reordered from abroad or from foreign firms in Shanghai.

sentences.zh: 或此種不甚靈動，則洋匠必另購一機以救之。

translations.literal: If a given type was not sufficiently responsive, the foreign artisans would necessarily purchase another machine to remedy it.
translations.idiomatic: If a machine type underperformed, the foreign engineers would buy another to fix the problem.

sentences.zh: 或此式之爐，試煉焦炭不淨，或舊法所采之礦不多，則洋匠又思一法以損益之。

translations.literal: If furnaces of this design produced impure coke in trial smelting, or ore obtained by the old method was insufficient, the foreign artisans would devise another method to adjust and improve matters.
translations.idiomatic: If a furnace of this design yielded impure coke in trials, or ore from the old mining method ran short, the foreign engineers would work out another fix.

sentences.zh: 曠日加工，致多糜費。

translations.literal: Days and months were spent in added work, leading to much waste.
translations.idiomatic: Work dragged on for days and months, wasting large sums.

sentences.zh: 一、外洋金鎊值價日昂，比初定機器時，價高過半。
