translations.literal: Fourth, foreign gold pounds rose in price daily; compared with when machinery was first ordered, prices were more than half again as high.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth, foreign sterling rose steadily; compared with the original machinery orders, prices were more than fifty percent higher.

sentences.zh: 而改換機器，訪訂洋匠等事，日積月累，亦成鉅款。

translations.literal: Replacing machinery, hiring foreign artisans, and the like accumulated day by day and month by month, also becoming a large sum.
translations.idiomatic: Replacing machinery, hiring foreign specialists, and the like piled up month after month into another major expense.

sentences.zh: 一、多用煤斤，凡鐵山煤礦，開採轉運，以及鐵廠起重運料、試鑽開井、抽水壓氣，無在不需機器，即無日不用煤斤，為數甚鉅。

translations.literal: Fifth, coal was used in great quantity: iron-mountain coal mines, mining and transport, and at the ironworks hoisting and moving materials, trial drilling and shaft opening, pumping and compressed air—all required machinery, and no day passed without coal; the amounts were very large.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth, coal consumption was enormous: mining and hauling at the iron hills, hoisting and moving materials at the works, trial drilling, shaft sinking, pumping, and compressed air—all required machinery and coal every day, in very large amounts.

sentences.zh: 又生鐵大爐，購用外洋焦炭，試煉兩月，費亦不貲。

translations.literal: Moreover, the large pig-iron furnace purchased foreign coke for trial smelting over two months, at no small expense.
translations.idiomatic: The large pig-iron furnace also bought foreign coke for two months of trial smelting, at considerable cost.

sentences.zh: 各款皆原估所難周悉，加以煤井開至數十丈，已費盡人工機器之力，而煤層忽脫節中斷。

translations.literal: All these items were hard to cover fully in the original estimate; moreover, when coal shafts had been sunk dozens of feet and human labor and machinery had been exhausted, the coal seam would suddenly fault and break off.
translations.idiomatic: None of these costs could be fully covered in the original estimate; coal shafts might be sunk dozens of feet at great labor and machinery expense, only for the seam to fault and break off abruptly.

sentences.zh: 外洋辦法，必仍就原處追尋，另行開井。

translations.literal: The foreign practice was necessarily to trace further from the original spot and open a new shaft elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: Foreign practice was to keep tracing from the original spot and open a new shaft elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 而重開一井，非鉅款不辦。

translations.literal: But reopening a shaft could not be done without a large sum.
translations.idiomatic: Opening a new shaft required a large outlay.

sentences.zh: 現實無此財力。

translations.literal: At present there was in truth no such financial capacity.
translations.idiomatic: At present there was no money for that.

sentences.zh: 若非馬鞍山煤井有成，則全恃湘煤，所費更鉅。

translations.literal: Had the Ma'anshan coal mine not succeeded, one would rely entirely on Hunan coal, at even greater expense.
translations.idiomatic: Without success at the Ma'anshan coal mine, the works would depend entirely on Hunan coal, at even greater cost.

sentences.zh: 此則時局變遷，多費用款，初非意料所及。

translations.literal: These were changes in the times, with added expenditures, not foreseen at the outset.
translations.idiomatic: These were changes in circumstances and added costs no one had foreseen.

sentences.zh: 前曾督飭局員及洋匠礦師，續估用款，以為能銷貨周轉，不致再有增加之款。

translations.literal: Previously he had supervised and ordered bureau staff, foreign artisans, and mining engineers to prepare a follow-up estimate of funds, believing that sales could sustain turnover and no further increases would be needed.
translations.idiomatic: He had previously ordered bureau staff, foreign engineers, and mining specialists to revise the budget, expecting sales to sustain operations without further increases.

sentences.zh: 乃移步換形，層折過多，加工遂致加料，費日因以費工，不特非局員所能限定，並非洋匠所能預知，多方補救，繁費滋多。

translations.literal: Yet as circumstances shifted step by step and complications multiplied layer upon layer, added processing led to added materials, and lost days meant lost labor; this was not something bureau staff could limit, nor something foreign artisans could foresee; remedies applied on many fronts only multiplied costs further.
translations.idiomatic: But circumstances kept shifting and complications piled up; extra processing meant extra materials, and lost time meant lost labor. Bureau staff could not cap it, foreign engineers could not foresee it, and every remedy added more expense.

sentences.zh: 今撥借各款，所餘無幾，若行銷挹注，必俟兩爐齊開，一年以後，始能流通周轉。

translations.literal: Now of the various allocated and borrowed funds little remained; if sales were to replenish operations, one had to wait until both furnaces were running together, and only after a year could circulation and turnover begin.
translations.idiomatic: Allocated and borrowed funds were nearly exhausted; sales could replenish operations only after both furnaces were running together for a year.

sentences.zh: 尤須鋼鐵各料，胥臻精美，合於製造之用，方可期流通無滯。

translations.literal: Steel and iron materials above all had to reach fine quality suited to manufacturing use before one could expect unimpeded sales.
translations.idiomatic: Steel and iron stock above all had to reach fine quality suited to manufacturing before sales could flow smoothly.

sentences.zh: 至暢銷後，尤防洋鐵有減價奪售之患。

translations.literal: Even after sales flourished, one had especially to guard against the threat of foreign iron underselling and seizing the market.
translations.idiomatic: Even after sales picked up, foreign iron underselling remained a serious threat.

sentences.zh: 此開煉之初，必須寬籌經費，庶不致停爐待款。

translations.literal: At the outset of smelting operations, funds had to be generously provided so the furnaces would not sit idle awaiting money.
translations.idiomatic: Smelting required generous funding at the start so furnaces would not sit idle for lack of cash.

sentences.zh: 原擬就槍砲廠經費挹注，無如槍砲廠增設砲彈、槍彈、砲架三廠，計機器運費等，已需銀三十萬兩，建廠之費，尚不在內，勢不能全行撥用。

translations.literal: It had originally been planned to draw from the rifle-and-cannon factory budget, but that factory had added three plants for shells, cartridges, and gun carriages; machinery and shipping alone already required three hundred thousand taels, construction costs not included—clearly the whole sum could not be diverted.
translations.idiomatic: The plan had been to draw on the rifle-and-cannon factory budget, but that factory had added shell, cartridge, and gun-carriage plants; machinery and freight alone already required 300,000 taels, not counting construction—clearly the full amount could not be diverted.

sentences.zh: 值此廠工已竣，煉鐵已成之際，所欠者僅此籌墊之款。

translations.literal: At this moment when plant construction was finished and iron smelting had succeeded, only this advance funding remained lacking.
translations.idiomatic: With construction finished and iron smelting under way, only this advance funding was still lacking.

sentences.zh: 若鎔鋼煉鐵，因此停工，則製造槍砲，何所取資？

translations.literal: If steel melting and iron smelting halted for this reason, where would rifle and cannon manufacture draw its resources?
translations.idiomatic: If steelmaking and iron smelting stopped for lack of funds, where would arms production get its materials?

sentences.zh: 當海防緊急之秋，而軍械缺乏，貽誤戎機，關係匪淺。

translations.literal: At a time of urgent coastal defense, with military stores deficient, missing the moment for action—the consequences would be far from slight.
translations.idiomatic: With coastal defense urgent and ordnance scarce, missing the moment for action would have serious consequences.

sentences.zh: 今各省財力，自顧不遑，豈能協助。

translations.literal: Today the finances of each province barely sufficed for their own needs; how could they assist?
translations.idiomatic: Provincial finances could barely cover local needs; assistance from other provinces was out of the question.

sentences.zh: 惟有就湖北本省各款，竭力勻撥周轉，機爐勿使停工，軍實得資接濟，庶不致功虧一簣也。」

translations.literal: One could only do one's utmost to apportion and turn over funds within Hubei itself, keep the furnaces and machinery from stopping, and supply military stores—so as not to see the work fail within sight of completion."
translations.idiomatic: Hubei could only do its utmost to apportion local funds, keep furnaces and machinery running, and supply military stores—so the work would not fail within sight of completion."

translations.literal: (closing quotation mark in the source.)
translations.idiomatic: (closing quotation mark in the source.)

sentences.zh: 又疏言：「前因開鍊鋼鐵為造械之本，以槍砲廠經費勻撥濟用，而槍砲廠更形支絀。

translations.literal: He memorialized again: "Previously, because refining steel and iron formed the foundation of arms manufacture, rifle-and-cannon factory funds were evenly allocated to assist the ironworks, leaving the rifle-and-cannon factory still more strained.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized again: "Because refining steel and iron was the foundation of arms manufacture, rifle-and-cannon factory funds had been evenly allocated to support the ironworks, leaving that factory still more strained.

sentences.zh: 前辦海防所購軍械，每槍式參差，彈碼互異，及舊槍攙雜，藥彈潮濕，流弊滋多。

translations.literal: Ordinance purchased in earlier coastal-defense preparations mixed every rifle pattern, with incompatible ammunition; old rifles were intermingled and powder and cartridges damp—abuses multiplied.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier coastal-defense purchases mixed rifle patterns and incompatible ammunition; old rifles were intermingled and powder and cartridges were damp—problems multiplied.

sentences.zh: 故砲架、砲彈、槍彈三廠之設，萬不可緩。

translations.literal: Hence establishing the three plants for gun carriages, artillery shells, and rifle cartridges could not be delayed.
translations.idiomatic: Establishing plants for gun carriages, artillery shells, and rifle cartridges could not wait.

sentences.zh: 今竭力籌款，先將砲架、砲彈機器，於十八年夏間，在德國力拂廠購定制造水陸行營各種砲架機器全副，每年能成六七生的至十二生的砲架砲車一百副。

translations.literal: They had now strained every effort to raise funds and first ordered carriage and shell machinery—in the summer of the eighteenth year, at the Lifu works in Germany, a complete set of machinery for making various carriages and gun mounts for field, naval, and camp use, able to turn out one hundred sets of carriages and gun carts of six to seven centimeter through twelve centimeter caliber each year.
translations.idiomatic: They had now strained every effort to raise funds and first ordered carriage and shell machinery—in the summer of Guangxu 18 (1892), at the Lifu works in Germany, a complete set for making field, naval, and camp gun carriages and mounts, able to turn out one hundred carriage-and-limber sets from 6 to 7 through 12 centimeter caliber each year.

sentences.zh: 購定制造克魯伯砲彈機器一副，每日能成六七生的至十二生的砲彈一百顆。

translations.literal: They ordered one set of Krupp shell-making machinery, able to produce one hundred shells of six to seven through twelve centimeter caliber each day.
translations.idiomatic: They ordered one Krupp shell-making set able to produce one hundred shells of 6 to 7 through 12 centimeter caliber each day.

sentences.zh: 其他開花彈、實心彈、群子彈、子母彈，均能自造。

translations.literal: Exploding shells, solid shot, case shot, and shrapnel could all be made on site.
translations.idiomatic: Exploding shells, solid shot, case shot, and shrapnel could all be made locally.

sentences.zh: 又購定小口徑槍彈機器一副，每日可成槍彈二萬五千顆，造銅板、造鉛條、裝藥入彈、修理器具俱全，共用銀三十萬兩有奇。

translations.literal: They also ordered one small-caliber cartridge machine set, able to produce twenty-five thousand cartridges daily, with complete equipment for making cupro-nickel sheet, lead wire, loading charges, and repairs—totaling somewhat more than three hundred thousand taels.
translations.idiomatic: They also ordered one small-caliber cartridge set able to produce twenty-five thousand rounds daily, with complete equipment for sheet brass, lead wire, loading, and repairs—totaling somewhat more than 300,000 taels.

sentences.zh: 又添廠屋、大小鐵梁、鐵地板、水泥、火磚各種建築工程，三廠合計共用銀十五萬八千兩。

translations.literal: Added plant buildings, iron beams large and small, iron flooring, cement, firebrick, and other construction—the three plants together cost one hundred fifty-eight thousand taels.
translations.idiomatic: Added plant buildings, iron beams, iron flooring, cement, firebrick, and other construction—the three plants together cost 158,000 taels.

sentences.zh: 近日外洋快砲益精，即兵船八十磅至百磅之大砲，亦用機器造成。

translations.literal: Recently foreign quick-firing guns had grown ever more refined; even the great guns of eighty to one hundred pounds on warships were now machine-made.
translations.idiomatic: Foreign quick-firing guns had grown ever more refined; even warship guns of eighty to one hundred pounds were now machine-made.

sentences.zh: 鄂廠本系製造新式連珠槍，若能兼造快砲，于軍事尤多裨益。

translations.literal: The Hubei plant was already built to make new-style repeater rifles; if it could also make quick-firing guns, military benefit would be all the greater.
translations.idiomatic: The Hubei plant already made new-style repeater rifles; adding quick-firing guns would help the military even more.

sentences.zh: 已電詢洋廠，增購新式快砲機器及砲管各件，共價銀三萬兩有奇。

translations.literal: They had already telegraphed foreign factories to add new quick-firing gun machinery and barrel parts, at somewhat more than thirty thousand taels in all.
translations.idiomatic: They had already telegraphed foreign firms to add new quick-firing gun machinery and barrel parts, at somewhat more than 30,000 taels.

sentences.zh: 其廠仍舊，俟機器到齊，即可改制，較之另起廠屋，所省經費實多。

translations.literal: The existing plant would remain; once machinery arrived it could be converted—far less costly than building anew.
translations.idiomatic: The existing plant would remain; once machinery arrived it could be converted—far cheaper than building anew.

sentences.zh: 此種快砲六生的者，每分鐘可放三十齣，九生的者，每分鐘可放二十餘出，洵為制勝之具也。」

translations.literal: Quick-firing guns of this type: six-centimeter pieces could fire thirty rounds per minute; nine-centimeter pieces, more than twenty rounds per minute—truly decisive weapons."
translations.idiomatic: Quick-firing guns of this type could fire thirty rounds per minute in 6 centimeter caliber and more than twenty in 9 centimeter caliber—truly decisive weapons."

sentences.zh: 是年，陝西巡撫鹿傳霖疏請以甘肅省舊存製造軍火機器全具，運至陝西省城，試造槍砲子藥。

translations.literal: That year, Shaanxi Governor Lu Chuanlin memorialized requesting that the complete set of old ordnance-making machinery stored in Gansu be transported to the Shaanxi provincial capital for trial manufacture of rifles, cannon, and ammunition.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Shaanxi Governor Lu Chuanlin asked that Gansu's complete set of old ordnance-making machinery be moved to the Shaanxi provincial capital to trial-build rifles, cannon, and ammunition.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，奉天增練新軍，將軍依克唐阿遣員在山東、吉林、奉天、遼陽等處，製造銅鐵等各項砲位，華、洋各式步槍，以及砲車砲架，併購製造子彈、碾火藥、造地雷器具，暨刀矛等件，在正餉動支。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, Fengtian expanded drilling of the new army; General Yiketang'a dispatched men to Shandong, Jilin, Fengtian, Liaoyang, and elsewhere to manufacture copper and iron artillery pieces, Chinese and foreign-pattern infantry rifles, gun carriages and mounts, and also purchase machinery for cartridges, powder grinding, land mines, as well as spears and halberds—all charged to regular pay funds.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 21 (1895), Fengtian expanded drilling of the new army; General Yiketang'a sent men to Shandong, Jilin, Fengtian, Liaoyang, and elsewhere to build copper and iron artillery, Chinese and foreign-pattern rifles, gun carriages and mounts, and to purchase machinery for cartridges, powder grinding, and land mines, along with spears and halberds—all charged to regular pay funds.

sentences.zh: 山東巡撫李秉衡以山東省自設立槍砲機器局後，供給各路軍火，逐年增加製造，請增常年經費。

translations.literal: Shandong Governor Li Bingheng reported that since Shandong had established its rifle-and-cannon machine bureau, it had supplied ordnance to various routes and increased manufacture year by year; he requested added regular funding.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong Governor Li Bingheng reported that since Shandong's rifle-and-cannon machine bureau had been established, it had supplied ordnance to various routes with output rising each year, and he requested added regular funding.

sentences.zh: 兩江總督張之洞以前年任湖廣總督，創辦湖北漢陽煉鐵廠，及興國州、馬鞍山二處採煤，以供煉鐵之用，著有成效，請優獎在事人員。

translations.literal: Governor-General Zhang Zhidong of the Two Jiangs reported that in his former post as Governor-General of Huguang he had founded the Hanyang ironworks in Hubei and coal mining at Xingguo Prefecture and Ma'anshan to supply iron smelting, with notable results, and requested special rewards for those involved.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Zhang Zhidong of the Two Jiangs reported that as former Governor-General of Huguang he had founded the Hanyang ironworks and coal mines at Xingguo and Ma'anshan to supply smelting, with notable results, and asked that personnel involved receive special rewards.

sentences.zh: 陝西巡撫張汝梅以陝西省各軍所用里明、毛瑟、中針、後膛各式洋槍，皆由他省協撥，不盡合用。

translations.literal: Shaanxi Governor Zhang Rumei reported that the Remington, Mauser, Snider, and various breech-loading foreign rifles used by Shaanxi troops were all allocated from other provinces and not fully suitable.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi Governor Zhang Rumei reported that Remington, Mauser, Snider, and various breech-loading foreign rifles used by Shaanxi troops were all allocated from other provinces and not fully suitable.

sentences.zh: 咨商甘肅省撥舊存製造軍火之機器等件，運至陝西，即在省城設立機器局，試造槍砲子藥，隨時修理舊械。

translations.literal: He consulted Gansu to allocate the old stored ordnance-making machinery and transport it to Shaanxi, establishing a machine bureau in the provincial capital to trial-build rifles, cannon, and ammunition and repair old arms as needed.
translations.idiomatic: He consulted Gansu to transfer old stored ordnance-making machinery to Shaanxi, establish a machine bureau in the provincial capital to trial-build rifles, cannon, and ammunition, and repair old arms as needed.

sentences.zh: 兩江總督張之洞上言：「天津、江南、廣東、山東、四川原有制造局，所造軍需水陸應用各件頗多，而所成槍砲甚少。

translations.literal: Governor-General Zhang Zhidong memorialized: "Tianjin, Jiangnan, Guangdong, Shandong, and Sichuan had original manufacturing bureaus that produced many military supplies for land and sea use, yet comparatively few rifles and cannon.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Zhang Zhidong wrote: "Tianjin, Jiangnan, Guangdong, Shandong, and Sichuan already had manufacturing bureaus turning out many land and naval supplies, but relatively few rifles and cannon.

sentences.zh: 或止能造槍砲彈而不能造槍砲，或能造槍，而汽機局廠尚小，均宜量加擴充。

translations.literal: Some could make only rifle and cannon shells but not rifles and cannon; some could make rifles, but their steam-engine shops and plants were still small—all should be expanded as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Some could make shells but not guns; some could make rifles but their steam shops were still small—all should be expanded as appropriate.

sentences.zh: 福建船政局現有大鍋爐機器及打鐵各廠，並多諳悉機器員司工匠，若增置造槍砲機器，費省而工亦易集。

translations.literal: The Fujian Naval Yard now had large boiler machinery and iron-forging plants, with many skilled machine staff and artisans; if rifle-and-cannon machinery were added, costs would be saved and labor easily assembled.
translations.idiomatic: The Fujian Naval Yard already had large boiler machinery and forging shops, with many skilled staff and artisans; adding rifle-and-cannon machinery would save money and labor.

sentences.zh: 如奉天為根本重地，而道遠難於接濟，宜專設一廠。

translations.literal: Fengtian was a fundamental stronghold, yet distant and hard to supply; a dedicated plant should be established.
translations.idiomatic: Fengtian was a fundamental stronghold but distant and hard to supply; it should have a dedicated plant.

sentences.zh: 陝西為中原奧區，且可以接濟西路，亦宜專設一廠。

translations.literal: Shaanxi was a central region of the heartland and could also supply the western routes; a dedicated plant should likewise be established.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi lay in the heartland and could supply western routes; it too should have a dedicated plant.

sentences.zh: 至各廠製造，大率皆宜以小口徑快槍及行營快砲為主，或槍砲並造，或槍砲分造，宜每項擇定一式，各廠統歸一律，以免參差。

translations.literal: Manufacturing at the various plants should generally take small-caliber quick rifles and field quick-firing guns as the main products; whether rifles and cannon were made together or separately, one pattern should be chosen for each item and all plants unified to avoid inconsistency.
translations.idiomatic: Plants should generally focus on small-caliber quick rifles and field quick-firing guns; whether rifles and cannon were made together or separately, each item should have one standard pattern across all plants to avoid inconsistency.

sentences.zh: 腹省各局，只須陸路過山小砲，即足供陸戰之用。

translations.literal: Bureaus in interior provinces needed only mountain guns for land warfare.
translations.idiomatic: Interior province bureaus needed only mountain guns for land warfare.

sentences.zh: 若沿江沿海數局，並宜造船台大快砲，每廠每年至少須出快槍五六千枝，陸路、過山二種小快砲一百餘尊，方能濟用。

translations.literal: Bureaus along rivers and coasts should also build emplacement large quick-firing guns; each plant had to turn out at least five or six thousand quick rifles and more than one hundred field and mountain quick-firing guns each year to meet demand.
translations.idiomatic: River and coastal bureaus should also build emplacement large quick-firing guns; each plant needed at least five or six thousand quick rifles and more than one hundred field and mountain quick-firing guns per year to meet demand.

sentences.zh: 一面僱用洋匠，一面選派工匠赴外洋名廠學習，冀他日能擴充製造廠數處。

translations.literal: While hiring foreign artisans, craftsmen should also be selected and sent to famous foreign plants to learn, in hope of expanding the number of manufacturing plants in future.
translations.idiomatic: While hiring foreign specialists, craftsmen should also be sent to famous foreign plants to learn, in hope of expanding manufacturing capacity later.

sentences.zh: 惟各省局廠，上海、金陵二處雖各有制造局，而金陵局規模頗小，機器未備，所出槍砲無多。

translations.literal: Among provincial bureaus and plants, Shanghai and Jinling each had a manufacturing bureau, but the Jinling bureau was rather small, its machinery incomplete, and its rifle and cannon output limited.
translations.idiomatic: Among provincial plants, Shanghai and Jinling each had a manufacturing bureau, but Jinling was small, its machinery incomplete, and its arms output limited.

sentences.zh: 其設局之處，限於地勢，不能展拓，僅能擇行軍要需者酌增機器，究不能多。

translations.literal: The site was limited by terrain and could not be expanded; it could only selectively add machinery for essential field needs, and in the end could not produce much.
translations.idiomatic: Terrain limited the site and prevented expansion; it could add machinery only for essential field needs and could not produce much.

sentences.zh: 上海製造局雖較宏大，惟所造槍彈、砲彈、水雷、火藥及修理輪船等門類頗多，而不專一，並非專造快槍之機器，每月成槍不過百餘枝，亦無造陸路、過山二種快砲之機器。

translations.literal: The Shanghai Manufacturing Bureau was larger, but it produced cartridges, shells, torpedoes, powder, and ship repairs among many lines without specialization; it lacked dedicated quick-rifle machinery, turning out only a little more than one hundred rifles a month, and had no machinery for field and mountain quick-firing guns.
translations.idiomatic: The Shanghai Manufacturing Bureau was larger but spread across cartridges, shells, torpedoes, powder, and ship repair without specialization; it lacked dedicated quick-rifle machinery, made only a little over one hundred rifles a month, and had no machinery for field and mountain quick-firing guns.

sentences.zh: 至大砲則一年或出一、二尊不等。

translations.literal: Large cannon might be turned out once or twice a year, or not at all.
translations.idiomatic: Large cannon might appear once or twice a year, if at all.

sentences.zh: 且該局軍械，須運出吳淞江後，再轉入長江。

translations.literal: Moreover, that bureau's ordnance had to be moved out past the Wusong River before entering the Yangtze.
translations.idiomatic: That bureau's ordnance also had to cross the Wusong River before entering the Yangtze.

sentences.zh: 若有兵事，敵人以戰船封口，一切轉運，立即束手。

translations.literal: If war came and the enemy blockaded the river with warships, all transport would immediately be paralyzed.
translations.idiomatic: In war, if enemy warships blockaded the river, transport would stop immediately.

sentences.zh: 前此開局滬上，只圖取材便利，未能盡善。

translations.literal: Opening the bureau at Shanghai had been only for material convenience and could not be fully ideal.
translations.idiomatic: Opening the bureau at Shanghai had favored material convenience over strategic soundness.

sentences.zh: 故沿江內地，必須添設局廠。

translations.literal: Hence along the inland river routes additional bureaus and plants had to be established.
translations.idiomatic: Additional bureaus and plants were needed along inland river routes.

sentences.zh: 湖北槍砲廠，因上年槍廠被火後，改造鐵料廠屋，修補機器，甚費經營。

translations.literal: The Hubei rifle-and-cannon plant, after the rifle factory burned the previous year, had rebuilt the iron-material plant buildings and repaired machinery at great expense.
translations.idiomatic: After the Hubei rifle factory burned the previous year, the rifle-and-cannon plant rebuilt iron-material buildings and repaired machinery at great expense.

sentences.zh: 快砲所增新機，以工匠初試，未熟線路，猝難較准。

translations.literal: For the newly added quick-firing gun machinery, workers were on their first trials and unfamiliar with the wiring, making quick calibration difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Workers were still on first trials with the new quick-firing gun machinery and unfamiliar with the wiring, so calibration was slow.

sentences.zh: 今甫造快槍式樣數十枝，快砲式樣一尊，車砲二尊，均尚合用。

translations.literal: They had just produced several dozen sample quick rifles, one sample quick-firing gun, and two carriage guns—all still usable.
translations.idiomatic: They had just produced several dozen sample quick rifles, one sample quick-firing gun, and two carriage guns—all still usable.

sentences.zh: 以後所出，自可日多。

translations.literal: Output thereafter could increase day by day.
translations.idiomatic: Output should increase steadily thereafter.

sentences.zh: 惟槍機曾經火灼，敏速之力稍減。

translations.literal: But the rifle mechanisms had been scorched by fire, and their speed of operation was slightly reduced.
translations.idiomatic: But rifle mechanisms scorched in the fire had slightly reduced firing speed.

sentences.zh: 一年以內，人器相習，每年約計可造成快槍七八千枝，陸路、過山二種快砲百尊。

translations.literal: Within one year men and machines would adapt; each year the plant could turn out roughly seven or eight thousand quick rifles and one hundred field and mountain quick-firing guns.
translations.idiomatic: Within a year men and machines would adapt; annual output should reach roughly seven or eight thousand quick rifles and one hundred field and mountain quick-firing guns.

sentences.zh: 局廠地踞上游，最為穩固。

translations.literal: The bureau and plant stood upstream and were most secure.
translations.idiomatic: The plant stood upstream and was strategically secure.

sentences.zh: 上可接濟川、湘、陝、豫，下可接濟江、皖，轉運甚便。

translations.literal: Upstream it could supply Sichuan, Hunan, Shaanxi, and Henan; downstream Jiangsu and Anhui—transport was very convenient.
translations.idiomatic: Upstream it could supply Sichuan, Hunan, Shaanxi, and Henan; downstream Jiangsu and Anhui—transport was very convenient.

sentences.zh: 若在江南另行擇地建造，所費至鉅。

translations.literal: Building anew at a separate site in Jiangnan would cost an enormous sum.
translations.idiomatic: Building anew elsewhere in Jiangnan would cost enormously.

sentences.zh: 不如就湖北廠添購機器，廣為擴充，其鋼鐵即用鄂省鐵廠所煉。

translations.literal: It was better to add machinery at the Hubei plant and expand broadly, using steel refined at the Hubei ironworks.
translations.idiomatic: Better to expand the Hubei plant with added machinery and use steel from the provincial ironworks.

sentences.zh: 除鄂廠原造之數外，今每年能加出快槍一萬枝，無煙藥槍彈一千萬顆，陸路、過山二種快砲二百尊，砲彈二十萬顆。

translations.literal: Beyond the Hubei plant's original output, it could now add ten thousand quick rifles, ten million smokeless-powder cartridges, two hundred field and mountain quick-firing guns, and two hundred thousand shells each year.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond existing output, the plant could now add ten thousand quick rifles, ten million smokeless-powder cartridges, two hundred field and mountain quick-firing guns, and two hundred thousand shells each year.

sentences.zh: 湖北向無新式藥廠，擬並造無煙藥、棕色藥、黑藥，令足敷各種槍砲之用。

translations.literal: Hubei had previously had no modern powder plant; it was proposed also to make smokeless powder, brown powder, and black powder sufficient for all types of rifles and cannon.
translations.idiomatic: Hubei had no modern powder plant; it proposed also to make smokeless powder, brown powder, and black powder sufficient for all rifles and cannon.

sentences.zh: 合計槍砲架藥彈各項機器，與外洋名廠考較，諸從節省，凡運費造廠，約需銀二百萬兩。

translations.literal: Total machinery for rifles, cannon, carriages, powder, and shells, compared with famous foreign plants with economies applied, would require about two million taels for shipping and plant construction.
translations.idiomatic: Total machinery for rifles, cannon, carriages, powder, and shells—compared with famous foreign plants and with economies applied—would require about 2 million taels for shipping and construction.

sentences.zh: 又因湖北省鐵廠，開煤井，煉焦炭，煉各種精鋼、熟銅、熟鐵，正在緊要之際，槍砲廠則趕造五處廠屋，試造槍砲。

translations.literal: Moreover, the Hubei ironworks was opening coal shafts, refining coke, and refining various fine steels, wrought copper, and wrought iron at a critical juncture, while the rifle-and-cannon plant was rushing five plant buildings and trial-building rifles and cannon.
translations.idiomatic: The Hubei ironworks was opening coal shafts, refining coke, and producing fine steel, wrought copper, and wrought iron at a critical stage, while the rifle-and-cannon plant was rushing five buildings and trial-building arms.

sentences.zh: 此二廠皆經費支絀，所造軍械，非專供湖北之用，請就江南籌防局撥款協濟。」

translations.literal: Both plants were short of funds; the arms they produced were not solely for Hubei's use; he requested that the Jiangnan coastal-defense bureau allocate funds to assist."
translations.idiomatic: Both plants were short of funds and their output served more than Hubei; he asked the Jiangnan coastal-defense bureau to allocate assistance."

translations.literal: (closing quotation mark in the source.)
translations.idiomatic: (closing quotation mark in the source.)

sentences.zh: 又以「江南省製造局，自光緒十七八年，沿江各省，教案會匪紛起，深恐海上有警，當將製造局應行增制快槍快砲、新式火藥各件，籌議購機試造。

translations.literal: He also reported: "The Jiangnan Provincial Manufacturing Bureau, from Guangxu seventeen and eighteen, as missionary cases and secret-society bandits arose repeatedly in provinces along the river, feared trouble at sea and planned to expand the bureau with quick rifles, quick-firing guns, and new-style powder and related items, discussing purchase of machinery for trial manufacture.
translations.idiomatic: He also reported: "From Guangxu 17–18 (1891–1892), as missionary cases and secret-society unrest spread along the river, the Jiangnan Manufacturing Bureau feared trouble at sea and planned to expand production of quick rifles, quick-firing guns, and new-style powder, arranging to buy machinery for trial manufacture.

sentences.zh: 迨光緒二十年，日本軍事起，各省徵調頻繁，處處調撥軍火，局中積年所造之槍砲藥彈，幾至撥發一空。

translations.literal: By Guangxu twenty, when hostilities with Japan began, requisitions from the provinces were frequent; ordnance was dispatched everywhere, and rifles, cannon, powder, and shells accumulated over years in the bureau were nearly exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: By Guangxu 20 (1894), when war with Japan began, provincial requisitions were constant; ordnance went out everywhere, and years of accumulated rifles, cannon, powder, and shells were nearly exhausted.

sentences.zh: 自應及時擴充機器，加緊製造。

translations.literal: Machinery should be expanded in timely fashion and manufacture intensified.
translations.idiomatic: Machinery should be expanded promptly and production stepped up.

sentences.zh: 近年軍械，以槍砲藥彈為先，而槍砲尤以新出快式為利。

translations.literal: In recent years ordnance had prioritized rifles, cannon, powder, and shells, and among rifles and cannon the newly issued quick-firing types were especially advantageous.
translations.idiomatic: Recent ordnance priorities were rifles, cannon, powder, and shells; among arms, the newest quick-firing types were especially advantageous.

sentences.zh: 是以鄂省設廠自鍊鋼料，為砲筒槍管之用。

translations.literal: Hence Hubei had established a plant to refine its own steel for gun barrels and rifle tubes.
translations.idiomatic: Hence Hubei had set up a plant to refine its own steel for gun barrels and rifle tubes.

sentences.zh: 又因新式巨砲，皆用栗色火藥餅，快砲快槍皆用無煙火藥，局中自造者無多，應增置各項機器，擇要先辦。

translations.literal: Moreover, new-style great guns all used brown powder cakes, and quick-firing guns and quick rifles all used smokeless powder; the bureau made little of its own and should add various machinery, choosing priorities first.
translations.idiomatic: New large guns all used brown powder cakes, and quick-firing guns and quick rifles used smokeless powder; the bureau made little of its own and should add machinery on a priority basis.

sentences.zh: 將鍊鋼、製藥，及造快槍、快砲各機器數十座，向洋商定購。

translations.literal: Several dozen sets of steel-refining, powder-making, and quick-rifle and quick-firing gun machinery were to be ordered from foreign firms.
translations.idiomatic: Several dozen sets of steel-refining, powder-making, and quick-rifle and quick-firing gun machinery were ordered from foreign firms.

sentences.zh: 又購買基地，增建鍊鋼廠、造栗色火藥餅廠、無煙火藥廠，及添購製造鋼料，與造火藥物料，合計用銀四十餘萬兩。

translations.literal: Land was also purchased and steelworks added, along with a brown powder cake plant, a smokeless powder plant, and added materials for steel manufacture and powder making—totaling more than four hundred thousand taels.
translations.idiomatic: Land was purchased for added steelworks, a brown powder cake plant, a smokeless powder plant, and materials for steel and powder manufacture—totaling more than 400,000 taels.

sentences.zh: 其在外洋訂購之器件，與洋商籌議，令其暫行墊辦，不致稽延時日，先將各項機器運到，即可開廠製造。

translations.literal: For parts ordered abroad, foreign merchants were consulted to advance payment temporarily so days would not be lost; once machinery arrived, manufacture could begin at once.
translations.idiomatic: For foreign orders, merchants were asked to advance payment temporarily to avoid delay; once machinery arrived, production could begin at once.

sentences.zh: 自光緒二十年海防戒嚴，各省防軍需用軍火甚急，而火藥子彈尤為大宗。

translations.literal: Since Guangxu twenty, when coastal defense was on alert, provincial defense forces urgently needed ordnance, and powder and cartridges were especially needed in bulk.
translations.idiomatic: Since Guangxu 20 (1894), with coastal defense on alert, provincial forces urgently needed ordnance, especially powder and cartridges in bulk.

sentences.zh: 外洋守局外之例，不肯代購。

translations.literal: Foreigners observed neutrality and would not purchase on others' behalf.
translations.idiomatic: Foreigners observed neutrality and would not buy on others' behalf.

sentences.zh: 即使設法運購，而價值驟增數倍，遠涉重洋，敵船又不時邀截，至為困難。

translations.literal: Even if purchase could somehow be arranged, prices suddenly rose several times over; long ocean voyages and intermittent enemy interception made the matter extremely difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Even when purchase was possible, prices multiplied; long ocean voyages and enemy interception made it extremely difficult.

sentences.zh: 今江南製造局購機設廠，自能仿造，不待外求，自為當務之急。

translations.literal: Now that the Jiangnan Manufacturing Bureau was purchasing machinery and establishing plants, it could imitate manufacture on its own without seeking abroad—this was the urgent task of the moment.
translations.idiomatic: With the Jiangnan bureau buying machinery and setting up plants, it could manufacture locally without foreign dependence—an urgent priority.

sentences.zh: 但局中常年經費，僅有二成洋稅數十萬兩，只能製造各項子藥，分濟南北兩洋操練防守之需。

translations.literal: But the bureau's regular budget consisted only of several hundred thousand taels from twenty percent of customs revenue, enough only to manufacture various ammunition and supply north and south coastal drill and defense needs.
translations.idiomatic: But regular funding was only several hundred thousand taels from twenty percent of customs revenue—enough only for ammunition to supply north and south coastal drill and defense.

sentences.zh: 若加造新式槍砲接濟各軍，則機廠既增，工料自倍加於昔。

translations.literal: If new-style rifles and cannon were added to supply the various armies, the expanded plants would require materials and labor doubled from before.
translations.idiomatic: Adding new-style rifles and cannon for the armies would double materials and labor at the expanded plants.

sentences.zh: 擬於江海關常年洋稅，或洋藥稅釐，每年加撥銀二十萬兩，為擴充製造後常年工作之需」。

translations.literal: It was proposed to add two hundred thousand taels each year from regular customs revenue at the Jianghaiguan or from opium tax surcharges, for regular operations after expansion of manufacture."
translations.idiomatic: He proposed adding 200,000 taels annually from Jianghaiguan customs revenue or opium tax surcharges for regular operations after expansion."

sentences.zh: 二十二年，成都將軍恭壽因四川省軍實不充，而防務重要，乃與駐防川省之八旗協領等量力捐廉，製造抬槍九十六枝，鳥槍四百八十枝，均用煅煉純鐵纏絲製造，堅實可恃。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, Chengdu General Gong Shou, because Sichuan's military stores were insufficient and defense was important, together with the Eight Banners assistant commanders stationed in Sichuan and others contributed from their salaries according to capacity, manufacturing ninety-six wall guns and four hundred eighty matchlock muskets, all made of forged pure iron with wrapped wire construction, solid and reliable.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 22 (1896), Chengdu General Gong Shou, finding Sichuan's military stores insufficient and defense critical, joined Eight Banners assistant commanders stationed in the province in salary contributions to build ninety-six wall guns and four hundred eighty matchlock muskets, all of forged pure iron with wire-wrapped barrels—solid and reliable.

sentences.zh: 其舊存槍枝，一律修整，為操練之需。

translations.literal: Old rifles on hand were uniformly repaired for drill needs.
translations.idiomatic: Old rifles on hand were all repaired for drill.

sentences.zh: 直隸總督王文韶以北洋機器局所造各種砲子，名目雖不同，而十生的半之子彈居多，皆系舊式，不盡合用。

translations.literal: Governor-General Wang Wenshao of Zhili reported that although the various shell types made at the Beiyang Machine Bureau differed in name, most were old-style shells for ten-and-a-half centimeter guns and were not fully suitable.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Wang Wenshao of Zhili reported that although Beiyang Machine Bureau shells bore different names, most were old-style 10.5 centimeter shells and were not fully suitable.

sentences.zh: 乃向洋商訂購洋式翻沙泥，及造彈各機器，自行仿歐西新式製造。

translations.literal: He therefore ordered from foreign merchants foreign-style sand-turning mold clay and shell-making machinery to imitate Western new-style manufacture on his own.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered foreign-style sand-turning mold clay and shell-making machinery from foreign merchants to imitate Western new-style production locally.

sentences.zh: 兩江總督劉坤一考核機器局成績，於常年製造之外，鍊鋼廠每年可出快砲快槍筒及槍砲槍件砲架器具等鋼料共二千二百餘頓，栗色火藥廠每年可出栗色火藥二十餘萬磅，無煙火藥廠每年可出無煙火藥六萬餘磅。

translations.literal: Governor-General Liu Kunyi of the Two Jiangs assessed the machine bureau's performance: beyond regular manufacture, the steelworks could turn out more than two thousand two hundred tons of steel each year for quick-firing gun and quick-rifle tubes, rifle and cannon parts, gun-carriage fittings, and tools; the brown powder plant could produce more than two hundred thousand pounds of brown powder; the smokeless powder plant could produce more than sixty thousand pounds of smokeless powder.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Liu Kunyi of the Two Jiangs assessed bureau performance: beyond regular output, the steelworks produced more than 2,200 tons of steel annually for quick-firing gun and quick-rifle tubes, rifle and cannon parts, gun-carriage fittings, and tools; the brown powder plant produced more than 200,000 pounds of brown powder; the smokeless powder plant produced more than 60,000 pounds of smokeless powder.

sentences.zh: 所創立造槍砲新廠，購機已備，加工製造，每年可出快利新式槍一千五百枝，一百磅子之快砲六尊，四十磅子之快砲十二尊，快利新槍子一百三十餘萬顆，快砲子彈一千五百顆，大小鐵彈一萬餘顆，漸著成績。

translations.literal: At the newly established rifle-and-cannon plant, with machinery purchased and ready, intensive manufacture could turn out each year one thousand five hundred Kuaili new-style rifles, six one-hundred-pounder quick-firing guns, twelve forty-pounder quick-firing guns, more than one million three hundred thousand Kuaili new-rifle rounds, one thousand five hundred quick-firing gun shells, and more than ten thousand iron shells large and small—results were gradually taking shape.
translations.idiomatic: At the newly established rifle-and-cannon plant, with machinery in place, intensive production could yield each year 1,500 Kuaili new-style rifles, six 100-pounder quick-firing guns, twelve 40-pounder quick-firing guns, more than 1.3 million Kuaili rifle rounds, 1,500 quick-firing gun shells, and more than 10,000 iron shells large and small—results were gradually taking shape.

sentences.zh: 四川總督鹿傳霖以四川省機器局自光緒十二年至十七年，前督臣劉秉璋曾將在局出力人員獎勵。

translations.literal: Sichuan Governor Lu Chuanlin reported that from Guangxu twelve to seventeen, former Governor Liu Bingzhang had once rewarded the hard-working personnel at the Sichuan Machine Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan Governor Lu Chuanlin reported that from Guangxu 12–17 (1886–1891), former Governor Liu Bingzhang had once rewarded the hard-working staff of the Sichuan Machine Bureau.

sentences.zh: 今又屆五年，所陸續造成機器藥彈等項，皆精良合用，增造後膛毛瑟抬槍亦頗快利。

translations.literal: Now another five years had passed; machine-made powder and shells produced in succession were all fine and suitable, and additionally manufactured breech-loading Mauser wall guns were also quite quick and effective.
translations.idiomatic: Five years had passed again. Successive output of powder and shells was fine and serviceable, and the added production of breech-loading Mauser wall guns was also brisk and effective.

sentences.zh: 在局各員，仍行獎勵之。

translations.literal: All personnel at the bureau were again to be rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: The bureau staff were rewarded once more.

sentences.zh: 直隸總督王文韶因京師練兵處王大臣以京營訓練，需用打帽抬槍一千五百枝，令北洋製造局如式製造，以應要需。

translations.literal: Governor-General Wang Wenshao of Zhili, because the grand ministers of the capital Drill and Training Office, for training of the capital garrison, required one thousand five hundred percussion-cap wall guns, ordered the Beiyang Manufacturing Bureau to manufacture according to pattern to meet need.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Wang Wenshao of Zhili reported that the grand ministers at the capital Drill and Training Office, preparing to drill the capital garrison, needed 1,500 percussion-cap wall guns and ordered the Beiyang Manufacturing Bureau to build them to pattern.

sentences.zh: 乃造成邊機抬槍、中機抬槍各一枝，試放均屬靈捷合用。

translations.literal: Thereupon one border-mechanism wall gun and one medium-mechanism wall gun were made; test firing showed both nimble and suitable.
translations.idiomatic: One border-mechanism and one medium-mechanism wall gun were built; test firing showed both were nimble and serviceable.

sentences.zh: 惟邊機抬槍分兩太重，不便施放。

translations.literal: Only the border-mechanism wall gun's weight was too heavy, inconvenient to fire.
translations.idiomatic: But the border-mechanism model was too heavy to handle comfortably.

sentences.zh: 若用中機抬槍改造邊機，其尺寸斤兩，仍與中機抬槍一致。

translations.literal: If the border mechanism were altered using the medium-mechanism wall gun, its dimensions and weight would still match the medium-mechanism wall gun.
translations.idiomatic: If the border mechanism were adapted from the medium-mechanism design, dimensions and weight would remain the same as the medium-mechanism model.

sentences.zh: 即令製造局按照此式，製造邊機前門大式抬槍五百枝，隨槍物件共五百分，以中機抬槍改造邊機前門小式抬槍一千枝，隨槍物件共一千分。

translations.literal: The Manufacturing Bureau was immediately ordered according to this pattern to manufacture five hundred large front-loading border-mechanism wall guns, with accessories totaling five hundred sets, and one thousand small front-loading border-mechanism wall guns adapted from medium-mechanism wall guns, with accessories totaling one thousand sets.
translations.idiomatic: The bureau was ordered to build 500 large front-loading border-mechanism wall guns with 500 accessory sets, and 1,000 small front-loading border-mechanism wall guns adapted from the medium-mechanism model with 1,000 accessory sets.

sentences.zh: 其制造款項，由北洋作正開支。

translations.literal: The manufacturing funds would be drawn as regular expenditure by Beiyang.
translations.idiomatic: Beiyang would cover the manufacturing costs from regular funds.

sentences.zh: 北洋製造局向有歲造荷砲子彈經費銀四萬兩，本年以此項荷彈歲費，改造後門抬槍。

translations.literal: The Beiyang Manufacturing Bureau had had annual funding of forty thousand taels for howitzer shells; this year that annual howitzer-shell appropriation would be converted to manufacture breech-loading wall guns.
translations.idiomatic: The Beiyang Manufacturing Bureau's annual 40,000-tael appropriation for howitzer shells would this year be diverted to build breech-loading wall guns instead.

sentences.zh: 今練兵處需槍孔急，擬即以此款移用。

translations.literal: Now the Drill and Training Office urgently needed rifles; it was proposed to redirect this fund immediately.
translations.idiomatic: With the Drill and Training Office urgently short of rifles, he proposed redirecting the funds at once.

sentences.zh: 湖廣總督譚繼洵以「湖北省製造軍火，向年所造舊式抬槍、線槍、抬砲、劈山砲等項，均系前膛，不及後膛新槍砲之敏捷，擬向外洋購置機器，改造各項後膛槍砲，並製造砲彈槍彈銅殼等項。

translations.literal: Governor-General Tan Jixun of Huguang reported: "In Hubei manufacture of ordnance, in past years the old-style wall guns, line guns, wall cannon, and mountain guns produced were all muzzle-loading, falling short of the agility of new breech-loading rifles and cannon; it was proposed to purchase machinery abroad and convert all items to breech-loading rifles and cannon, and manufacture shell, rifle, and brass cartridge cases and the like.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Tan Jixun of Huguang reported: "Hubei's ordnance works had long turned out old-style muzzle-loading wall guns, line guns, wall cannon, and mountain guns—less agile than new breech-loaders. I propose buying foreign machinery to convert production to breech-loading rifles and cannon and to manufacture shells, rifle rounds, brass cartridge cases, and the like.

sentences.zh: 今因部臣允從奉天府丞李培元之議，令各省製造局兼造抬槍，並造內地火藥，籌度辦理。

translations.literal: Now because Board ministers had approved Assistant Prefect Li Peiyuan of Fengtian's proposal, ordering provincial manufacturing bureaus also to manufacture wall guns and domestic powder, matters were planned and handled.
translations.idiomatic: With the Board having approved Assistant Prefect Li Peiyuan of Fengtian's proposal for provincial bureaus also to build wall guns and domestic powder, he was planning accordingly.

sentences.zh: 因抬槍、抬砲本中國向日制勝之具，將弁兵丁素所習練，今若改用後膛，操演易於精熟，用款不多，而日後可收大效。

translations.literal: Because wall guns and wall cannon were China's traditional instruments of victory, familiar to officers and soldiers for drill; if changed now to breech-loading, drill would be easier to master, expense would not be great, and great results could be reaped later.
translations.idiomatic: Wall guns and wall cannon were China's traditional weapons of victory, and officers and men already knew them. Switching to breech-loaders would make drill easier to master at modest cost and pay large dividends later.

sentences.zh: 雖漢陽槍砲廠規模宏遠，而機器種類各有不同，若抬槍、抬砲等器，他日能製造精純，亦可為漢廠之助也」。

translations.literal: Although the Hanyang Rifle and Cannon Works was vast in scale, machine types differed; if wall guns, wall cannon, and the like could one day be manufactured with precision, they could also assist the Hanyang plant."
translations.idiomatic: Although the Hanyang Rifle and Cannon Works was immense, its machinery served different purposes; if wall guns and wall cannon could one day be built to a high standard, they would also strengthen the Hanyang plant."

sentences.zh: 山東巡撫李秉衡考核機器局成績，於光緒二十一年所造成各種火藥十五萬六千九百六十斤，大銅帽火七十二萬顆，開花炸子一千六百顆，炸子銅螺絲引門一千六百副，克雷力伯銅砲拉火銅管四萬四千枝，帶活架瓶砲九尊，大砲子一千四百九十顆，洋鉛彈丸一百三十九萬四百五十粒，添造各廠應用機器及熟鐵大鍋爐一具，修理各營損壞洋槍洋砲，製成各項軍火箱盒，修理槍子廠、軋銅廠房屋及大鍋爐，爐台、烘銅爐、大煙筒、生鐵廠、保險爐、提硝房、工務廠之屋宇等，又採買硝磺銅鐵鋼鉛及華、洋各種物料，暨員匠工役薪工運腳雜費等，共支用銀六萬四千七百餘兩有奇。

translations.literal: Shandong Governor Li Bingheng assessed the machine bureau's performance: in Guangxu twenty-one it produced various powders totaling 156,960 jin, big percussion caps 720,000, explosive shells 1,600, shell copper screw fuse gates 1,600 sets, Krupp cannon pull-fire copper tubes 44,000, nine bottle cannon with movable frames, large cannonballs 1,490, foreign lead bullets 1,390,450, added machinery for various plants and one large wrought-iron boiler, repaired damaged foreign rifles and cannon for various camps, made ordnance boxes and cases of all kinds, repaired buildings and boilers of the bullet plant and copper-rolling plant, furnace platforms, copper-drying furnaces, large chimneys, cast-iron plant, safety furnace, saltpeter extraction rooms, works buildings, and the like, also purchased saltpeter, sulfur, copper, iron, steel, lead and Chinese and foreign materials, plus salaries for staff, craftsmen, laborers, transport, and miscellaneous expenses—total expenditure more than 64,700 taels.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong Governor Li Bingheng assessed the machine bureau's Guangxu 21 (1895) output: 156,960 jin of various powders; 720,000 large percussion caps; 1,600 explosive shells; 1,600 shell fuse gates; 44,000 Krupp cannon priming tubes; nine mounted bottle cannon; 1,490 large cannonballs; 1,390,450 foreign lead bullets; plant machinery and a large wrought-iron boiler; repairs to camps' damaged foreign rifles and cannon; ordnance boxes; repairs to bullet and copper-rolling plant buildings, boilers, furnace platforms, copper-drying furnaces, chimneys, cast-iron plant, safety furnace, saltpeter rooms, and works buildings; purchases of saltpeter, sulfur, copper, iron, steel, lead, and Chinese and foreign materials; and staff, craftsmen, labor, transport, and miscellaneous costs—totaling more than 64,700 taels.

sentences.zh: 是年，戶部從吉林將軍長順之議，增吉林機器局製造軍火常年經費，除黑龍江軍隊領用外，其餘分給奉天防軍。

translations.literal: That year the Board of Revenue approved Jilin General Chang Shun's proposal to increase the Jilin Machine Bureau's regular ordnance-manufacturing funds; except for what Heilongjiang armies drew, the remainder would be allocated to Fengtian defense forces.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Board of Revenue approved Jilin General Chang Shun's proposal to increase regular funding for the Jilin Machine Bureau; aside from Heilongjiang army allotments, the rest would go to Fengtian defense forces.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，大學士榮祿上言：「製造軍火，以煤鐵為根本。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, Grand Secretary Rong Lu memorialized: "In manufacturing ordnance, coal and iron are the foundation.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 23 (1897), Grand Secretary Rong Lu wrote: "Ordnance production rests on coal and iron.

sentences.zh: 外洋購價日昂，中國各省煤鐵礦產，以山西、河南、四川、湖南為最，應令山西等疆吏籌款，從速開採，設立製造局廠，漸次擴充，以重軍需。」

translations.literal: Foreign purchase prices rose daily; coal and iron mineral resources in China's provinces were richest in Shanxi, Henan, Sichuan, and Hunan; Shanxi and other frontier officials should raise funds, open mines swiftly, establish manufacturing bureaus and plants, expand gradually, to strengthen military supply."
translations.idiomatic: Foreign prices kept rising; Shanxi, Henan, Sichuan, and Hunan had China's richest coal and iron deposits. Frontier officials in Shanxi and elsewhere should raise funds to open mines quickly, establish manufacturing plants, and expand gradually to strengthen military supply."

sentences.zh: 廷議允之。

translations.literal: The court deliberated and approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 令督撫臣就地方情形認真籌辦，總期有備無患，庶足倉卒應變。

translations.literal: Governors and governors-general were ordered according to local conditions earnestly to plan and handle matters, in all cases aiming to be prepared without calamity, so as to meet sudden change.
translations.idiomatic: Governors and governors-general were ordered to plan earnestly according to local conditions, aim to be prepared against trouble, and be ready for sudden emergencies.

sentences.zh: 是年，湖北巡撫譚繼洵以湖北省製造軍火，增置砲架、槍彈、砲彈三廠，所有機器工料之價，並改換新式快砲機器，尚需銀十四萬餘兩，即在籌捐項下撥給。

translations.literal: That year Hubei Governor Tan Jixun reported that Hubei ordnance manufacture added three plants for gun carriages, rifle rounds, and shells; all machinery and materials, including conversion to new quick-firing gun machinery, still required more than 140,000 taels, to be allocated from fund-raising donations.
translations.idiomatic: That year Hubei Governor Tan Jixun reported that Hubei was adding gun-carriage, rifle-round, and shell plants; machinery, materials, and new quick-firing gun equipment would require more than 140,000 taels, to be drawn from fund-raising donations.

sentences.zh: 山東巡撫李秉衡上言：「山東機器局於光緒二十二年間所造軍火，共造成各種洋火藥十九萬六千餘斤，堅利遠後膛大抬槍二百十六枝，步槍六枝，大銅帽火四百四十二萬顆，粗細銅管拉火六萬二千枝，銅砲炸子二千一百顆，炸子引門二千一百副，砲子一千一百九十個，各種群子八萬四千八百個，各種後膛自來火帶藥槍子一百十六萬八千四百顆，洋鉛丸一百七十二萬一千五百粒，抬槍、抬砲、來福槍、鳥槍及裝配毛瑟槍、哈乞開司槍各種大小鉛丸一百五十九萬粒，捲筒鉛子二萬一千二百斤，並修成各營抬槍、抬砲、洋槍、洋砲，添買車床、鑽床及各項雜費，均歸戶部核銷。

translations.literal: Shandong Governor Li Bingheng memorialized: "The Shandong Machine Bureau in Guangxu twenty-two produced ordnance totaling various foreign powders more than 196,000 jin, sturdy long-range breech-loading large wall guns 216, rifles 6, big percussion caps 4,420,000, coarse and fine copper-tube primers 62,000, copper cannon explosive shells 2,100, shell fuse gates 2,100 sets, cannonballs 1,190, various canister shot 84,800, various breech-loading self-igniting cartridges with powder 1,168,400, foreign lead balls 1,721,500, large and small lead balls for wall guns, wall cannon, rifles, matchlock muskets and for fitting Mauser and Hotchkiss rifles 1,590,000, rolled-tube lead bullets 21,200 jin, and repaired wall guns, wall cannon, foreign rifles, and foreign cannon for various camps, added lathes, drill presses, and various miscellaneous expenses—all to be audited by the Board of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong Governor Li Bingheng reported: "In Guangxu 22 (1896) the Shandong Machine Bureau produced more than 196,000 jin of foreign powder; 216 sturdy long-range breech-loading large wall guns; 6 rifles; 4.42 million large percussion caps; 62,000 copper primers; 2,100 copper cannon explosive shells; 2,100 shell fuse gates; 1,190 cannonballs; 84,800 canister rounds; 1,168,400 breech-loading self-igniting cartridges; 1,721,500 foreign lead balls; 1,590,000 large and small lead balls for wall guns, wall cannon, rifles, matchlock muskets, and Mauser and Hotchkiss rifles; 21,200 jin of rolled-tube lead bullets; repairs to camps' wall guns, wall cannon, foreign rifles, and foreign cannon; added lathes, drill presses, and miscellaneous costs—all subject to Board of Revenue audit.

sentences.zh: 原有機器局，設法擴充製造，添造槍械，採購應用材料，增建廠屋，購買機器，乃於機器廠後建設洋式大槍廠一所。

translations.literal: The existing machine bureau was to be expanded for manufacture, additional arms built, needed materials purchased, plant buildings added, and machinery bought; behind the machine plant a foreign-style large-rifle plant was then established.
translations.idiomatic: The existing machine bureau would expand production, add arms, buy materials, erect new buildings, and purchase machinery; a foreign-style large-rifle plant was built behind the machine shop.

sentences.zh: 造槍需用銅鐵零件甚多，則熟鐵廠必須擴充，乃於舊鐵廠之後，另建洋式熟鐵大廠一所。

translations.literal: Building rifles required very many copper and iron parts, so the wrought-iron plant had to be expanded; behind the old iron plant another foreign-style large wrought-iron plant was built.
translations.idiomatic: Rifle production required vast numbers of copper and iron parts, so the wrought-iron plant had to expand; a foreign-style large wrought-iron plant was built behind the old iron works.

sentences.zh: 造槍則用槍子倍多，乃於舊槍子廠之東，另建洋式槍子廠一所。

translations.literal: Building rifles used twice as many bullets, so east of the old bullet plant another foreign-style bullet plant was built.
translations.idiomatic: Rifle production doubled bullet demand, so a foreign-style bullet plant was built east of the old bullet works.

sentences.zh: 槍子需銅最多，乃另建軋銅大廠一所。

translations.literal: Bullets required the most copper, so another large copper-rolling plant was built.
translations.idiomatic: Bullets consumed the most copper, so another large copper-rolling plant was added.

sentences.zh: 外洋製造廠，視鍋爐之大小，以定煙筒之高下。

translations.literal: In foreign manufacturing plants, chimney height was set according to boiler size.
translations.idiomatic: Foreign factories sized their chimneys to match their boilers.

sentences.zh: 今造成九十五尺高之煙筒一座，七十五尺高之煙筒一座，五十五尺高之煙筒一座，鐵煙筒一座。

translations.literal: Now one chimney ninety-five feet high, one seventy-five feet high, one fifty-five feet high, and one iron chimney were built.
translations.idiomatic: The bureau built chimneys ninety-five, seventy-five, and fifty-five feet high, plus one iron chimney.

sentences.zh: 廠基深掘五尺，煙筒基深掘八尺，均密釘排椿，上築三合土，蓋以大石板，再砌條石牆腳，則扁磚實砌，純灌灰漿，梁棟皆用外洋木之方而巨者，屋柱則生鐵鑄成，即機器常年震動，不致有鼓裂之虞。

translations.literal: The plant foundation was dug five feet deep and the chimney foundation eight feet deep; both were densely piled with driven stakes, rammed earth was laid on top, large stone slabs placed over it, then cut-stone wall footings built, flat bricks solidly laid, pure mortar poured in; beams and rafters all used large square foreign timber, roof columns were cast iron, so that even with the machinery vibrating year-round, there would be no fear of bulging or cracking.
translations.idiomatic: Plant foundations were dug five feet deep and chimney foundations eight feet; both were densely piled, capped with rammed earth and large stone slabs, then cut-stone footings, solid flat-brick walls, and pure mortar; beams and rafters used large square foreign timber and roof columns were cast iron, so constant machinery vibration would not crack or bulge the structure.

sentences.zh: 此外所增建者，軍械日富，則有存儲之區，工匠日多，則有休息之所，乃建軍火庫二十間，工匠房四十間。

translations.literal: Beyond this, as ordnance grew there had to be storage space, and as craftsmen increased there had to be rest quarters; twenty ordnance storehouses and forty craftsmen quarters were built.
translations.idiomatic: As ordnance stocks grew, twenty storehouses were added; as the workforce expanded, forty craftsmen quarters were built.

sentences.zh: 又建水龍房以備不虞，泥工廠以資修葺，皆不可少之工。

translations.literal: A fire-engine house was also built against emergency, and a masonry plant for repairs—work that could not be omitted.
translations.idiomatic: A fire-engine house was added against emergencies, and a masonry shop for upkeep—both indispensable.

sentences.zh: 共增廠四座，群屋八十餘間，較原廠擴充三分之二。

translations.literal: In all four plants were added and more than eighty grouped buildings, expanding the original plant by two-thirds.
translations.idiomatic: Four new plants and more than eighty grouped buildings expanded the original works by two-thirds.

sentences.zh: 至製造抬槍機器，外洋本無抬槍名目，故無此專用機器。

translations.literal: As for machinery for manufacturing wall guns, abroad there was no category called wall gun, so there was no dedicated machinery for it.
translations.idiomatic: Foreign arsenals had no category called "wall gun," so no dedicated wall-gun machinery existed abroad.

sentences.zh: 嗣選通曉製造之員，與洋商參酌，定造抬槍機器，並可兼造毛瑟洋槍機器共六十餘種。

translations.literal: Thereafter staff versed in manufacture were selected to consult with foreign merchants and order wall-gun machinery that could also make Mauser rifle machinery, more than sixty types in all.
translations.idiomatic: Staff skilled in manufacture then worked with foreign merchants to order wall-gun machinery that could also turn out Mauser rifle parts—more than sixty types in all.

sentences.zh: 此外地軸皮帶鎚鉗軸枕螺絲各種輪模刀鑽，共一百七十餘件，已陸續運解到省。

translations.literal: Besides these, ground shafts, belts, hammers, vises, shaft pillows, screws, various wheels, molds, knives, and drills—more than 170 items in all—had already been shipped to the province in succession.
translations.idiomatic: More than 170 additional items—ground shafts, belts, hammers, vises, shaft pillows, screws, wheels, molds, knives, and drills—had already reached the province in batches.

sentences.zh: 俟機器及銅鐵鋼料運齊，工匠募足，即可開車製造。

translations.literal: Once machinery and copper, iron, and steel materials arrived and craftsmen were fully recruited, production could begin at once.
translations.idiomatic: Once machinery, copper, iron, and steel arrived and craftsmen were fully hired, production could begin at once.

sentences.zh: 共用銀十二萬兩，先由籓庫及南運局籌給。」

translations.literal: The total cost was 120,000 taels, first to be raised from the provincial treasury and the Southern Transport Bureau."
translations.idiomatic: The project cost 120,000 taels, to be raised first from the provincial treasury and the Southern Transport Bureau."

translations.literal: (closing quotation mark in the source.)
translations.idiomatic: (closing quotation mark in the source.)

sentences.zh: 大學士榮祿建議，通飭各省製造快槍、快砲、無煙火藥，並鍊鋼鐵各項機器。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Rong Lu proposed a general order to all provinces to manufacture quick rifles, quick-firing guns, smokeless powder, and steel-refining machinery of all kinds.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Rong Lu proposed ordering every province to manufacture quick rifles, quick-firing guns, smokeless powder, and steel-refining machinery.

sentences.zh: 海疆多事，武備為先，須通力合作，以備強敵。

translations.literal: The coast faced many troubles; military preparedness came first; joint effort was needed to prepare against strong enemies.
translations.idiomatic: With coastal troubles mounting, military preparedness came first; provinces had to cooperate to meet a formidable enemy.

sentences.zh: 河南巡撫劉樹棠上言，河南機器局規模甚小，若遵榮祿所議，兼造各式軍械，財力實有未逮。

translations.literal: Henan Governor Liu Shutang memorialized that the Henan Machine Bureau was very small in scale; if Rong Lu's proposal were followed to manufacture all kinds of ordnance, financial capacity truly could not reach that far.
translations.idiomatic: Henan Governor Liu Shutang reported that the Henan Machine Bureau was very small; if Rong Lu's plan required building every kind of ordnance, the province simply could not afford it.

sentences.zh: 豫省機器局建設於省城南門外卓屯地方。

translations.literal: The Henan Machine Bureau was built at Zhuotun outside the south gate of the provincial capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Henan Machine Bureau stood at Zhuotun outside the provincial capital's south gate.

sentences.zh: 其造彈機器，已向上海信義洋行定購，在外洋加工造成，陸續運至河南，安置妥貼，開工製造槍彈火藥。

translations.literal: Its bullet-making machinery had been ordered from the Xinyi foreign firm in Shanghai, to be processed and built abroad and shipped in succession to Henan, properly installed, and put to work manufacturing rifle rounds and powder.
translations.idiomatic: Bullet-making machinery had been ordered from the Xinyi foreign firm in Shanghai for manufacture abroad, shipment to Henan, installation, and production of rifle rounds and powder.

sentences.zh: 其造抬槍車床，亦經運到，並訂購鋼筒五百枝。

translations.literal: Its wall-gun lathes had also arrived, and five hundred steel barrels were ordered.
translations.idiomatic: Wall-gun lathes had also arrived, and five hundred steel barrels were ordered.

sentences.zh: 先造後膛抬槍五百桿，以資應用。

translations.literal: Five hundred breech-loading wall guns would first be built for use.
translations.idiomatic: Five hundred breech-loading wall guns would be built first for immediate use.

sentences.zh: 本省新練之豫正全軍，一律改習洋操。

translations.literal: The province's newly drilled Yuzheng full army would uniformly change to foreign drill.
translations.idiomatic: The province's newly drilled Yuzheng full army would all switch to foreign drill.

sentences.zh: 又通令各州縣，籌款自練勇隊，所需槍械子藥，皆省局自造。

translations.literal: A general order was also sent to all prefectures and counties to raise funds and train their own militia companies; needed rifles, ammunition, and powder would all be made by the provincial bureau.
translations.idiomatic: He also ordered every prefecture and county to raise funds and train local militia; rifles, ammunition, and powder would all come from the provincial bureau.

sentences.zh: 湖廣總督張之洞上言：「大學士榮祿議令產煤鐵各省，咸從速開採，已經設立有制造局廠省分，規模未備者，尤宜擴充，自鍊鋼以迄造無煙藥彈各項機器，均須實力講求，以重軍需。

translations.literal: Governor-General Zhang Zhidong of Huguang memorialized: "Grand Secretary Rong Lu proposed that provinces rich in coal and iron should all open mines swiftly; provinces that had already established manufacturing bureaus and plants but whose scale was not yet complete should especially expand, from steel refining through machinery for smokeless powder and shells—all must be pursued in earnest to strengthen military supply.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Zhang Zhidong of Huguang wrote: "Grand Secretary Rong Lu urged coal- and iron-rich provinces to open mines quickly. Provinces with manufacturing plants that were still incomplete should expand especially—from steel refining through smokeless-powder and shell machinery—all must be pursued in earnest to strengthen military supply.

sentences.zh: 所言切中機宜，亟應籌辦。

translations.literal: What he said hit the mark; it should urgently be planned and carried out.
translations.idiomatic: His proposal was exactly right and should be pursued at once.

sentences.zh: 湖北製造廠所造快槍、快砲，為新式最精之械。

translations.literal: The quick rifles and quick-firing guns made at the Hubei manufacturing plant were the finest new-style arms.
translations.idiomatic: The quick rifles and quick-firing guns from the Hubei plant were the finest new-style arms.

sentences.zh: 若有械無彈無藥，仍屬虛器。

translations.literal: If there were arms but no rounds and no powder, they would still be empty instruments.
translations.idiomatic: Arms without rounds and powder were still useless metal.

sentences.zh: 故既添設銅殼廠，又須添設無煙藥廠。

translations.literal: Therefore, having added a brass-cartridge plant, a smokeless-powder plant must also be added.
translations.idiomatic: Having added a brass-cartridge plant, a smokeless-powder plant was also required.

sentences.zh: 因外洋裝配快槍、快砲，悉用無煙火藥，他項洋藥皆不合用。

translations.literal: Because abroad quick rifles and quick-firing guns were all fitted with smokeless powder, other foreign powders were not suitable.
translations.idiomatic: Abroad, quick rifles and quick-firing guns all used smokeless powder; other foreign powders would not do.

sentences.zh: 又槍管砲身，必須精鍊之罐子鋼，方足以受無煙火藥之漲力。

translations.literal: Moreover rifle barrels and cannon bodies required finely refined pot steel before they could withstand the explosive force of smokeless powder.
translations.idiomatic: Rifle barrels and cannon bodies also required finely refined pot steel to withstand smokeless powder's explosive force.

sentences.zh: 湖北鐵廠所煉之西門馬丁鋼，以之制他器，則已稱精良。

translations.literal: The Siemens-Martin steel smelted at the Hubei ironworks, used for other implements, was already called excellent.
translations.idiomatic: The Siemens-Martin steel from the Hubei ironworks was already excellent for other implements.

sentences.zh: 以之制槍砲，則尚非極致。

translations.literal: Used for rifles and cannon, it was still not the ultimate grade.
translations.idiomatic: For rifles and cannon, it was still not the highest grade.

sentences.zh: 外洋罐子鋼之價值，數十倍於常鋼，非徒購運道遠也。

translations.literal: The value of foreign pot steel was dozens of times that of ordinary steel—not merely because purchase and transport were distant.
translations.idiomatic: Foreign pot steel cost dozens of times ordinary steel—not only because of distance and transport.

sentences.zh: 故鋼藥二者，必須購機自造。

translations.literal: Therefore steel and powder both had to be made by purchasing machinery.
translations.idiomatic: Steel and powder both had to be produced with purchased machinery.

sentences.zh: 雖物力困絀，終不敢畏難自沮，致已成之槍砲廠，有不全不備之弊。

translations.literal: Although material resources were strained, one dared not shrink from difficulty and discourage oneself, lest the rifle-and-cannon plants already established suffer the defect of being incomplete.
translations.idiomatic: Resources were tight, but he dared not be deterred by difficulty and leave the existing rifle-and-cannon plants incomplete.

sentences.zh: 故於上年即飭局員在漢口禮和洋行議定向德國格魯森廠添購無煙火藥機，每十點鐘能出火藥三十三磅，每年約出火藥五十頓，共價德銀十三萬六千八百馬克。

translations.literal: Therefore last year bureau staff were ordered at the Hankou Carlowitz foreign firm to negotiate adding purchase from Germany's Gruson works of smokeless-powder machinery able to produce thirty-three pounds of powder every ten hours, about fifty tons of powder each year, total price 136,800 German marks.
translations.idiomatic: Last year he ordered bureau staff at the Hankou Carlowitz foreign firm to negotiate adding smokeless-powder machinery from Germany's Gruson works—thirty-three pounds every ten hours, about fifty tons a year—for 136,800 German marks.

sentences.zh: 今機器已運至上海。

translations.literal: The machinery has now reached Shanghai.
translations.idiomatic: That machinery has now reached Shanghai.

sentences.zh: 上年又與禮和洋行訂購德國名廠煉罐子鋼機器全副，每日能煉罐子鋼二、三頓，鑄鋼機能鑄塊鋼，每塊重二頓，價值運保各費，共用德銀十三萬馬克，久已起運，即可到滬。

translations.literal: Last year a complete set of pot-steel refining machinery from a renowned German factory was also ordered through the Carlowitz foreign firm, able to refine two or three tons of pot steel daily; the steel-casting machinery could cast ingot steel in blocks of two tons each; price, transport, and insurance together totaled 130,000 German marks; shipment had long begun and would soon reach Shanghai.
translations.idiomatic: Last year he also ordered through Carlowitz a complete pot-steel refining plant from a leading German factory—two or three tons daily, with casting machinery for two-ton ingots—for 130,000 German marks including transport and insurance; it had long been shipped and would soon reach Shanghai.

sentences.zh: 至廠中侭制行營快砲，以備陸戰之用。

translations.literal: As for the plant, it only manufactured field quick-firing guns for land warfare.
translations.idiomatic: The plant had so far made only field quick-firing guns for land warfare.

sentences.zh: 因經費太絀，故於砲台之大砲，未經議及。

translations.literal: Because funds were too tight, the large guns for fort batteries had not yet been discussed.
translations.idiomatic: Funds were too tight to address the large guns for fort batteries.

sentences.zh: 外洋新式十二生的長快砲，安置沿江砲台，能施放有準，足禦敵艦。

translations.literal: Foreign new-style twelve-centimeter long quick-firing guns, placed in riverside fort batteries, could fire accurately and were sufficient to repel enemy ships.
translations.idiomatic: Foreign new-style 12-centimeter long quick-firing guns in riverside batteries could fire accurately and repel enemy ships.

sentences.zh: 上年由出使德國大臣許景澄在力拂廠訂購十二生的快砲並架彈等機，共用德銀三十二萬五千馬克，機器月內可到。

translations.literal: Last year Minister to Germany Xu Jingcheng ordered at the Lifu works twelve-centimeter quick-firing guns plus carriage and shell machinery, totaling 325,000 German marks; the machinery would arrive within the month.
translations.idiomatic: Last year Minister to Germany Xu Jingcheng ordered 12-centimeter quick-firing guns plus carriage and shell machinery from the Lifu works for 325,000 German marks; the machinery would arrive within the month.

sentences.zh: 以上各機，皆屬無款可籌，不得不與洋商婉商墊欠，分期歸款，庶可及早舉辦。

translations.literal: All the machinery above had no funds that could be raised; one had no choice but to negotiate tactfully with foreign merchants for advance credit and repayment by installments, so that work could begin early.
translations.idiomatic: None of this machinery had allocated funds; he had no choice but to negotiate advance credit from foreign merchants and repay in installments so work could begin promptly.

sentences.zh: 加以添購大小新式樣砲、碾銅板機、拉鋼機、壓鋼機、大汽錘以及添配最精之鋼模樣板等件，約須銀十數萬兩。

translations.literal: Adding purchase of large and small new-style guns, copper-plate rolling machinery, steel-drawing machinery, steel-pressing machinery, large steam hammers, and the finest steel pattern plates and the like would require about several hundred thousand taels.
translations.idiomatic: Adding large and small new-style guns, copper-plate rolling machinery, steel-drawing and steel-pressing machinery, large steam hammers, and the finest steel pattern plates would cost several hundred thousand taels more.

sentences.zh: 再加增建廠屋，又需銀十餘萬兩。

translations.literal: Adding new plant buildings would require more than 100,000 taels.
translations.idiomatic: New plant buildings would require more than 100,000 taels more.

sentences.zh: 其增雇華、洋工匠常年製造工料之費，為數甚鉅，又需銀二十三萬兩。

translations.literal: The cost of added Chinese and foreign craftsmen for regular manufacture and materials was very large, requiring another 230,000 taels.
translations.idiomatic: Hiring additional Chinese and foreign craftsmen and paying for regular materials would require another 230,000 taels.

sentences.zh: 各款均無所出。

translations.literal: None of these funds had a source.
translations.idiomatic: There was no source for any of these funds.

sentences.zh: 如上海製造局年撥八十萬兩，嗣因添制快槍，並加撥常年工作之需，每年用款已逾百萬兩。

translations.literal: For example the Shanghai Manufacturing Bureau received 800,000 taels annually; afterward because quick rifles were added and regular operating funds were increased, annual expenditure already exceeded one million taels.
translations.idiomatic: The Shanghai Manufacturing Bureau, for example, received 800,000 taels a year; after adding quick rifles and regular operating funds, annual spending already exceeded one million taels.

sentences.zh: 現在湖北廠所造槍砲子彈，比津局既逾數倍，比滬局亦復加多，近又添造無煙火藥，添煉罐子鋼，添造砲台所用十二生的大快砲，功用益廣，而常年經費僅土藥稅等三十六七萬兩，較滬局止及三分之一。

translations.literal: Now the Hubei plant's rifle, cannon, and shell output already exceeded the Tianjin bureau several times over and the Shanghai bureau as well; recently it had added smokeless powder, pot-steel refining, and twelve-centimeter large quick-firing guns for fort batteries—the scope of work grew ever wider—yet regular funding was only about 360,000–370,000 taels from the native opium tax and the like, only one-third of the Shanghai bureau.
translations.idiomatic: The Hubei plant already produced several times more rifles, cannon, and shells than Tianjin and more than Shanghai as well; it had lately added smokeless powder, pot-steel refining, and 12-centimeter fort quick-firing guns—yet regular funding was only about 360,000–370,000 taels from the native opium tax and the like, just one-third of Shanghai's allotment.

sentences.zh: 惟有請加撥常年專款，符原估七十五六萬之數，庶可增料加工，使舊有各廠得盡機器之力，新增各廠早收美備之功。

translations.literal: One could only request added regular dedicated funds matching the original estimate of 750,000–760,000 taels, so that materials and labor could be increased and old plants could fully use their machinery while new plants could early reap the benefit of complete excellence.
translations.idiomatic: He could only ask for added regular dedicated funds matching the original estimate of 750,000–760,000 taels so materials and labor could expand, existing plants could fully use their machinery, and new plants could soon reach full capacity.

sentences.zh: 況近年武備最重，鄂廠調撥槍砲供給各處，為數甚多，造成槍砲，並非湖北一省之用。

translations.literal: Moreover in recent years military preparedness weighed heaviest; the Hubei plant dispatched rifles and cannon to supply many places—the rifles and cannon produced were not for Hubei province alone.
translations.idiomatic: Military preparedness weighed heaviest in recent years; the Hubei plant supplied rifles and cannon to many places—the output was not for Hubei alone.

sentences.zh: 事關全局，滬廠、鄂廠，理無二致，軍實要需，必多為籌備也。」

translations.literal: The matter concerned the whole situation; the Shanghai and Hubei plants should be treated alike; military stores were urgently needed and must be amply provided."
translations.idiomatic: This concerned the whole empire; Shanghai and Hubei should be treated alike, and military stores urgently needed fuller funding."

translations.literal: (closing quotation mark in the source.)
translations.idiomatic: (closing quotation mark in the source.)

sentences.zh: 二十四年，山西巡撫胡聘之以山西省向無機器製造局，亟宜籌辦。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, Shanxi Governor Hu Pinyi reported that Shanxi had never had a machine manufacturing bureau and should urgently be provided one.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 24 (1898), Shanxi Governor Hu Pinyi reported that Shanxi had never had a machine manufacturing bureau and one should urgently be established.

sentences.zh: 因派員赴天津向洋商定購製造槍砲各種機件，並酌建廠屋，雇集工匠，仿洋式自行製造。

translations.literal: Staff were therefore dispatched to Tianjin to order from foreign merchants various machine parts for manufacturing rifles and cannon, and plant buildings were planned, craftsmen hired, and foreign-style manufacture carried out on one's own.
translations.idiomatic: He dispatched staff to Tianjin to order rifle-and-cannon machinery from foreign merchants, planned plant buildings, hired craftsmen, and began foreign-style local manufacture.

sentences.zh: 在省城北關外擇地建廠。

translations.literal: A site outside the north gate of the provincial capital was chosen to build the plant.
translations.idiomatic: A site outside the provincial capital's north gate was chosen for the plant.

sentences.zh: 因山西僻在內地，非通商口岸，凡辦料募匠等事，用費極昂，即以歸化城關稅盈餘之款撥用。

translations.literal: Because Shanxi lay remote in the interior and was not a treaty port, all matters of procuring materials and recruiting craftsmen were extremely costly; the surplus from Guihuacheng customs revenue would be allocated for use.
translations.idiomatic: Shanxi lay remote in the interior, not a treaty port, so procuring materials and hiring craftsmen was extremely costly; funding would come from Guihuacheng customs surpluses.

sentences.zh: 各機器運到晉省，開廠興工。

translations.literal: When all machinery reached Shanxi, the plant opened and work began.
translations.idiomatic: Once the machinery reached Shanxi, the plant opened and work began.

sentences.zh: 山東巡撫張汝梅以山東省機器局自創造至今，並未延聘西人，而內地風氣初開，其精於製造人員，實不多見。

translations.literal: Shandong Governor Zhang Rumei reported that since the Shandong Machine Bureau was founded it had never employed Westerners, and with inland customs only beginning to open, personnel skilled in manufacture were truly not often seen.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong Governor Zhang Rumei reported that since the Shandong Machine Bureau was founded it had never employed Westerners, and with inland industry only beginning, skilled manufacturing personnel were scarce.

sentences.zh: 且所造全系銅鐵硝磺等火器，局員工匠，素鮮經驗，非洋匠專門之比，稍一不慎，即有損傷炸裂之虞，至難極險，與尋常差使不同，乃量予獎敘。

translations.literal: Moreover what was manufactured was entirely ordnance of copper, iron, saltpeter, sulfur, and the like; bureau staff and craftsmen had little experience and were not comparable to specialized foreign artisans; the slightest carelessness brought risk of injury and explosion—it was extremely difficult and dangerous, unlike ordinary assignments—so rewards were granted in measured degree.
translations.idiomatic: Everything produced was ordnance of copper, iron, saltpeter, and sulfur; bureau staff and craftsmen had little experience and were no match for specialized foreign artisans.
