The slightest mistake risked injury or explosion—the work was extraordinarily difficult and dangerous, unlike ordinary duty—so he granted measured rewards.

sentences.zh: 直隸總督裕祿以北洋之軍械共有二局，一為機器局，一為製造局。

translations.literal: Governor-General Yu Lu of Zhili reported that Beiyang ordnance had two bureaus in all: one the Machine Bureau, one the Manufacturing Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Yu Lu of Zhili reported that Beiyang ordnance had two bureaus: a Machine Bureau and a Manufacturing Bureau.

sentences.zh: 機器局所有制造火藥、毛瑟槍子銅帽、各式後膛砲彈及硝磺鏹水、雷電器具、卷銅鍊鋼等機，每年能造黑色火藥七十餘萬磅，栗色火藥二十五萬餘磅，棉花火藥五萬餘磅，無煙火藥八千餘磅，毛瑟後膛槍子四百餘萬粒，銅帽火二千八百餘萬粒，鋼彈一千二百顆，大小砲子一萬四千餘顆。

translations.literal: The Machine Bureau had machinery for manufacturing powder, Mauser rifle copper caps, various breech-loading cannon shells, saltpeter, aqua fortis, lightning equipment, copper rolling, steel refining, and the like; each year it could make more than 700,000 pounds of black powder, more than 250,000 pounds of brown powder, more than 50,000 pounds of cotton powder, more than 8,000 pounds of smokeless powder, more than 4 million Mauser breech-loading rifle rounds, more than 28 million copper-cap primers, 1,200 steel shells, and more than 14,000 cannonballs large and small.
translations.idiomatic: The Machine Bureau made powder, Mauser rifle caps, various breech-loading shells, saltpeter, aqua fortis, lightning equipment, and copper-rolling and steel-refining machinery; annually it could produce more than 700,000 pounds of black powder, 250,000 pounds of brown powder, 50,000 pounds of cotton powder, 8,000 pounds of smokeless powder, more than 4 million Mauser breech-loading rounds, more than 28 million cap primers, 1,200 steel shells, and more than 14,000 cannonballs large and small.

sentences.zh: 製造局每年能造七生的半開花砲子一萬二千顆，銅件一萬六千副，克魯伯鐵身砲車十具，銅管拉火二萬四千枝，哈乞砲子五萬餘顆，哈乞開司槍子二百十萬餘粒，雲者士得槍子一百四十餘萬粒。

translations.literal: The Manufacturing Bureau each year could make 12,000 seven-and-a-half-centimeter explosive shells, 16,000 sets of copper fittings, ten Krupp iron-body gun carriages, 24,000 copper-tube primers, more than 50,000 Hotchkiss shells, more than 2.1 million Hotchkiss rifle rounds, and more than 1.4 million Werndl rifle rounds.
translations.idiomatic: The Manufacturing Bureau could produce 12,000 7.5-centimeter explosive shells, 16,000 sets of copper fittings, ten Krupp iron gun carriages, 24,000 copper primers, more than 50,000 Hotchkiss shells, more than 2.1 million Hotchkiss rifle rounds, and more than 1.4 million Werndl rifle rounds each year.

sentences.zh: 而外洋所出軍械，日新月異。

translations.literal: But foreign ordnance produced changed day by day with the month.
translations.idiomatic: But foreign ordnance changed month by month.

sentences.zh: 今各路軍營所用毛瑟快槍、小口毛瑟槍、格魯森五生的過山快砲、克魯伯七生的半陸路行營快砲、七生的過山快砲，頗為合用，宜次第仿造。

translations.literal: Now the Mauser quick rifles, small-bore Mauser rifles, Gruson five-centimeter mountain quick-firing guns, Krupp seven-and-a-half-centimeter field quick-firing guns, and seven-centimeter mountain quick-firing guns used by armies on various routes were quite suitable and should be copied in sequence.
translations.idiomatic: The Mauser quick rifles, small-bore Mauser rifles, Gruson 5-centimeter mountain quick-firing guns, Krupp 7.5-centimeter field quick-firing guns, and 7-centimeter mountain quick-firing guns used by armies on various routes were quite suitable and should be copied in turn.

sentences.zh: 兩江總督劉坤一以江南省製造局之後膛抬槍，上海製造局之快利新槍，及大小砲位，均稱合用。

translations.literal: Governor-General Liu Kunyi of the Two Jiangs reported that the breech-loading wall guns of the Jiangnan Manufacturing Bureau, the Kuaili new rifles of the Shanghai Manufacturing Bureau, and cannon large and small were all called suitable.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Liu Kunyi of the Two Jiangs reported that the Jiangnan bureau's breech-loading wall guns, the Shanghai bureau's Kuaili new rifles, and cannon large and small were all judged serviceable.

sentences.zh: 金陵局機器無多，凡大宗軍火，胥由上海製造局供用。

translations.literal: The Jinling bureau had little machinery; all bulk ordnance was supplied by the Shanghai Manufacturing Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: The Jinling bureau had little machinery; bulk ordnance all came from the Shanghai Manufacturing Bureau.

sentences.zh: 近年增設煉銅廠、栗色火藥廠、無煙火藥廠三處，其所制砲，有十二磅子六磅子二種快砲，與北洋所用快砲口徑相同。

translations.literal: In recent years three plants were added—a copper-refining plant, a brown-powder plant, and a smokeless-powder plant; the cannon they made included twelve-pounder and six-pounder quick-firing guns, the same calibers as Beiyang quick-firing guns.
translations.idiomatic: Three plants were added in recent years—a copper-refining plant, a brown-powder plant, and a smokeless-powder plant; their cannon included 12-pounder and 6-pounder quick-firing guns of the same caliber as Beiyang quick-firing guns.

sentences.zh: 惟北洋之七生的快砲，湖北之三生的七快砲，南洋之六生的快砲，若購自外洋，終非久計。

translations.literal: Only Beiyang's seven-centimeter quick-firing guns, Hubei's 3.7-centimeter quick-firing guns, and the Nanyang six-centimeter quick-firing guns—if purchased abroad—would never be a long-term plan.
translations.idiomatic: But Beiyang's 7-centimeter quick-firing guns, Hubei's 3.7-centimeter quick-firing guns, and Nanyang's 6-centimeter quick-firing guns could not rely on foreign purchase forever.

sentences.zh: 乃擬增換機爐，自行製備，專精仿造。

translations.literal: It was therefore proposed to add and replace furnaces and machinery, prepare them on one's own, and specialize in imitation manufacture.
translations.idiomatic: He therefore proposed upgrading furnaces and machinery to build them locally and specialize in imitation production.

sentences.zh: 所有槍砲子彈，與天津、湖北二廠咸歸一律。

translations.literal: All rifle, cannon, and shell production would be brought into uniformity with the Tianjin and Hubei plants.
translations.idiomatic: All rifle, cannon, and shell production would be standardized with the Tianjin and Hubei plants.

sentences.zh: 四川總督文光因前奉朝旨，令四川製造局漸次擴充。

translations.literal: Sichuan Governor Wen Guang, because of a former court order to expand the Sichuan Manufacturing Bureau gradually, reported accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan Governor Wen Guang reported that under a former court order the Sichuan Manufacturing Bureau was to expand gradually.

sentences.zh: 前督臣恭壽擬就川省原有機器局擴充製造，不必另設局廠。

translations.literal: Former Governor Gong Shou had proposed expanding manufacture at Sichuan's existing machine bureau without establishing a separate bureau or plant.
translations.idiomatic: Former Governor Gong Shou had proposed expanding the province's existing machine bureau rather than founding a separate plant.

sentences.zh: 但機器局雖創設多年，而規制未宏，若欲廣制槍砲，殊不敷用。

translations.literal: But although the machine bureau had been founded many years ago, its scale was not large; if one wished broadly to manufacture rifles and cannon, it would truly not suffice.
translations.idiomatic: Although the machine bureau had existed for years, it was still small; it could not support large-scale rifle and cannon production.

sentences.zh: 乃擬增置長刨床一部，小車床及壓銅機器、引長機器、齊口機器各四部，緊口機器二部，均已一律制全，靈動堅固，與購自外洋者不異。

translations.literal: It was therefore proposed to add one long planing machine, four small lathes and copper-pressing, drawing, and facing machines each, and two tightening machines—all already fully built, nimble and solid, no different from those purchased abroad.
translations.idiomatic: He therefore proposed adding one long planing machine, four each of small lathes and copper-pressing, drawing, and facing machines, and two tightening machines—all already completed, nimble and solid, no different from foreign purchases.

sentences.zh: 惟機器既已增加，則製造亦宜推廣，應加常年經費銀二萬兩，以備製造之需。

translations.literal: Since machinery had already been added, manufacture should likewise be expanded; regular annual funds of 20,000 taels of silver should be added to meet manufacturing needs.
translations.idiomatic: Since new machinery had been added, production should be expanded as well—20,000 taels in regular annual funding should be added to meet manufacturing needs.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，湖廣總督張之洞上言：「軍實最為急需，利器必須完備，近日鍊鋼造藥，尤為槍砲廠必不可少之需，無罐子鋼則槍砲不精，非無煙藥則槍砲無用。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, Governor-General Zhang Zhidong of Huguang memorialized: "Military materiel is the most urgent need; serviceable weapons must be fully provided. Recently steel refining and powder manufacture are especially indispensable needs for rifle and cannon plants; without crucible steel rifles and cannon are not fine; without smokeless powder rifles and cannon are useless.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 25 (1899), Governor-General Zhang Zhidong of Huguang wrote: "Military supplies are the most urgent need, and serviceable weapons must be fully provided. Steel refining and powder manufacture have become indispensable to rifle and cannon plants; without crucible steel, rifles and cannon lack precision; without smokeless powder, they are useless.

sentences.zh: 屢經奉旨，責令湖北與上海各局，趕造軍械，供京營之用。

translations.literal: Repeatedly by imperial order, Hubei and Shanghai bureaus were ordered to hurry manufacture of military equipment for the capital garrison's use.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial orders had repeatedly directed the Hubei and Shanghai bureaus to rush production of arms for the capital garrison.

sentences.zh: 而籌款艱難，何從趕辦。

translations.literal: Yet raising funds was difficult—how could one hurry the work?
translations.idiomatic: But raising funds was difficult—how could they hurry the work?

sentences.zh: 前所請加撥宜昌關稅銀五萬兩，仍請照撥，俾購機建廠製造等事，徐底於成。

translations.literal: The previously requested additional allotment of 50,000 taels from Yichang customs duties was again requested to be granted as asked, so that buying machinery, building plants, and manufacturing might gradually be brought to completion.
translations.idiomatic: He again asked that the previously requested supplemental allotment of 50,000 taels from Yichang customs duties be granted, so machinery purchases, plant construction, and manufacturing could gradually be completed.

sentences.zh: 上海製造局新增鋼藥三廠，每年加撥經費銀二十萬兩，鄂廠事同一律，舊設各廠，經費本屬不敷，新廠所需，更無從出。

translations.literal: The Shanghai Manufacturing Bureau had added three steel and powder plants with an additional annual appropriation of 200,000 taels; the Hubei plant should follow the same rule—the existing plants' funds were already insufficient, and those needed for new plants had no source.
translations.idiomatic: The Shanghai bureau had added three steel and powder plants with a supplemental annual appropriation of 200,000 taels; the Hubei plant should receive the same treatment—existing plants were already underfunded, and there was no source for new plants.

sentences.zh: 若從部議，不得動用關稅，則製造將無可措手。

translations.literal: If one followed the board's decision and could not use customs duties, manufacture would have no way to proceed.
translations.idiomatic: If the board's decision barred use of customs duties, production would have no way to proceed.

sentences.zh: 綜計新廠需款共二十餘萬兩，但能加撥宜昌稅銀五萬，當設法周轉，不使廠務停滯也。」

translations.literal: Altogether the new plants required more than 200,000 taels, but if 50,000 taels of Yichang tax silver could be added, one would find means to keep funds in circulation so that plant work would not stall."
translations.idiomatic: The new plants would need more than 200,000 taels altogether, but with the supplemental 50,000 taels from Yichang customs, he would find ways to keep funds moving so plant operations would not stall."

sentences.zh: 吉林將軍延茂于吉林省機器局增置機器，並代造黑龍江鎮邊軍及靖邊新軍各營軍火。

translations.literal: Jilin General Yan Mao at the Jilin Machine Bureau added machinery and also manufactured ordnance on behalf of the Heilongjiang Frontier Defense Army and each battalion of the Jingbian New Army.
translations.idiomatic: Jilin General Yan Mao added machinery at the Jilin Machine Bureau and also produced ordnance for the Heilongjiang Frontier Defense Army and the battalions of the Jingbian New Army.

sentences.zh: 山東巡撫毓賢擴充東省機器局，增建製造新槍大廠、造槍子廠、熟鐵廠、軋銅廠、化銅廠、泥工廠、軍火庫房、水龍廠房、法藍爐房、儲器房。

translations.literal: Shandong Governor Yu Xian expanded the Shandong Machine Bureau, adding a large new-rifle plant, a rifle-round plant, a wrought-iron plant, a copper-rolling plant, a copper-refining plant, a masonry plant, ordnance storehouses, a fire-engine building, an enamel-furnace building, and a storage building.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong Governor Yu Xian expanded the provincial machine bureau, adding a large new-rifle plant, a rifle-round plant, a wrought-iron plant, a copper-rolling plant, a copper-refining plant, a masonry plant, ordnance storehouses, a fire-engine building, an enamel-furnace building, and a storage building.

sentences.zh: 又造大小磚鐵煙筒鐵柵等件。

translations.literal: Brick and iron chimneys, iron fences, and other items large and small were also made.
translations.idiomatic: It also produced brick and iron chimneys, iron fences, and other items large and small.

sentences.zh: 黑龍江將軍恩澤上言：「黑龍江鎮邊軍，每年由練餉內提銀三萬兩充軍火經費，歸吉林機器局兼造。

translations.literal: Heilongjiang General Enze memorialized: "The Heilongjiang Frontier Defense Army each year drew 30,000 taels from drill pay for ordnance expenses, with manufacture entrusted to the Jilin Machine Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Heilongjiang General Enze wrote: "The Heilongjiang Frontier Defense Army drew 30,000 taels each year from drill pay for ordnance expenses, with production handled by the Jilin Machine Bureau.

sentences.zh: 近年物料昂貴，實不敷用。

translations.literal: In recent years materials had grown costly and truly did not suffice.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years materials had grown costly and the funds no longer sufficed.

sentences.zh: 以新編之師，操練宜勤，軍火尤為繁巨。

translations.literal: With newly organized divisions, drill should be diligent, and ordnance needs were especially vast.
translations.idiomatic: With newly organized divisions requiring steady drill, ordnance needs were especially heavy.

sentences.zh: 應仿照奉天、吉林二省設局自造軍火成案，於黑龍江省城擇地設立專局，悉心製造。

translations.literal: Following the precedent of Fengtian and Jilin in establishing bureaus for self-manufacture of ordnance, a dedicated bureau should be chosen and established at a site in the Heilongjiang provincial capital for careful manufacture.
translations.idiomatic: Following the Fengtian and Jilin precedent of establishing local ordnance bureaus, a dedicated bureau should be set up in the Heilongjiang provincial capital for careful production.

sentences.zh: 此項購買機器建築廠房各費，約用銀十萬餘兩，在鎮邊新軍歲需軍火經費內分年籌撥。」

translations.literal: The costs of purchasing machinery and building plant buildings for this item would use about 100,000 taels, to be raised by annual allotments from the Jingbian New Army's yearly ordnance budget."
translations.idiomatic: Machinery purchases and plant construction would cost about 100,000 taels, to be raised by annual allotments from the Jingbian New Army's ordnance budget."

translations.literal: (closing quotation mark in the source.)
translations.idiomatic: (closing quotation mark in the source.)

sentences.zh: 是年，令各省疆臣，製造槍砲，為邊防第一要著。

translations.literal: That year, provincial governors and frontier officials were ordered that manufacturing rifles and cannon was the first priority for border defense.
translations.idiomatic: That year the court ordered provincial governors and frontier officials to make rifle and cannon production the first priority of border defense.

sentences.zh: 惟各省財力不齊，自應就原有局廠切實擴充，以備鄰近各省就近購用。

translations.literal: Only each province's financial strength differed; one should earnestly expand existing bureaus and plants so neighboring provinces could purchase nearby.
translations.idiomatic: Since each province's finances differed, existing bureaus and plants should be earnestly expanded so neighboring provinces could buy locally.

sentences.zh: 又令各疆臣：「天津、上海、江寧、湖北等處，均有制造槍砲局廠，曾令督撫臣切實會商，務將所制槍砲膛口，子彈大小，各局統歸一律，以期通用。

translations.literal: The frontier officials were again ordered: "At Tianjin, Shanghai, Jiangning, Hubei, and other places there are rifle and cannon manufacturing bureaus and plants; governors and governors-general were once ordered to confer earnestly and bring the bores of rifles and cannon made and the sizes of bullets at each bureau into uniform standard for mutual interchangeability.
translations.idiomatic: Frontier officials were again ordered: "Tianjin, Shanghai, Jiangning, Hubei, and other places all have rifle and cannon plants. Governors were once told to confer earnestly and standardize rifle and cannon bores and bullet sizes across bureaus for mutual interchangeability.

sentences.zh: 並將每年所造槍件子藥若干，據實上聞，並按季咨報戶部、神機營查核。

translations.literal: Each year the number of rifle parts and rounds manufactured should be reported truthfully to the throne, and each quarter reported to the Board of Revenue and the Shenji Camp for verification.
translations.idiomatic: Each year's rifle parts and ammunition produced should be truthfully reported to the throne and quarterly to the Board of Revenue and the Shenji Camp for verification.

sentences.zh: 乃為時已久，並未據報有案。

translations.literal: Yet a long time had passed without any reported case on file.
translations.idiomatic: Yet a long time had passed without any such reports on file.

sentences.zh: 槍砲為行軍要需，豈容因循延宕。」

translations.literal: Rifles and cannon were essential for campaigning—how could delay and procrastination be tolerated?"
translations.idiomatic: Rifles and cannon were essential to campaigning—delay could not be tolerated."

sentences.zh: 令裕祿、劉坤一、張之洞：「詳析查明各廠局所造槍砲，究系何項名目，是否業已會商，造成一律，迅即切實復陳。

translations.literal: Yulu, Liu Kunyi, and Zhang Zhidong were ordered: "Investigate in detail what designations the rifles and cannon made at each plant and bureau actually bear, whether consultation has already taken place, and whether manufacture has been unified; report back earnestly at once.
translations.idiomatic: Yulu, Liu Kunyi, and Zhang Zhidong were ordered: "Investigate in detail what types of rifles and cannon each plant produces, whether consultation has taken place, and whether production has been unified; report back earnestly at once.

sentences.zh: 嗣後仍遵前旨，按年按季分別奏咨，毋得延緩。

translations.literal: Thereafter still follow the former order, reporting separately by year and by quarter in memorials and dispatches, and do not delay.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter they were to follow the former order, reporting annually and quarterly in memorials and dispatches without delay.

sentences.zh: 各督撫督率承辦各員，認真經理，精益求精。

translations.literal: Each governor and governor-general should supervise the responsible officials, manage earnestly, and refine without cease.
translations.idiomatic: Each governor and governor-general was to supervise responsible officials, manage earnestly, and keep improving quality.

sentences.zh: 並將槍砲膛口子彈，彼此比較畫一，務令不差累黍，庶各省互相接濟，臨時不致缺誤。

translations.literal: Rifle and cannon bores and bullets should be compared with one another and unified, striving that they differ not even by the smallest measure, so that provinces might aid one another and not fail in emergency.
translations.idiomatic: Rifle and cannon bores and bullets were to be compared and standardized to the smallest measure, so provinces could support one another and not fail in an emergency.

sentences.zh: 倘管理局員草率從事，虛糜經費，或演放時有炸裂等事，治以重罪。」

translations.literal: If managing bureau officials worked perfunctorily, wasted funds in vain, or explosions and the like occurred during test firing, they would be punished with severe penalties."
translations.idiomatic: If bureau managers worked carelessly, wasted funds, or explosions occurred during test firing, they would face severe punishment."

sentences.zh: 旋經兩江總督劉坤一覆陳：「當飭滬、寧二處製造局員，將出入款項，核實勾稽，製造軍械，詳細考究。

translations.literal: Thereupon Governor-General Liu Kunyi of the Two Jiangs reported in reply: "The manufacturing bureau officials at Shanghai and Jiangning were ordered to audit receipts and expenditures in truth, and to study ordnance manufacture in detail.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Liu Kunyi of the Two Jiangs then replied: "He had ordered the Shanghai and Jiangning bureau officials to audit receipts and expenditures and to study ordnance production in detail.

sentences.zh: 並令與天津機器局、湖北槍砲廠隨時知照，互相講求。

translations.literal: They were also ordered to keep the Tianjin Machine Bureau and Hubei Rifle and Cannon Plant informed at all times and to seek improvement together.
translations.idiomatic: They were also to keep the Tianjin Machine Bureau and Hubei Rifle and Cannon Plant informed and to work together on improvements.

sentences.zh: 復由上海製造局員馳赴湖北比較數次，兩局所製成槍砲子彈，格式分量，口徑大小，一律合膛，並無歧異。

translations.literal: Shanghai Manufacturing Bureau officials also hurried to Hubei several times for comparison; the rifles, cannon, and bullets finished at the two bureaus matched in pattern, weight, and caliber without discrepancy.
translations.idiomatic: Shanghai bureau officials also traveled to Hubei several times for comparison; rifles, cannon, and bullets from the two bureaus matched in pattern, weight, and caliber without discrepancy.

sentences.zh: 惟江寧製造局所造後膛抬槍，系出新創，各省槍械，均無此式。

translations.literal: Only the breech-loading wall guns made at the Jiangning Manufacturing Bureau were a newly created design; no other province had this pattern of firearm.
translations.idiomatic: Only the Jiangning bureau's breech-loading wall guns were a new design; no other province had this pattern.

sentences.zh: 其兩磅子、一磅子後膛快砲，亦與上海局中所造一律。

translations.literal: Its two-pounder and one-pounder breech-loading quick-firing guns were also uniform with those made at the Shanghai bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Its 2-pounder and 1-pounder breech-loading quick-firing guns also matched those made at the Shanghai bureau.

sentences.zh: 此外砲架、砲彈、各種槍子拉火等件，分解南北洋各軍應用。

translations.literal: Besides these, gun carriages, shells, various rifle rounds, primers, and other items were allocated for use by the northern and southern fleets.
translations.idiomatic: Gun carriages, shells, rifle rounds, primers, and other items were allocated to the northern and southern fleets.

sentences.zh: 以經費有限，未能加撥擴充。

translations.literal: Because funds were limited, additional allotments for expansion could not be made.
translations.idiomatic: Funds were limited, so no additional allotments for expansion could be made.

sentences.zh: 該局在江寧城外，粗具規模。

translations.literal: That bureau outside Jiangning city had roughly achieved scale.
translations.idiomatic: That bureau outside Jiangning city had reached a modest scale.

sentences.zh: 且居腹地形勝之區，一旦海上有事，在內地製造，接濟軍需，庶幾緩急足恃。

translations.literal: Moreover it lay in an interior region of strategic terrain; if trouble arose at sea, manufacture inland to supply military needs would perhaps suffice in urgency.
translations.idiomatic: It also lay in a strategically placed interior region; if trouble arose at sea, inland production could supply military needs in an emergency.

sentences.zh: 至上海製造局，並能造各項快砲，除砲台所用之大砲外，其所造四十磅一種，即北洋之十二生的快砲，其十二磅一種，即北洋之七生的半快砲，其六磅子一種，即北洋之五十七米里快砲，其兩磅子一種，即湖北三生的七快砲。

translations.literal: As for the Shanghai Manufacturing Bureau, it could also make various quick-firing guns; aside from large guns for fort batteries, its forty-pounder type was Beiyang's twelve-centimeter quick-firing gun, its twelve-pounder type was Beiyang's seven-and-a-half-centimeter quick-firing gun, its six-pounder type was Beiyang's fifty-seven-millimeter quick-firing gun, and its two-pounder type was Hubei's 3.7-centimeter quick-firing gun.
translations.idiomatic: The Shanghai bureau could also make various quick-firing guns; aside from large fort guns, its 40-pounder type matched Beiyang's 12-centimeter quick-firing gun, its 12-pounder matched Beiyang's 7.5-centimeter quick-firing gun, its 6-pounder matched Beiyang's 57-millimeter quick-firing gun, and its 2-pounder matched Hubei's 3.7-centimeter quick-firing gun.

sentences.zh: 洋廠名稱雖殊，其尺寸大小，則不差累黍。

translations.literal: Foreign plant names differed, but their dimensions did not vary by the smallest measure.
translations.idiomatic: Foreign plant names differed, but the dimensions matched to the smallest measure.

sentences.zh: 今由上海製造局派員與天津、湖北二局逐一比試，均無參差。

translations.literal: Now officials dispatched from the Shanghai Manufacturing Bureau compared them one by one with the Tianjin and Hubei bureaus, and there was no discrepancy.
translations.idiomatic: Officials from the Shanghai bureau had compared them one by one with the Tianjin and Hubei bureaus and found no discrepancy.

sentences.zh: 其快利新槍，系以舊機參用人工所造，亦頗便利。

translations.literal: Its Kuaili new rifles were made with old machinery supplemented by manual labor and were also quite convenient.
translations.idiomatic: Its Kuaili new rifles were made with old machinery supplemented by hand work and were fairly convenient.

sentences.zh: 究嫌費用多而出槍少，去年飭各軍改用小口徑毛瑟快槍。

translations.literal: Ultimately it was regretted that costs were high and rifle output low; last year all armies were ordered to switch to small-caliber Mauser quick-firing rifles.
translations.idiomatic: They were costly and output was low; last year all armies were ordered to switch to small-caliber Mauser quick-firing rifles.

sentences.zh: 本擬訂造此種槍枝及造槍彈機器，專一仿製，以歸一律。

translations.literal: It was originally planned to order machinery for this type of rifle and rifle-round manufacture and specialize in imitation to achieve uniformity.
translations.idiomatic: The plan was to order machinery for this rifle and its ammunition and specialize in imitation to achieve uniformity.

sentences.zh: 訪之上海各洋行，需款數十萬，為期且甚久，一時無此財力。

translations.literal: Inquiring at Shanghai foreign firms, several hundred thousand taels were needed and the term was also very long; for the moment there was no such financial strength.
translations.idiomatic: Inquiries at Shanghai foreign firms showed several hundred thousand taels would be needed over a long period—beyond current means.

sentences.zh: 遂仍用舊機，更易機簧，添配車座，訂購改造七米里之毛瑟槍枝槍彈等件，按照合同，每日可出槍十枝。

translations.literal: Therefore old machinery was still used, springs were replaced, carriages were added, and conversion to seven-millimeter Mauser rifles and rifle rounds was ordered; according to contract, ten rifles could be produced daily.
translations.idiomatic: Old machinery was therefore retained, with springs replaced and carriages added, and conversion to 7-millimeter Mauser rifles and ammunition was ordered; under contract, ten rifles could be produced daily.

sentences.zh: 俟安裝全備，即日開工，嚴定章程，按年按季上聞，以期核實。

translations.literal: Once installation was fully complete, work would begin that day; regulations would be strictly fixed, and reports made by year and by quarter to the throne for verification.
translations.idiomatic: Once installation was complete, work would begin at once; regulations would be fixed and reports made annually and quarterly to the throne for verification.

sentences.zh: 各局兼造各項快砲，均系新式，尚敷應用。

translations.literal: The various quick-firing guns made at each bureau were all new patterns and still sufficed for use.
translations.idiomatic: The quick-firing guns made at each bureau were all new patterns and still sufficed for use.

sentences.zh: 至仿造小口徑毛瑟槍，僅有湖北、上海二廠，其機器一系新購專門，一系舊式更改，能力所限，每年造槍不多，各路軍營，恐難遍給。

translations.literal: As for imitation of small-caliber Mauser rifles, only the Hubei and Shanghai plants existed; one's machinery was newly purchased and specialized, the other's was converted from old equipment; limited in capacity, annual rifle output was not great, and army camps on every route would probably be hard to supply throughout.
translations.idiomatic: Only the Hubei and Shanghai plants imitated small-caliber Mauser rifles—one with newly purchased specialized machinery, the other with converted old equipment. Capacity was limited, annual output was modest, and camps on every route would be hard to supply fully.

sentences.zh: 曾與直隸、湖廣督臣商酌添購造槍新機，無論在津、鄂、寧、滬何廠承造，均以款絀，未能即行擴充。

translations.literal: Consultation had been held with the governors of Zhili and Huguang on adding purchases of new rifle-making machinery; whether manufacture was undertaken at Tianjin, Hubei, Jiangning, or Shanghai, funds were short and expansion could not be carried out at once.
translations.idiomatic: He had consulted the governors of Zhili and Huguang on buying new rifle-making machinery, but whether production was at Tianjin, Hubei, Jiangning, or Shanghai, funds were short and expansion could not proceed at once.

sentences.zh: 南洋軍火經費，但期洋稅暢收，並竭力撙節，另款存儲，以備添置仿造小口徑毛瑟槍機器一部，能數年之內，機器購全，與湖北槍砲廠分途仿造，以期器械日精。

translations.literal: For Nanyang ordnance funds, it was hoped only that foreign-tax receipts would flow smoothly, and that through strenuous economy separate funds would be stored to prepare for adding a set of machinery for imitating small-caliber Mauser rifles, so that within a few years machinery could be fully purchased and imitation carried out separately from the Hubei Rifle and Cannon Plant, expecting arms to grow daily finer.
translations.idiomatic: For Nanyang ordnance funds, he hoped foreign-tax receipts would remain strong and that through strict economy separate funds could be saved to buy machinery for small-caliber Mauser rifles, so that within a few years equipment could be fully purchased and imitation carried out alongside the Hubei Rifle and Cannon Plant, with arms growing steadily finer.

translations.idiomatic: He also proposed establishing a technical school to train men in shipbuilding, ordnance, rifles, cannon, torpedoes, mines, and related manufacture, to broaden the talent pool."

sentences.zh: 是年，浙江巡撫劉樹堂向金陵軍械所撥用德國老毛瑟槍三千枝，子彈一百五十萬顆，供浙省防軍之用。

translations.literal: That year, Zhejiang Governor Liu Shutang drew from the Jinling Ordnance Depot 3,000 old German Mauser rifles and 1,500,000 rounds for use by Zhejiang's defense forces.
translations.idiomatic: That year Zhejiang Governor Liu Shutang drew 3,000 old German Mauser rifles and 1,500,000 rounds from the Jinling Ordnance Depot for Zhejiang's defense forces.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，直隸總督裕祿上言：「北洋機器局經費，每年用銀二十五萬餘兩，所造軍火，向供北洋海軍及淮、練各營操防之用。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, Governor-General Yulu of Zhili memorialized: "The Beiyang Machine Bureau's funds used more than 250,000 taels of silver each year; the ordnance it made ordinarily supplied the Beiyang navy and the Huai and training camps for drill and defense.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 26 (1900), Governor-General Yulu of Zhili wrote: "The Beiyang Machine Bureau spent more than 250,000 taels each year; its ordnance ordinarily supplied the Beiyang navy and the Huai and training camps for drill and defense.

sentences.zh: 近年經費減收，而向例撥解軍火之外，又加以新練武衛等五大軍，而京師神機、虎槍等營，復時有調撥，每虞缺乏。

translations.literal: In recent years funds had decreased, yet besides the customary allocation of ordnance there were now added the five newly trained armies such as the Wuyi Army, and the Shenji, Huqiang, and other camps in the capital also had frequent transfers—shortages were feared at every turn.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years revenues had fallen, yet besides customary ordnance allocations there were now the five newly trained armies such as the Wuyi Army, and the Shenji, Huqiang, and other capital camps also required frequent transfers—shortages were feared at every turn.

sentences.zh: 況增募各軍，皆以快槍、快砲為利器，各項槍砲子彈，必須自行製造，始能不誤操防。

translations.literal: Moreover the newly recruited armies all took quick-firing rifles and quick-firing guns as their serviceable weapons; all rifle, cannon, and ammunition types had to be manufactured on one's own before drill and defense would not be impaired.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the newly recruited armies all relied on quick-firing rifles and guns; all rifle, cannon, and ammunition had to be manufactured locally to keep drill and defense on track.

sentences.zh: 因於光緒二十四年，始陸續購辦製造快砲快槍子彈及造無煙槍砲火藥等項機器，今始由外洋次第運至天津，安設入廠。

translations.literal: Therefore in Guangxu twenty-four machinery for manufacturing quick-firing gun and rifle rounds and smokeless rifle and cannon powder was gradually purchased; only now was it being transported in sequence from abroad to Tianjin and installed in the plant.
translations.idiomatic: Machinery for quick-firing gun and rifle rounds and smokeless rifle and cannon powder was therefore purchased gradually beginning in Guangxu 24 (1898); only now was it arriving from abroad at Tianjin for installation.

sentences.zh: 並派員赴上海、江寧等處，將各局所造快槍、快砲格式，及槍子、砲彈分量，互相討論，取到江南、湖北二局所造槍砲各種子彈，詳加比較，以求畫一。

translations.literal: Officials were also dispatched to Shanghai, Jiangning, and other places to discuss the patterns of quick-firing rifles and guns made at each bureau and the weights of rifle rounds and shells; samples of various rifle and cannon rounds from the Jiangnan and Hubei bureaus were obtained and compared in detail to seek uniformity.
translations.idiomatic: Officials were also sent to Shanghai, Jiangning, and other places to discuss quick-firing rifle and gun patterns and the weights of rifle rounds and shells; samples from the Jiangnan and Hubei bureaus were obtained and compared in detail to seek uniformity.

sentences.zh: 所有北洋增造快槍子廠、無煙火藥廠、快砲子廠，並整頓鍊鋼廠等項經費，每年至少須增用銀十五萬兩，應由部臣在各海關洋稅內加撥，以濟軍用。」

translations.literal: All funds for Beiyang's added quick-firing rifle-round plant, smokeless-powder plant, quick-firing shell plant, and reorganization of the steel-refining plant required at least 150,000 taels more each year; board officials should add allotments from foreign customs taxes at the various ports to meet military needs."
translations.idiomatic: Funds for Beiyang's added quick-firing rifle-round plant, smokeless-powder plant, quick-firing shell plant, and steel-refining reorganization would require at least 150,000 taels more each year; board officials should add allotments from port foreign customs taxes to meet military needs."

translations.idiomatic: (closing quotation mark in the source.)

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, Governor-General Liu Kunyi of the Two Jiangs supplied Guangxi military camps with new-pattern smokeless quick-firing rifles and wheeled quick-firing guns made by the Shanghai Manufacturing Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 28 (1902), Governor-General Liu Kunyi of the Two Jiangs supplied Guangxi camps with new smokeless quick-firing rifles and wheeled quick-firing guns made by the Shanghai Manufacturing Bureau.

sentences.zh: 四川總督奎俊以四川省機器局自光緒三年創建廠房，製造槍砲，五年停辦。

translations.literal: Sichuan Governor Kuijun reported that the Sichuan Machine Bureau had built plant buildings and manufactured rifles and cannon since Guangxu three, and ceased operation in the fifth year.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan Governor Kuijun reported that the Sichuan Machine Bureau had built plant buildings and manufactured rifles and cannon since Guangxu 3 (1877) and ceased operation in Guangxu 5 (1879).

sentences.zh: 六年奉旨復開局製造，並增修熟鐵鍋爐碾火藥各廠房，各洋火藥局，迄今二十餘年，所造軍械，成績頗多。

translations.literal: In the sixth year by imperial order manufacture was reopened, and wrought-iron, boiler, powder-grinding, and other plant buildings and foreign-powder bureaus were added and repaired; to the present more than twenty years had passed, and ordnance output had been considerable.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 6 (1880) manufacture reopened by imperial order, with wrought-iron, boiler, powder-grinding, and other plants and foreign-powder bureaus added and repaired; over twenty years since, ordnance output had been considerable.

sentences.zh: 而屋宇年久漸多朽壞，一律修造，以濟要工。

translations.literal: But buildings after many years had gradually grown dilapidated; all were to be repaired to meet urgent work.
translations.idiomatic: But buildings had gradually deteriorated over the years and were all to be repaired to meet urgent needs.

sentences.zh: 上年因擴充製造，已增設繪圖委員，既經培修各廠，乃增繪圖房、白火藥房各一所。

translations.literal: Last year, because manufacture was being expanded, drafting commissioners had been added; once the various plants had been repaired and expanded, one drafting room and one white-powder room were added.
translations.idiomatic: Last year, with manufacture expanding, drafting commissioners were added; once the plants were repaired and expanded, one drafting room and one white-powder room were added.

sentences.zh: 四川人心浮動，調撥威遠軍一營，常年駐守局旁，以資巡察。

translations.literal: Sichuan's populace was restless; one battalion of the Weiyuan Army was transferred to garrison the bureau year-round for patrol.
translations.idiomatic: Because Sichuan's populace was restless, one battalion of the Weiyuan Army was stationed at the bureau year-round for patrol.

sentences.zh: 並建修表碼廠一所，為演試槍砲之地。

translations.literal: One firing-range building was also built and repaired as a place for test-firing rifles and cannon.
translations.idiomatic: A firing range was also built and repaired for test-firing rifles and cannon.

sentences.zh: 閩浙總督許應騤以上年防務戒嚴，福建機器局製造槍子所需用魚子火藥，及海口砲台所用砲位藥餅，因外洋禁售軍火，乃採購土硝硫磺，以備製造。

translations.literal: Governor-General Xu Yingqi of Fujian and Zhejiang reported that last year, with coastal defense on alert, the pellet powder needed by the Fujian Machine Bureau for rifle rounds and the powder-charge cakes for fort batteries, because foreign countries forbade sale of ordnance, native saltpeter and sulfur were purchased to prepare manufacture.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Xu Yingqi of Fujian and Zhejiang reported that last year, with coastal defense on alert, the Fujian Machine Bureau needed pellet powder for rifle rounds and powder-charge cakes for fort batteries; because foreign countries forbade ordnance sales, native saltpeter and sulfur were purchased for manufacture.

sentences.zh: 復飭機器局，按照洋式，自造車輪快砲並快槍，共採買土硝七萬斤，硫磺一萬斤，自製成魚子洋式火藥五萬磅，各大砲藥餅六百九十三出，三磅子車輪快砲十二尊，十二磅子快砲二尊，後膛新式抬槍一百枝，修改後膛子輪快砲六尊，在海防經費內開支。

translations.literal: The machine bureau was again ordered, according to foreign patterns, to make wheeled quick-firing guns and quick-firing rifles on its own; 70,000 jin of native saltpeter and 10,000 jin of sulfur were purchased in all; 50,000 pounds of foreign-style pellet powder, 693 large-cannon powder-charge cakes, twelve three-pounder wheeled quick-firing guns, two twelve-pounder quick-firing guns, one hundred new-pattern breech-loading wall guns, and six modified breech-loading wheeled quick-firing guns were self-made—all charged to coastal-defense funds.
translations.idiomatic: The machine bureau was also ordered to build wheeled quick-firing guns and quick-firing rifles on foreign patterns; 70,000 jin of native saltpeter and 10,000 jin of sulfur were purchased; it produced 50,000 pounds of foreign-style pellet powder, 693 large-cannon powder-charge cakes, twelve 3-pounder wheeled quick-firing guns, two 12-pounder quick-firing guns, one hundred new breech-loading wall guns, and six modified breech-loading wheeled quick-firing guns—all charged to coastal-defense funds.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，兩江總督張之洞以滬上之制造局所有機器，七年以前所造，系林明登槍，乃外洋陳舊不用之式。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, Governor-General Zhang Zhidong of the Two Jiangs reported that with the machinery at the Shanghai manufacturing bureau, what was made more than seven years earlier was the Remington rifle—an obsolete foreign pattern no longer used.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 29 (1903), Governor-General Zhang Zhidong of the Two Jiangs reported that the Shanghai bureau's machinery had produced Remington rifles more than seven years earlier—an obsolete foreign pattern no longer used.

sentences.zh: 兩年以前所造，系快利槍，乃製造局臆造之式，亦不甚合用。

translations.literal: What was made within the last two years was the Kuaili rifle—a pattern improvised by the manufacturing bureau—and also not very suitable.
translations.idiomatic: Within the last two years it had produced Kuaili rifles—a pattern improvised by the bureau—and those were also not very suitable.

sentences.zh: 故槍械新舊湊配，出數無多，砲機亦未能完備，而歲費巨款，頗為可惜。

translations.literal: Therefore old and new firearms were mixed, output was not great, cannon machinery was also not complete, yet huge sums were spent yearly—quite regrettable.
translations.idiomatic: Old and new firearms were therefore mixed, output was modest, cannon machinery was incomplete, yet huge sums were spent each year—a waste.

sentences.zh: 當整頓武備之時，軍營所用槍械，宜歸一律。

translations.literal: At a time of reorganizing armaments, the firearms used in military camps should be unified.
translations.idiomatic: At a time of reorganizing armaments, camp firearms should be unified.

sentences.zh: 乃定議上海廠仿照湖北廠，改造小口徑新式毛瑟快槍。

translations.idiomatic: The Shanghai plant was therefore to follow the Hubei plant in converting to small-caliber new-pattern Mauser quick-firing rifles.

translations.literal: Only the Shanghai plant's rifle machinery could not be fully complete; manual labor had to be combined, costing much labor and producing few rifles.
translations.idiomatic: But the Shanghai plant's rifle machinery was incomplete; manual labor had to supplement it, costing much labor for modest output.

translations.literal: Although machinery had been added and reorganized in recent years, only seven rifles could be produced daily, about two thousand-odd per year—of no help to the larger cause of armaments.

translations.literal: The wheeled guns made at its cannon plant were also not very suitable; new rifle-making machinery capable of fifty thousand quick-firing rifles per year must be purchased, and new cannon-making machinery added capable of ten large platform guns and two hundred seven-and-a-half-centimeter quick-firing guns per year, so that after several years it might meet the demands of the provinces and achieve uniformity.

translations.idiomatic: A separate set of general-purpose machinery was also to be provided for adding parts and repairing plant machinery.

translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Chongshan of Fujian and Zhejiang reported that in Guangxu 25 (1899) Fujian moved back to the provincial capital at Shuimen the machinery previously transferred to the Mawei shipyard, specializing in fort-battery shells, explosive nails, and related items.

translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 26 (1900) land beside the machine bureau was expanded and one rifle-round plant building was added.
