translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 28 (1902) a separate manufacturing bureau was established outside Xiguan west of the provincial capital, specializing in smokeless quick-firing rifles.

sentences.zh: 其機器槍子二廠，自開辦至二十八年，止共用經費銀一十七萬八千餘兩，製成三磅子快砲二十四尊，與上海局所造砲同式，福字一號二號陸軍後膛快砲二尊，洋式十二磅半快砲二尊，而機簧標準，均不甚靈捷。

translations.literal: Its two machine and rifle-round plants, from opening to the twenty-eighth year, used only 178,000-odd taels in all; twenty-four three-pounder quick-firing guns were completed, the same pattern as Shanghai bureau guns; two Fu No. 1 and No. 2 army breech-loading quick-firing guns; two foreign-pattern twelve-and-a-half-pounder quick-firing guns—but springs and standards were all not very nimble.
translations.idiomatic: Its two machine and rifle-round plants, from opening through Guangxu 28 (1902), had used only 178,000-odd taels; they produced twenty-four 3-pounder quick-firing guns of the same pattern as Shanghai bureau guns, two Fu No. 1 and No. 2 army breech-loading quick-firing guns, and two foreign-pattern 12.5-pounder quick-firing guns—but springs and standards were not very nimble.

sentences.zh: 尚有修改船廠舊式陸路快砲四尊，福強軍後膛車砲六尊，製造新式後膛抬槍一百枝，改造短柄洋槍一百枝，製造各項後膛槍子三百二十餘萬顆。

translations.literal: There were also four modified old-pattern land quick-firing guns from the shipyard, six Fuqiang Army breech-loading field guns, one hundred new-pattern breech-loading wall guns manufactured, one hundred short-stocked foreign rifles converted, and more than 3,200,000 breech-loading rifle rounds of various types manufactured.
translations.idiomatic: They also modified four old-pattern land quick-firing guns from the shipyard, six Fuqiang Army breech-loading field guns, one hundred new breech-loading wall guns, and one hundred short-stocked foreign rifles, and produced more than 3,200,000 breech-loading rifle rounds of various types.

sentences.zh: 其餘修理各項洋槍，製造前膛砲子彈等件，為費甚多。

translations.literal: Besides these, repairs to various foreign rifles and manufacture of muzzle-loading cannon rounds and other items cost greatly.
translations.idiomatic: Repairs to various foreign rifles and manufacture of muzzle-loading cannon rounds and other items also cost greatly.

sentences.zh: 其機器槍子二廠，建設在水部門內人煙稠密之處，存儲軍火，大非所宜，不如西關外製造局地面寬大，不近民居。

translations.literal: Its two machine and rifle-round plants were built inside Shuimen in a densely populated place—storing ordnance there was greatly unsuitable; the manufacturing bureau outside Xiguan had broad ground and was not near dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: Its two machine and rifle-round plants stood inside Shuimen in a densely populated area—storing ordnance there was unsuitable; the manufacturing bureau outside Xiguan had ample space and was not near dwellings.

sentences.zh: 蓋製造槍砲，與製造子彈，本系一事，與其分廠而費大，不如合廠而費省。

translations.literal: For manufacturing rifles and cannon and manufacturing rounds were originally one matter; rather than separate plants with greater expense, merging plants would save expense.
translations.idiomatic: Manufacturing rifles and cannon and manufacturing rounds were originally one matter; merging plants would save expense rather than running separate plants at greater cost.

sentences.zh: 乃飭二廠一律暫行停造，歸併製造一局，將製成槍砲子彈及機件材料，妥為存儲。

translations.literal: Both plants were therefore ordered to suspend manufacture for the time being and merge into one manufacturing bureau; finished rifles, cannon, rounds, machinery parts, and materials were to be properly stored.
translations.idiomatic: Both plants were therefore ordered to suspend production temporarily and merge into one manufacturing bureau; finished rifles, cannon, rounds, machinery parts, and materials were to be properly stored.

sentences.zh: 其員役工匠，大加裁減，每年只造各式抬槍，及各式子彈，以備操防所用。

translations.literal: Its clerks, laborers, and artisans were greatly reduced; each year only various wall guns and various rounds would be made for drill and defense use.
translations.idiomatic: Staff and artisans were greatly reduced; each year only various wall guns and rounds would be made for drill and defense.

sentences.zh: 山東巡撫周馥以山東省為海防要地，而軍隊器械不足。

translations.literal: Shandong Governor Zhou Fu reported that Shandong province was a key coastal-defense area, yet army equipment was insufficient.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong Governor Zhou Fu reported that Shandong was a key coastal-defense area but army equipment was insufficient.

sentences.zh: 請向金陵製造局購新制三十七米里小快砲，湖北槍砲廠購格魯森五生的七過山快砲，並開花子彈。

translations.literal: He requested to purchase from the Jinling Manufacturing Bureau newly made thirty-seven-millimeter small quick-firing guns, and from the Hubei Rifle and Cannon Plant Gruson five-point-seven-centimeter mountain quick-firing guns, along with explosive shells.
translations.idiomatic: He asked to buy newly made 37-millimeter small quick-firing guns from the Jinling Manufacturing Bureau and Gruson 5.7-centimeter mountain quick-firing guns from the Hubei Rifle and Cannon Plant, along with explosive shells.

sentences.zh: 兩江總督張之洞以東西洋各國章程，於槍砲等件，每得新式，一律通行，其舊式軍械概行作廢。

translations.literal: Governor-General Zhang Zhidong of the Two Jiangs reported that in the regulations of Eastern and Western countries, whenever a new pattern of rifle, cannon, and the like was obtained, it was adopted uniformly and old-pattern arms were entirely discarded.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Zhang Zhidong of the Two Jiangs reported that in Eastern and Western practice, whenever a new rifle or cannon pattern was adopted, it was adopted uniformly and old arms were discarded.

sentences.zh: 今湖北、上海二局，一律專造小口徑毛瑟快槍，乃將上海製造局所存快利槍枝悉行報廢，期軍火日精。

translations.literal: Now the Hubei and Shanghai bureaus alike specialized exclusively in small-caliber Mauser quick-firing rifles; the Kuaili rifles stored at the Shanghai Manufacturing Bureau were therefore all written off as scrap, expecting ordnance to grow daily finer.
translations.idiomatic: The Hubei and Shanghai bureaus now specialized exclusively in small-caliber Mauser quick-firing rifles; the Shanghai bureau's stored Kuaili rifles were therefore all written off as scrap, expecting ordnance to grow steadily finer.

sentences.zh: 河南巡撫張人駿以河南省機器局製造軍械，規模未備，亟應增購槍砲子彈需用銅鐵各料，並自造毛瑟快槍、無煙火藥。

translations.literal: Henan Governor Zhang Renjun reported that the Henan Machine Bureau's ordnance manufacture was not yet fully scaled; copper, iron, and other materials needed for rifles, cannon, and rounds should urgently be purchased in greater quantity, and Mauser quick-firing rifles and smokeless powder should be made on one's own.
translations.idiomatic: Henan Governor Zhang Renjun reported that the Henan Machine Bureau was not yet fully scaled; copper, iron, and other materials for rifles, cannon, and rounds should urgently be purchased, and Mauser quick-firing rifles and smokeless powder should be made locally.

sentences.zh: 山東巡撫周馥以山東省機器局歷年造成各種西式槍枝火藥槍丸，今復採買外洋銅鐵各料，增造各廠機器爐房箱盒。

translations.literal: Shandong Governor Zhou Fu reported that the Shandong Machine Bureau over the years had made various Western-style rifles, powder, and balls; now foreign copper, iron, and other materials were again purchased, and machinery, furnaces, buildings, and boxes at the various plants were added.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong Governor Zhou Fu reported that the Shandong Machine Bureau had over the years produced various Western-style rifles, powder, and balls; it was now buying foreign copper, iron, and other materials and adding machinery, furnaces, buildings, and boxes at the various plants.

sentences.zh: 是年，以湖北漢陽廠仿格魯森新式所造五生的三及五生的七之開花砲彈二種，又曼利亞槍彈、黎意槍彈各槍拉火，撥毅軍備用。

translations.literal: That year, two types of explosive shells imitating the new Gruson pattern made at the Hubei Hanyang plant—the five-point-three-centimeter and five-point-seven-centimeter types—along with Mannlicher rifle rounds, Lee rifle rounds, and primers for each rifle, were allocated to the Yi Army for reserve use.
translations.idiomatic: That year two types of Gruson-pattern explosive shells—the 5.3-centimeter and 5.7-centimeter types—made at the Hubei Hanyang plant, along with Mannlicher and Lee rifle rounds and primers, were allocated to the Yi Army for reserve use.

sentences.zh: 福建機器局增造無煙火藥機器。

translations.literal: The Fujian Machine Bureau added smokeless-powder machinery.
translations.idiomatic: The Fujian Machine Bureau added smokeless-powder machinery.

sentences.zh: 三十年，河南巡撫陳夔龍以河南省原有機器局，因陋就簡，未能講求新法，請增購機器十部，及一切應用物件，併購兩磅銅砲胚二十尊，四磅銅砲胚十尊，以備自行製造，逐漸開拓。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year, Henan Governor Chen Kuilong reported that Henan's original machine bureau, making do with what was at hand, had not been able to pursue new methods; he requested purchase of ten additional machines and all needed items, together with twenty two-pounder copper gun blanks and ten four-pounder copper gun blanks, to prepare for self-manufacture and gradual expansion.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 30 (1904), Henan Governor Chen Kuilong reported that Henan's original machine bureau had made do with what was at hand and had not pursued new methods; he asked to buy ten additional machines and all needed items, along with twenty 2-pounder and ten 4-pounder copper gun blanks, to prepare for local manufacture and gradual expansion.

sentences.zh: 兩江總督魏光燾擴充金陵機器局，仿照外洋，製造各式砲位架具、炸彈銅火，及砲台需用各件，分設機器翻沙、鐵木、火箭各廠。

translations.literal: Governor-General Wei Guangtao of the Two Jiangs expanded the Jinling Machine Bureau; following foreign models, it manufactured various gun-mount fittings, explosive shells, copper primers, and items needed for fort batteries, establishing separate machine, sand-casting, iron-and-wood, and rocket plants.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Wei Guangtao of the Two Jiangs expanded the Jinling Machine Bureau; following foreign models, it manufactured gun-mount fittings, explosive shells, copper primers, and fort-battery items, establishing separate machine, sand-casting, iron-and-wood, and rocket plants.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，兵部議江南、天津、山東各處機器局，並金陵洋火藥局，所有運送軍裝軍火等運費，一律報部。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year, the Board of War deliberated that transport costs for military equipment and ordnance at the machine bureaus of Jiangnan, Tianjin, Shandong, and elsewhere, and the Jinling foreign-powder bureau, should all be reported to the board.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 31 (1905), the Board of War ruled that transport costs for military equipment and ordnance at the Jiangnan, Tianjin, Shandong, and other machine bureaus and the Jinling foreign-powder bureau should all be reported to the board.

sentences.zh: 四川總督錫良因奉部臣議，自光緒三十年以後，所有修整廠房機器，並造成機器火藥洋槍等件，遵新章呈報戶部。

translations.literal: Sichuan Governor Xi Liang, because of the board officials' deliberation, from Guangxu thirty onward reported to the Board of Revenue all repairs to plant buildings and machinery and all manufacture of machinery, powder, foreign rifles, and other items according to the new regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan Governor Xi Liang, following the board's ruling, reported to the Board of Revenue from Guangxu 30 (1904) onward all plant and machinery repairs and all production of machinery, powder, foreign rifles, and related items under the new regulations.

sentences.zh: 山東巡撫楊士驤以山東省機器局自創設以來，所造西式各種火藥大銅帽火，各種後膛槍來福槍，各式洋鉛丸，並增各廠機器爐房，尚不敷用。

translations.literal: Shandong Governor Yang Shixiang reported that since the Shandong Machine Bureau was established, the various Western-style gunpowder, large copper percussion caps, breech-loading rifles, rifles, and foreign lead balls it had made, together with the machinery and furnace buildings added at the various plants, were still insufficient.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong Governor Yang Shixiang reported that since the Shandong Machine Bureau was established, its output of Western-style gunpowder, large copper percussion caps, breech-loading rifles, rifles, and foreign lead balls, together with the machinery and furnace buildings added at the various plants, was still insufficient.

sentences.zh: 又採買外洋銅鐵物料，擴充製造。

translations.literal: Foreign copper and iron materials were again purchased to expand manufacture.
translations.idiomatic: Foreign copper and iron materials were purchased again to expand production.

sentences.zh: 河南巡撫陳夔龍擴充河南機器局，即開工製造槍砲子彈，以供軍實。

translations.literal: Henan Governor Chen Kuilong expanded the Henan Machine Bureau and immediately began manufacturing rifles, cannon, and bullets to supply military stores.
translations.idiomatic: Henan Governor Chen Kuilong expanded the Henan Machine Bureau and immediately began manufacturing rifles, cannon, and bullets to supply the army.

sentences.zh: 是年，戶部定議，通飭各省所有機器製造局，以後如採購物料，必報部核銷。

translations.literal: That year, the Board of Revenue fixed a rule ordering all machine manufacturing bureaus in every province that hereafter, when purchasing materials, they must report to the board for audit and reimbursement.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Board of Revenue ruled that every provincial machine manufacturing bureau must report material purchases to the board for audit and reimbursement.

sentences.zh: 三十二年，四川總督錫良綜核機器局成績，續造機器槍械、蜀利抬槍、利川手槍等一百有四起，火藥二萬餘斤，馬梯尼槍彈、毛瑟槍彈三十餘萬顆。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year, Sichuan Governor Xi Liang reviewed the machine bureau's results and continued manufacture of one hundred and four sets of machine weapons, Shuli sniping guns, Lichuan pistols, and the like, more than twenty thousand jin of gunpowder, and more than three hundred thousand Martini and Mauser rifle rounds.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 32 (1906), Sichuan Governor Xi Liang reviewed the machine bureau's output and continued production of 104 sets of machine weapons, Shuli sniping guns, and Lichuan pistols, more than 20,000 jin of gunpowder, and more than 300,000 Martini and Mauser rounds.

sentences.zh: 湖廣總督張之洞以湖北省新增鋼藥各廠，所有經費，由兵工總局兌收。

translations.literal: Governor-General Zhang Zhidong of Hu-Guang reported that for the newly added steel and powder plants in Hubei, all expenses were to be covered by the Ordnance General Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Zhang Zhidong of Hu-Guang reported that all expenses for Hubei's newly added steel and powder plants were to be covered by the Ordnance General Bureau.

sentences.zh: 兩江總督周馥上言，上海製造局各項軍火，悉仿西式造成，分給各省，共經費二百三十八萬兩有奇，所用材料，多系洋產，工資物價，均無定例，難以常例相繩。

translations.literal: Governor-General Zhou Fu of the Two Jiangs submitted a memorial that the Shanghai Manufacturing Bureau's ordnance, all made in Western style and distributed to the provinces, had cost more than 2.38 million taels in all; the materials used were mostly foreign products, and wages and prices had no fixed standard, so they could not be bound by ordinary rules.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Zhou Fu of the Two Jiangs submitted a memorial that the Shanghai Manufacturing Bureau's Western-style ordnance, distributed to the provinces, had cost more than 2.38 million taels; most materials were foreign imports, and wages and prices had no fixed standard, so ordinary regulations could not be applied.

sentences.zh: 陝西巡撫曹鴻勛以陝西省製造局陸續制給各營火藥三萬餘斤，鉛丸七千餘斤，為滿、綠各營操防之用。

translations.literal: Shaanxi Governor Cao Hongxun reported that the Shaanxi manufacturing bureau had successively supplied the camps with more than thirty thousand jin of gunpowder and more than seven thousand jin of lead balls for the training and defense of the Manchu and Green Standard camps.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi Governor Cao Hongxun reported that the Shaanxi manufacturing bureau had successively supplied the camps with more than 30,000 jin of gunpowder and more than 7,000 jin of lead balls for Manchu and Green Standard training and defense.

sentences.zh: 直隸總督袁世凱、兩江總督端方會議，令金陵機器局仿照外洋製造各式砲位車輛架具、炸彈銅火以及修配砲台等處需用物件，分設機器翻沙、鐵木、槍子、卷銅、火藥各廠，雇募工匠，常川製造。

translations.literal: Governor-General Yuan Shikai of Zhili and Governor-General Duan Fang of the Two Jiangs jointly deliberated and ordered the Jinling Machine Bureau, following foreign models, to manufacture various gun mounts, vehicles, fittings, explosive shells, and copper primers, as well as items needed for fort batteries and repairs; separate machine, sand-casting, iron-and-wood, bullet, copper-rolling, and powder plants were established, craftsmen were hired, and manufacture was carried on continuously.
translations.idiomatic: Governors-General Yuan Shikai of Zhili and Duan Fang of the Two Jiangs jointly ordered the Jinling Machine Bureau to follow foreign models in manufacturing gun mounts, vehicles, fittings, explosive shells, copper primers, and fort-battery items; separate machine, sand-casting, iron-and-wood, bullet, copper-rolling, and powder plants were established, craftsmen were hired, and production was kept running continuously.

sentences.zh: 四川總督錫良擴充川省製造槍砲所，造毛瑟槍彈，一切改良，仿造外洋九響毛瑟等槍子彈，亦能如式命中，修造機件，日益加多。

translations.literal: Sichuan Governor Xi Liang expanded the Sichuan gun and cannon works, manufacturing Mauser rifle rounds; with improvements in every respect, it copied foreign nine-shot Mauser and other rifle bullets and could hit the mark according to pattern; the machinery repaired and made grew daily more numerous.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan Governor Xi Liang expanded the provincial gun and cannon works, producing Mauser rifle rounds; with steady improvements it copied foreign nine-shot Mauser and other rifle ammunition to standard accuracy, and the machinery it repaired and built grew steadily.

sentences.zh: 是年，命政務處大臣會同部臣，嚴核各省機器槍砲局廠，五年保獎一次。

translations.literal: That year, grand councilors of the Bureau of Government Affairs were ordered, together with board officials, to strictly audit the machine rifle and cannon bureaus and plants of every province, with retention and reward once every five years.
translations.idiomatic: That year grand councilors of the Bureau of Government Affairs were ordered, together with ministry officials, to strictly audit every provincial machine rifle and cannon bureau and plant, with retention and reward once every five years.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，陸軍部議建四大兵工廠，使所出軍械，日精日多，以備緩急之用。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year, the Army Ministry deliberated building four major ordnance plants so that the arms produced would grow daily finer and more numerous, to prepare for emergencies.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 33 (1907), the Army Ministry proposed building four major ordnance plants so that output would grow steadily finer and more abundant for emergencies.

sentences.zh: 護理四川總督趙爾豐綜核機器局成績，於光緒三十二年內，共修理機器五十九起，舊式洋槍一千餘枝，新造法藍單響毛瑟槍一千四百餘枝，標刀帽火針簧一千四百二十餘起，洗把一百四十餘個，九響毛瑟槍藥彈一百零四萬二千餘顆，毛瑟槍藥殼三十三萬餘顆，單響毛瑟槍藥彈三十三萬六千顆，銅擊火八百顆，十三響馬槍彈一千二百顆，碰火二千顆，紅銅小火四十六萬顆，黃銅釘五十二萬顆，火槍八枝，洋鼓二百十二個，各項機件一萬五千十一起，已成洋火藥二萬八千一百八十五斤，均經試放合用，分別存儲。

translations.literal: Acting Sichuan Governor Zhao Erfeng reviewed the machine bureau's results: within Guangxu thirty-two, it repaired fifty-nine sets of machinery, more than one thousand old-pattern foreign rifles, more than one thousand four hundred newly made single-shot French Mauser rifles, one thousand four hundred and twenty-odd sets of bayonet caps, firing pins, and springs, more than one hundred and forty cleaning rods, more than one million forty-two thousand nine-shot Mauser rifle rounds, more than three hundred thirty thousand Mauser cartridge cases, three hundred thirty-six thousand single-shot Mauser rifle rounds, eight hundred copper primers, one thousand two hundred thirteen-shot cavalry rifle rounds, two thousand friction primers, four hundred sixty thousand small red-copper fire caps, five hundred twenty thousand brass nails, eight fire lances, two hundred twelve foreign drums, ten thousand five hundred eleven assorted machine parts, and twenty-eight thousand one hundred eighty-five jin of finished foreign gunpowder—all test-fired and found suitable and stored separately.
translations.idiomatic: Acting Sichuan Governor Zhao Erfeng reviewed the machine bureau's output: in Guangxu 32 (1906) it repaired 59 sets of machinery, more than 1,000 old-pattern foreign rifles, more than 1,400 newly made single-shot French Mauser rifles, 1,420-odd sets of bayonet caps, firing pins, and springs, more than 140 cleaning rods, more than 1,042,000 nine-shot Mauser rounds, more than 330,000 Mauser cartridge cases, 336,000 single-shot Mauser rounds, 800 copper primers, 1,200 thirteen-shot cavalry rounds, 2,000 friction primers, 460,000 small red-copper fire caps, 520,000 brass nails, 8 fire lances, 212 foreign drums, 10,511 assorted machine parts, and 28,185 jin of finished foreign gunpowder—all test-fired, found suitable, and stored separately.

sentences.zh: 湖廣總督張之洞創建湖北兵工廠，始於光緒十六年，經營籌度，至是年而規模始具。

translations.literal: Governor-General Zhang Zhidong of Hu-Guang founded the Hubei Ordnance Plant, beginning in Guangxu sixteen; after years of planning and management, by that year its scale was finally complete.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Zhang Zhidong of Hu-Guang founded the Hubei Ordnance Plant in Guangxu 16 (1890); after years of planning, by that year its scale was finally complete.

sentences.zh: 初辦時，每日所出七米里九口徑毛瑟快槍不過十餘枝，復經設法擴充，增置機器，以後每日可造成五十餘枝。

translations.literal: At the outset, the daily output of 7.9-millimeter Mauser quick-firing rifles was no more than ten-odd; after further expansion and added machinery, afterward fifty-odd could be made each day.
translations.idiomatic: At first daily output of 7.9-millimeter Mauser quick-firing rifles was only about ten; after further expansion and added machinery, it later reached more than fifty per day.

sentences.zh: 槍彈一項，僅日造數千顆，逐漸加造至五萬餘顆。

translations.literal: For rifle rounds alone, only several thousand were made daily at first; manufacture was gradually increased to more than fifty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Rifle rounds at first totaled only a few thousand per day; production was gradually raised to more than 50,000.

sentences.zh: 所造三生的七格魯森快砲，自開機至二十五年止，共造成六十餘尊。

translations.literal: The 3.7-centimeter Gruson quick-firing guns made, from the opening of the plant until the twenty-fifth year, totaled more than sixty pieces.
translations.idiomatic: From the plant's opening until Guangxu 25 (1899), it produced more than sixty 3.7-centimeter Gruson quick-firing guns.

sentences.zh: 嗣於二十五年改造五生的七過山快砲，每年可造成六十餘尊至九十尊。

translations.literal: Thereafter, in the twenty-fifth year it converted to 5.7-centimeter mountain quick-firing guns, of which sixty-odd to ninety could be made each year.
translations.idiomatic: From Guangxu 25 (1899) it switched to 5.7-centimeter mountain quick-firing guns, producing sixty to ninety per year.

sentences.zh: 開花砲彈，由五萬餘顆遞加至每年七萬餘顆。

translations.literal: Explosive shells increased step by step from more than fifty thousand to more than seventy thousand each year.
translations.idiomatic: Explosive shell output rose step by step from more than 50,000 to more than 70,000 per year.

sentences.zh: 所造各項槍砲子彈，與來自外洋者無所區別。

translations.literal: The various rifles, cannon, and bullets manufactured were indistinguishable from those coming from abroad.
translations.idiomatic: The rifles, cannon, and ammunition it produced were indistinguishable from foreign imports.

sentences.zh: 至鋼藥二種，逐年次第增設鍊鋼、拉鋼各廠，所煉出鋼質，亦頗精良合用。

translations.literal: As for the two types of steel and powder, steel-refining and steel-drawing plants were added year by year in succession; the steel smelted was also quite fine and suitable for use.
translations.idiomatic: For steel and powder, steel-refining and steel-drawing plants were added year by year; the steel smelted was also quite fine and serviceable.

sentences.zh: 火藥廠所造成無煙火藥，足能源源接濟，使兵工廠無誤製造子彈之用。

translations.literal: The smokeless powder made by the powder plant was sufficient to supply continuously, so that the ordnance plant would not fall behind in manufacturing bullets.
translations.idiomatic: The powder plant's smokeless powder supply was steady enough to keep bullet production at the ordnance plant from falling behind.

sentences.zh: 所造軍械至三十二年年底止，共造成馬步快槍十萬一千六百九十枝，槍彈四千三百四十三萬七千九百三十一顆，各種快砲七百三十尊，前膛車砲一百三十五尊，各種開花砲彈六十三萬一千七百顆，前膛砲彈六萬零八百六十顆。

translations.literal: Arms manufactured up to the end of the thirty-second year totaled one hundred ten thousand one hundred ninety cavalry and infantry quick-firing rifles, four hundred thirty-four million three hundred seventy-nine thousand thirty-one rifle rounds, seven hundred thirty quick-firing guns of various types, one hundred thirty-five muzzle-loading field guns, six hundred thirty-one thousand seven hundred explosive shells, and sixty thousand eight hundred sixty muzzle-loading shells.
translations.idiomatic: By the end of Guangxu 32 (1906), total output was 110,190 cavalry and infantry quick-firing rifles, 434,379,031 rifle rounds, 730 quick-firing guns of various types, 135 muzzle-loading field guns, 631,700 explosive shells, and 60,860 muzzle-loading shells.

sentences.zh: 辦事各員，不辭勞瘁，寒暑無間，乃能有此成績。

translations.literal: The officials in charge, undaunted by hardship, worked without interruption through cold and heat—only thus could there be such results.
translations.idiomatic: The officials in charge worked through cold and heat without rest—only thus could such results be achieved.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十四年，曾加獎勵，今又及十年之久，仍匯案給獎。

translations.literal: In Guangxu twenty-four rewards had once been granted; now, after another ten years, the cases were again assembled and rewards given.
translations.idiomatic: Rewards had been granted once in Guangxu 24 (1898); after another ten years the cases were assembled again and rewards issued.

sentences.zh: 安徽巡撫馮煦以安徽省所用槍彈，向年購自他省，乃以原有之造幣廠改為製造局，為自造子彈及修理槍械之用，遂購機募匠，開局興辦。

translations.literal: Anhui Governor Feng Xu reported that the rifle rounds used in Anhui had in past years been purchased from other provinces; he therefore converted the existing mint into a manufacturing bureau for self-made bullets and rifle repair, purchased machinery, hired craftsmen, and opened the bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Anhui Governor Feng Xu reported that Anhui's rifle rounds had long been bought from other provinces; he converted the existing mint into a manufacturing bureau for local bullets and rifle repair, bought machinery, hired craftsmen, and opened operations.

sentences.zh: 四川總督錫良以上年曾派員出洋考察製造軍械事宜，即在德國名廠訂購製造小口徑毛瑟快槍及造子彈、造無煙火藥各種機器，分運到川。

translations.literal: Sichuan Governor Xi Liang reported that the previous year he had dispatched officials abroad to inspect arms manufacture; at famous German plants they ordered machinery for manufacturing small-caliber Mauser quick-firing rifles, bullet-making, and smokeless powder, which was shipped to Sichuan in separate consignments.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan Governor Xi Liang reported that the previous year he had sent officials abroad to inspect arms manufacture; at famous German plants they ordered machinery for small-caliber Mauser quick-firing rifles, bullet-making, and smokeless powder, shipped to Sichuan in separate consignments.

sentences.zh: 因舊日製造局無可展拓，乃另擇相宜之地，建築造槍廠、造槍彈廠、造無煙火藥廠，仿德國蜀赫廠新式自造。

translations.literal: Because the old manufacturing bureau could not be expanded, a suitable site was newly chosen and rifle, bullet, and smokeless-powder plants were built, copying the new German Suhl pattern for self-manufacture.
translations.idiomatic: Because the old manufacturing bureau could not be expanded, a new site was chosen and rifle, bullet, and smokeless-powder plants were built, copying the new German Suhl pattern for local production.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，直隸總督楊士驤在保定省城內軍械局增建火藥庫及兵房。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year, Zhili Governor Yang Shixiang added a powder magazine and barracks at the ordnance bureau within Baoding provincial city.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 34 (1908), Zhili Governor Yang Shixiang added a powder magazine and barracks at the ordnance bureau in Baoding.

sentences.zh: 東三省總督徐世昌以近年東省新軍日增，乃於省城設立軍械總局，吉林、黑龍江二省各設分局，以修械司附屬之。

translations.literal: Governor-General Xu Shichang of the Three Eastern Provinces reported that in recent years the new armies of the eastern provinces had grown daily; he therefore established a general ordnance bureau in the provincial capital, with branch bureaus in Jilin and Heilongjiang, to which repair services were attached.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Xu Shichang of the Three Eastern Provinces reported that the eastern provinces' new armies had grown steadily; he established a general ordnance bureau in the provincial capital, with branch bureaus in Jilin and Heilongjiang and attached repair services.

sentences.zh: 宣統元年，陸軍部建議，泰西各國軍械製造局廠內首領以次各官，多與我國副、協都統、參領、軍校諸秩相埒。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xuantong, the Army Ministry proposed that in the ordnance manufacturing bureaus and plants of Western countries, the chief down through the various officials mostly ranked on a par with our vice commanders, assistant commanders, staff officers, and military academy graduates.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 1 (1909), the Army Ministry proposed that in Western ordnance bureaus and plants, the chief and subordinate officials mostly ranked on a par with Chinese vice commanders, assistant commanders, staff officers, and military academy graduates.

sentences.zh: 我國製造軍械，設立學堂，將來製造人才造就日多，應仿各國成規，於各製造廠設工官以供驅使，湖廣總督陳夔龍以湖北省兵工鋼藥廠自成立以來，為軍械要需，每年經費，增銀至八十萬兩，以維局務。

translations.literal: Because China manufactures arms and establishes schools, and in future manufacturing talent will daily increase, it should follow the regulations of the various countries and establish technical officers at each manufacturing plant for employment; Governor-General Chen Kuilong of Hu-Guang reported that since the Hubei Ordnance Steel and Powder Plant was established, as an essential need for ordnance, its annual expenses were increased to eight hundred thousand taels to maintain bureau affairs.
translations.idiomatic: As China manufactured arms and trained talent in its schools, technical officers should be established at each plant following foreign practice; Governor-General Chen Kuilong of Hu-Guang reported that since the Hubei Ordnance Steel and Powder Plant was essential to ordnance, its annual budget was raised to 800,000 taels to sustain operations.

sentences.zh: 二年，東三省總督錫良在奉天省垣設立軍裝製造局，選集木材鐵革各工師，分科製造，以供奉、吉、黑三省軍隊、巡警之用。

translations.literal: In the second year, Governor-General Xi Liang of the Three Eastern Provinces established a military-equipment manufacturing bureau in Fengtian provincial city, gathering wood, iron, and leather craftsmen by specialty for manufacture, to supply the armies and police of Fengtian, Jilin, and Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 2 (1910), Governor-General Xi Liang of the Three Eastern Provinces established a military-equipment manufacturing bureau in Fengtian, gathering wood, iron, and leather craftsmen by specialty to supply the armies and police of Fengtian, Jilin, and Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 三年，吉林巡撫陳昭常以吉林省陸軍改編成鎮，設立軍械專局，附設修械司，備軍警之需。

translations.literal: In the third year, Jilin Governor Chen Zhaochang reported that the Jilin army was reorganized into a brigade and a special ordnance bureau was established, with an attached repair service, to meet army and police needs.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 3 (1911), Jilin Governor Chen Zhaochang reported that the Jilin army was reorganized into a brigade; a special ordnance bureau was established with an attached repair service to meet army and police needs.

sentences.zh: 綜舉各省製造軍械之事，同治元年，天津初造槍砲，二三年間，江蘇分設機器局於江寧、上海，共設三局。

translations.literal: Summing up the manufacture of arms in the various provinces: in the first year of Tongzhi, Tianjin first made rifles and cannon; in the second and third years, Jiangsu separately established machine bureaus at Jiangning and Shanghai—three bureaus in all.
translations.idiomatic: In summary, provincial arms manufacture began when Tianjin first made rifles and cannon in Tongzhi 1 (1862); in Tongzhi 2–3 (1863–64) Jiangsu established separate machine bureaus at Jiangning and Shanghai—three bureaus in all.

sentences.zh: 四年，並三局於上海，定名機器製造局。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, the three bureaus were merged at Shanghai and named the Machine Manufacturing Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 4 (1865) the three bureaus were merged at Shanghai as the Machine Manufacturing Bureau.

sentences.zh: 六年，天津擴充製造，設軍火機器局。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Tianjin expanded manufacture and established the Ordnance and Machine Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 6 (1867) Tianjin expanded production and established the Ordnance and Machine Bureau.

sentences.zh: 九年，改名天津機器局。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, it was renamed the Tianjin Machine Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 9 (1870) it was renamed the Tianjin Machine Bureau.

sentences.zh: 十三年，福建設機器局，自造開花砲。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, Fujian established a machine bureau and made explosive shells on its own.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 13 (1874) Fujian established a machine bureau and began making explosive shells locally.

sentences.zh: 上海製造局仿造林明登槍。

translations.literal: The Shanghai Manufacturing Bureau copied Remington rifles.
translations.idiomatic: The Shanghai Manufacturing Bureau copied Remington rifles.

sentences.zh: 天津、上海二局，均仿造水雷。

translations.literal: The Tianjin and Shanghai bureaus both copied torpedoes.
translations.idiomatic: The Tianjin and Shanghai bureaus both copied torpedoes.

sentences.zh: 廣東設機器局、軍火局。

translations.literal: Guangdong established a machine bureau and an ordnance bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Guangdong established a machine bureau and an ordnance bureau.

sentences.zh: 上海、江寧二局，增槍砲子彈機。

translations.literal: The Shanghai and Jiangning bureaus added rifle, cannon, and bullet machinery.
translations.idiomatic: The Shanghai and Jiangning bureaus added rifle, cannon, and bullet machinery.

sentences.zh: 光緒二年，派學生藝徒出洋，分赴各國學習製造。

translations.literal: In the second year of Guangxu, students and apprentices were sent abroad to the various countries to study manufacture.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 2 (1876) students and apprentices were sent abroad to study manufacturing in various countries.

sentences.zh: 湖南、山東二省，均設機器局，自造軍械，不用洋匠。

translations.literal: Hunan and Shandong both established machine bureaus and made arms on their own, without employing foreign craftsmen.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan and Shandong both established machine bureaus and made arms locally without foreign craftsmen.

sentences.zh: 三年，四川設局專造馬梯尼後膛槍。

translations.literal: In the third year, Sichuan established a bureau specializing in Martini breech-loading rifles.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 3 (1877) Sichuan established a bureau specializing in Martini breech-loading rifles.

sentences.zh: 四年，津局造後膛砲。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, the Tianjin bureau made breech-loading cannon.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 4 (1878) the Tianjin bureau made breech-loading cannon.

sentences.zh: 六年，江寧局造來福槍、馬梯尼槍、林明登槍。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, the Jiangning bureau made rifles, Martini guns, and Remington guns.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 6 (1880) the Jiangning bureau made rifles, Martini guns, and Remington guns.

sentences.zh: 七年，上海局造砲台鋼砲。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, the Shanghai bureau made fort steel guns.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 7 (1881) the Shanghai bureau made fort steel guns.

sentences.zh: 吉林設機器局。

translations.literal: Jilin established a machine bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Jilin established a machine bureau.

sentences.zh: 江寧增設洋火藥局。

translations.literal: Jiangning added a foreign-powder bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangning added a foreign-powder bureau.

sentences.zh: 十一年，廣東設製造局及水雷局。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, Guangdong established a manufacturing bureau and a torpedo bureau.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 11 (1885) Guangdong established a manufacturing bureau and a torpedo bureau.

sentences.zh: 十三年，江寧局造田雞砲。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, the Jiangning bureau made frog guns.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 13 (1887) the Jiangning bureau made frog guns.

sentences.zh: 廣東設槍彈廠。

translations.literal: Guangdong established a rifle-round plant.
translations.idiomatic: Guangdong established a rifle-round plant.

sentences.zh: 十六年，湖北設兵工廠，所造新式槍砲，為南北洋、川、廣各製造局所無，並籌備煉鐵廠及開煤礦，為製造之基。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, Hubei established an ordnance plant; the new-pattern rifles and cannon it made were unmatched by the manufacturing bureaus of the northern and southern fleets, Sichuan, and Guangdong, and it also prepared an iron-smelting plant and coal mines as the foundation for manufacture.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 16 (1890) Hubei established an ordnance plant whose new-pattern rifles and cannon surpassed those of the northern and southern fleet bureaus and the Sichuan and Guangdong plants; it also prepared an iron-smelting plant and coal mines as the foundation for production.

sentences.zh: 十八年，貴州設爐煉鐵。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, Guizhou established furnace iron-smelting.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 18 (1892) Guizhou established furnace iron-smelting.

sentences.zh: 十九年，天津、上海二局，均設爐煉鐵。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, the Tianjin and Shanghai bureaus both established furnace iron-smelting.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 19 (1893) the Tianjin and Shanghai bureaus both established furnace iron-smelting.

sentences.zh: 上海局增造新式槍砲。

translations.literal: The Shanghai bureau added manufacture of new-pattern rifles and cannon.
translations.idiomatic: The Shanghai bureau added new-pattern rifles and cannon.

sentences.zh: 湖北設煉鐵廠。

translations.literal: Hubei established an iron-smelting plant.
translations.idiomatic: Hubei established an iron-smelting plant.

sentences.zh: 二十年，湖北增設砲架、砲彈、槍彈三廠。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, Hubei added three plants for gun carriages, shells, and rifle rounds.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 20 (1894) Hubei added plants for gun carriages, shells, and rifle rounds.

sentences.zh: 陝西運取甘肅舊存機器以備造械。

translations.literal: Shaanxi transported old machinery stored in Gansu to prepare for arms manufacture.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi brought old machinery stored in Gansu to prepare for arms manufacture.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，天津機器局改名總理北洋機器局。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, the Tianjin Machine Bureau was renamed the Superintendent Northern Seas Machine Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 21 (1895) the Tianjin Machine Bureau was renamed the Superintendent Northern Seas Machine Bureau.

sentences.zh: 廣東造抬槍、線槍。

translations.literal: Guangdong made sniping guns and muskets.
translations.idiomatic: Guangdong made sniping guns and muskets.

sentences.zh: 湖北、江南二省，均增設鍊鋼廠、栗色火藥廠、無煙火藥廠。

translations.literal: Hubei and Jiangnan both added steel-refining plants, brown-powder plants, and smokeless-powder plants.
translations.idiomatic: Hubei and Jiangnan both added steel-refining, brown-powder, and smokeless-powder plants.

sentences.zh: 陝西設機器局。

translations.literal: Shaanxi established a machine bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi established a machine bureau.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，江南新廠造快利新槍。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, the new Jiangnan plant made Kuaili new rifles.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 22 (1896) the new Jiangnan plant made Kuaili rifles.

sentences.zh: 天津局購機造新式砲子。

translations.literal: The Tianjin bureau purchased machinery to make new-pattern shells.
translations.idiomatic: The Tianjin bureau bought machinery to make new-pattern shells.

sentences.zh: 四川局造後膛毛瑟抬槍。

translations.literal: The Sichuan bureau made breech-loading Mauser sniping guns.
translations.idiomatic: The Sichuan bureau made breech-loading Mauser sniping guns.

sentences.zh: 天津局造中機、邊機前門抬槍。

translations.literal: The Tianjin bureau made center- and rim-fire front-gate sniping guns.
translations.idiomatic: The Tianjin bureau made center- and rim-fire front-gate sniping guns.

sentences.zh: 湖北廠以舊日之抬槍、線槍、抬砲、劈山砲，均改造後膛。

translations.literal: The Hubei plant converted the old sniping guns, muskets, sniping cannon, and mountain-blasting guns entirely to breech-loading.
translations.idiomatic: The Hubei plant converted its old sniping guns, muskets, sniping cannon, and mountain-blasting guns entirely to breech-loading.

sentences.zh: 山東增熟鐵廠、軋銅廠、槍子廠、大槍廠。

translations.literal: Shandong added wrought-iron, copper-rolling, bullet, and large-rifle plants.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong added wrought-iron, copper-rolling, bullet, and large-rifle plants.

sentences.zh: 河南局增造槍彈火藥及造抬槍機器。

translations.literal: The Henan bureau added manufacture of rifle rounds and powder and machinery for sniping guns.
translations.idiomatic: The Henan bureau added rifle rounds and powder and machinery for sniping guns.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，湖北廠增造罐子鋼及造無煙火藥機器。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, the Hubei plant added manufacture of crucible steel and smokeless-powder machinery.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 23 (1897) the Hubei plant added crucible steel and smokeless-powder machinery.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，山西設製造槍砲廠。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, Shanxi established a rifle and cannon manufacturing plant.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 24 (1898) Shanxi established a rifle and cannon manufacturing plant.

sentences.zh: 上海、天津二局，均增造快砲機器。

translations.literal: The Shanghai and Tianjin bureaus both added quick-firing gun machinery.
translations.idiomatic: The Shanghai and Tianjin bureaus both added quick-firing gun machinery.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，山東增建造槍、造彈、化銅、軋銅各廠。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, Shandong added rifle, shell, copper-refining, and copper-rolling plants.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 25 (1899) Shandong added rifle, shell, copper-refining, and copper-rolling plants.

sentences.zh: 黑龍江設機器局。

translations.literal: Heilongjiang established a machine bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Heilongjiang established a machine bureau.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，福建增建槍子廠。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, Fujian added a bullet plant.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 26 (1900) Fujian added a bullet plant.

sentences.zh: 天津增建快砲子廠、快槍子廠、無煙火藥廠。

translations.literal: Tianjin added quick-firing shell, quick-firing rifle-round, and smokeless-powder plants.
translations.idiomatic: Tianjin added quick-firing shell, quick-firing rifle-round, and smokeless-powder plants.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，江西局增造槍砲機器。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, the Jiangxi bureau added rifle and cannon machinery.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 28 (1902) the Jiangxi bureau added rifle and cannon machinery.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，福建並造槍造藥二廠為一廠。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, Fujian merged its rifle and powder plants into one plant.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 29 (1903) Fujian merged its rifle and powder plants into one.

sentences.zh: 三十年，河南局增造槍砲機器。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year, the Henan bureau added rifle and cannon machinery.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 30 (1904) the Henan bureau added rifle and cannon machinery.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，陸軍部議建四大兵工廠。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year, the Army Ministry deliberated building four major ordnance plants.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 33 (1907) the Army Ministry proposed building four major ordnance plants.

sentences.zh: 四川設造槍廠、造彈廠、造無煙火藥廠。

translations.literal: Sichuan established rifle, bullet, and smokeless-powder plants.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan established rifle, bullet, and smokeless-powder plants.

sentences.zh: 安徽建槍彈廠。

translations.literal: Anhui built a rifle-round plant.
translations.idiomatic: Anhui built a rifle-round plant.

sentences.zh: 宣統二年，奉天建軍裝製造局。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xuantong, Fengtian built a military-equipment manufacturing bureau.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 2 (1910) Fengtian built a military-equipment manufacturing bureau.

sentences.zh: 三年，吉林設軍械局。

translations.literal: In the third year, Jilin established an ordnance bureau.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 3 (1911) Jilin established an ordnance bureau.

sentences.zh: 各省機器局廠之設，歷時垂五十餘年，開局遍十七行省，幾經增改，漸就精良。

translations.literal: The establishment of machine bureaus and plants in the various provinces extended over more than fifty years; bureaus were opened throughout the seventeen provinces, and after repeated additions and changes they gradually reached refinement.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial machine bureaus and plants took more than fifty years to develop; bureaus spread across all seventeen provinces and, through repeated expansion and revision, gradually reached a high standard.

sentences.zh: 此制造軍械之大概也。

translations.literal: This is the general account of the manufacture of arms.
translations.idiomatic: Such, in broad outline, was the manufacture of arms.
